name: Vaada sabse pehle
when: Har video ki shuruaat par
action: Title/thumbnail jo vaada kare, wahi cheez pehle seconds me dikhao ya bolo — result, sabse striking moment, ya woh sawal jiska jawab video hai
why: Viewer pehle seconds me faisla karta hai; YouTube ka official lever hai ki thumbnail/title asal content ko reflect kare aur intro wahi dikhaye
frequency: Har video; long-form me pehle 5-30 s ke window me, Shorts me pehle frame/3 s me
evidence_note: YouTube official guidance (YT-moments, platform) + Melvynx ke measured outlier data; ExpoCut playbook bhi yahi kehta hai

name: Intro, greeting, logo — hook se pehle kuch nahi
when: Kisi bhi video (long-form ya Short) ke opening seconds me
action: Greeting ('Hey guys, welcome back'), channel intro, logo sting, subscribe pitch — kuch bhi hook se pehle mat rakho; pehli cheez viewer promise/payoff sune ya dekhe. Logo aaye to content ke upar card ki tarah aaye, alag shot me kabhi nahi
why: Pehle seconds vaade ke liye hain — greeting/intro unhi seconds ko khaali cheez par kharch karta hai jahan audience sabse zyada girti hai; subscribe pitch abhi earn hi nahi hua. Saare source clusters isey sabse aam opening galti mante hain
frequency: Har video ki shuruaat par, bina exception
evidence_note: Creator practice (TubeBuddy/TikTok blogs) + kmilo/Melvynx house rules + Jake/SkillMedev/serge ki shared craft rule; ExpoCut: 'never on an intro card' (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com); koi measured study nahi

name: Cold open = sabse mazboot moment
when: Video ki structure banate waqt
action: Video ke best moment/line ko shuruaat me rakho (vlog ka best pal, podcast ki sabse mazboot exchange, tutorial ka end-state), phir context par wapas aao
why: Thanda, dheere chadhne wala start viewer ko rok nahi pata; best moment hi thumbnail ke vaade ko sach karta hai
frequency: Talking head 5-15 s, podcast 15-60 s, tutorial hook 10-20 s (end-state pehle)
evidence_note: Creator practice (TubeBuddy-hacks aadi) — kmilo recipes ka standing structure rule

name: Hook formula se, score 7+ ka gate
when: Har script likhte waqt
action: 3 hooks 3 alag formulas se likho (22 formulas ki library: pain, claim, number, mistake, story, promise, curiosity, proof, reaction), har hook ko 5-point rubric (Specific, Tension, Viewer, Fast, True) par 0-2 score karo, best rakho; sab 7/10 se kam hon to 3 aur likho
why: Ek hi andaz ka hook aksar kamzor hota hai; teen vikalp + score se mazboot hook chunna aasan aur dohraane layak hota hai
frequency: Har script par 3 hooks; rakha hua hook ≥7/10
evidence_note: Melvynx studio-script ka creator system (rubric usi ka banaya hua, koi public data nahi)

name: On-screen hook chhota aur alag
when: Short ki pehli 1-2 s me on-screen text lagate waqt
action: Screen par hook 6-7 shabd se zyada nahi, ek accent word ke saath; woh spoken hook ki copy na ho, usme kuch jode (number, result, sawal)
why: Sound-off viewer ko screen wala hook hi rokta hai; bola hua dohraane se dusri jaankari ki jagah khali जाती hai
frequency: Har short; Melvynx ≤6 shabd, ExpoCut 4-7 shabd
evidence_note: Melvynx house rule + ExpoCut playbook practice (ExpoCut: Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com)

name: Open loop kholo, aakhir se pehle band mat karo
when: Script ki structure me
action: Aage aane wali cheez announce karo ('teesri wali ne hairaan kar diya') aur uska payoff end ke paas do; har sentence usi ek vaade ko aage badhaye, detour nahi
why: Khula sawal viewer ko roke rakhta hai; jo hissa video ko aage nahi badhata, retention graph wahi girta hai
frequency: Har video me kam se kam 1 open loop, payoff end se pehle nahi
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo hook-and-retention); Melvynx ke measured viral data me 'one promise, paid line after line' isko support karta hai

name: Re-hook 40-60% par
when: Script ke beech wale hisse me
action: 40-60% ke aas-paas ek line rakho jo dhyaan restart kare: naya sawal, number, twist ('lekin isse theek nahi hua'), ya sabse mushkil hissa ('ye wala sab skip karte hain')
why: Beech me dhyaan girna sabse aam hai; ek naya gap wahi rokta hai jahan viewer jaane wala hota hai
frequency: 25 s se lambi har script me 1 re-hook; 25 s se chhoti skip kar sakte ho
evidence_note: Melvynx ke niche-outlier measurements (apne studied accounts) me consistent pattern — measured data, peer-reviewed nahi

name: Ek video = ek idea, ek vaada
when: Topic aur script tay karte waqt
action: Ek hi idea rakho; script me 'and also' aaye to woh dusri video hai; hook se ask tak ek hi promise chale
why: Do topics wala video dono me aadha rehta hai; ek vaada hi retention aur share dono banata hai
evidence_note: Melvynx script-rules ka house rule

name: Topic pehle, script baad me (proven concept)
when: Kuch bhi likhne se pehle, planning par
action: Woh concept chuno jo niche me pehle over-perform kar chuka ho (account median ke x3+ outliers wala); kaam ka kram: topic > hook > structure; fresh news wala topic ho to use week me pehle rakho
why: Measured data kehta hai views topic se bante hain — same creator, same edit, topic badalte hi x1 se x100 ka farak
frequency: Week ke 5 scripts me kam se kam 3 proven concept par
evidence_note: Melvynx ke outlier measurements (har studied niche me median ke muqable) — measured data

name: Object 0 second par, hook me specific
when: Short ke pehle frame aur pehli line par
action: Jis cheez ke baare me video hai use pehle second me dikhao (naam baad me), aur pehli line me kam se kam ek specific rakho: number, bade brand ka naam, ya 'free'
why: Viewer 1 s me tay karta hai 'ye mere liye hai ya nahi'; creator ke baare me hook ya vague category x1 par reh jati hai
evidence_note: Melvynx viral research ke measured rules (every niche checked)

name: Proof 8 second ke andar
when: Video ki shuruaat me
action: 8 s ke andar proof dikha do — number, screen, ya receipt — taaki viewer ko baaki video par bharosa ho
why: Bina saboot ke vaada sirf daava lagta hai; jaldi proof aage ki baaton ko wazan deta hai
frequency: Har script; viral data kehta hai 4-7 s sabse achha
evidence_note: Melvynx viral measurements (proof by 4-7 s) + script trigger rule (proof before 8 s)

name: Triggers kam se kam 4, apni jagah par
when: Script likhne ke baad check karte waqt
action: Kam se kam 4 triggers sahi jagah rakho: curiosity gap (hook), self-recognition (hook/line 2), proof (8 s se pehle), enemy (problem par — tool/habit/myth, viewer kabhi nahi), pattern break (re-hook), specificity (fix me), loss/urgency (ask se pehle; fake scarcity kabhi nahi)
why: Script isiliye tikti hai kyunki har hissa sahi pal par ek lever kheenchta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx script-rules ka creator framework

name: Funnel: darwaza bada, pivot 20-35% par
when: Naye viewers tak pahunchne wali Teach/Opinion video par
action: M ya L size ke topic se kholo (bridge 0-3 s: debate, bada naam, sabki roz ki scene), tension 3-10 s, pivot script ke 20-35% par niche ki taraf modo, pearl (sabse mazboot line) sabse pehle likho; bridge par 2 test: niche tak 15 s ke andar pahunche? kal ko is viewer ko offer chahiye hoga?
why: Sirf niche ke topic par video chhote test group me hi marti hai; bada darwaza sahi viewer ko andar laata hai
frequency: Naye-reach wali videos par; pivot hamesha 20-35% band me
evidence_note: Melvynx funnel reference ka creator framework

name: Divisive bridge ke kaide
when: Funnel me behes wala bridge use karte waqt
action: Niche ke pehchane debate par ek paksh lo, ek sentence me kaho aur use fairly defend karo (pehle opposite ki ek line, phir apni wajah + example); hamla idea/habit/tool par ho, kisi person ya viewer group par kabhi nahi; CTA soft rakho (proximity 0-1)
why: Behes sabse chauda darwaza hai, lekin galat nishana rage-bait ban jata hai aur sakht sale usi pal bharosa tod deta hai
frequency: Divisive script me; bridge kabhi poori video nahi
evidence_note: Melvynx funnel reference ka creator framework

name: Hook khule, sirf ek baar repeat ho
when: Koi line hook bana kar cut ki shuruaat me rakho to
action: Hook line cut ko khole aur poori edit me apne context me sirf ek baar repeat ho; dusri baar repeat kabhi nahi
why: Reviewer ki standing pasand: ek repeat context deta hai, dusra repeat defect mana gaya (pipeline ke apne itihaas me repeat bug do baar lauta)
frequency: Har reel jisme hook prepend ho — repeat count theek 1
evidence_note: mktkit owner/reviewer ka house rule, QA gate (hook.once) se enforce hota hai
conflict_note: Ye sirf mktkit ka design rule hai; baaki teen sources me hook-repeat ka koi niyam nahi — aam taur par repeat ko galti hi mana jata hai, dusri pipeline me lagane se pehle socho

name: End screen aur closing
when: YouTube lambi video ke aakhir me
action: Aakhri 5-20 s end screen ke liye khaali rakho (video ≥25 s ho, ≤4 elements aayenge, wahan zaroori text mat rakho); closing ek sentence me batao aage kahan jana hai — lambi recap nahi
why: End screen elements content ko dhak dete hain; lambe sign-off par hi retention sabse tez girti hai
evidence_note: YouTube official end-screen spec (platform rule)

name: CTA ek line me, object ke saath
when: Video ke aakhir me ask rakhte waqt
action: Ek hi ask, ek line me, aur woh koi cheez de (repo, guide, prompt); Shorts me CTA card aakhri 2-3 s me; 'thanks for watching' ya bina exact shabd wala 'comment karo' nahi
why: CTA views nahi banata, comments/DMs banata hai — aur kai asks ek saath koi ask nahi banta
frequency: Har video me 1 ask; Offer video ke alawa soft
evidence_note: Melvynx viral measurements (CTA reach nahi banata) + shorts-codes ka house rule

name: Facts aur numbers invent mat karo
when: Script ya video me koi number, naam ya result aaye to
action: Number/naam/result sirf asal source se (creator ke diye hue facts); jo na mile use {{placeholder}} rakho aur 'bharna baki' me likho; koi figure bina source ke mat ghusao — source na ho to saaf kaho
why: Gadha hua number ek baar pakda jaye to poori channel ki baaton par bharosa jata hai
evidence_note: kmilo hard rule ('No invented numbers') + Melvynx facts rule — dono house/creator ethic

name: Licensed media hi; meme recreate karo
when: Music, SFX, footage ya meme use karte waqt
action: Sirf CC0, YouTube Audio Library, ya commercial use ki written license wala media lo; NC ya 'YouTube par mila hua' kabhi nahi; meme ka original media/music mat uthao — joke ko apne graphics se recreate karo
why: Monetized channel par ek claim poori video (aur channel) ko mehenga pad sakta hai
frequency: Har asset par; library me naya sound aaye to uska license evidence record karo
evidence_note: kmilo hard rule + licenses reference (house rule, legal risk par based)

name: Body ki banawat type ke hisaab se
when: Script ka body likhte waqt
action: Type-wise beats rakho — Teach: problem → kyun hota hai → fix (steps/ek move) → kya badlega; Proof: result+number → concretely kya kiya → copyable hissa → honest catch; Story: moment (mid-scene) → turn → ek line ka lesson; Opinion: position → opposite ko fairly → reason+example → kya karein; Talking head: cold open → context → sections (har section mini-hook se khule) → payoff
why: Har type ka viewer alag ummeed se aata hai; banawat wahi ummeed poori karti hai to beech me girawat nahi aati
frequency: Har script par uske type ki banawat
evidence_note: Melvynx script-rules (body by type) + kmilo talking-head recipe structure

name: Week ka mix aur offer ki doori
when: Hafte ki scripts plan karte waqt
action: Pehle mix banao (5 me lagbhag Teach 2, Proof 1, Story 1, Opinion 1, Offer ≤1); ek hi hook formula lagatar do baar nahi, ek hi type hafte me teen baar nahi; offer proximity ladder 0-3 rakho — rung 3 hafte me ≤1 aur woh bhi sabse mazboot value video ke baad
why: Ek hi tarah ki videos thakati hain aur har video me bechna bharosa khatm karta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx week-mix aur offer-proximity house rules

name: Hit concept ko do hafte me repeat karo
when: Apna koi concept x3+ over-perform kare to
action: Use 2 hafte ke andar 2-3 naye hooks ya naye items ke saath repost karo, use 'luck' kehne se pehle
why: Jo shape ek baar median se kai guna gaya, woh recipe hai; dohraana hi use sabit karta hai
frequency: Har x3+ hit par, 14 din ke andar
evidence_note: Melvynx viral measurements ka rule (apne studied accounts par)

name: Retention report padh kar seekho
when: Video publish hone ke baad
action: Retention report dekho: jis moment par dip hai wahi agli baar cut/sudhar ka candidate hai; spikes (rewatch/share wale hisse) pehchano aur unhe dohraane ki koshish karo
why: Graph jhooth nahi bolta — dip aksar usi hisse par hota hai jo video ko aage nahi badhata
frequency: Har publish ke baad (key moments ≥60 s aur ≥100 views wali videos par milte hain)
evidence_note: YouTube official key-moments feature (platform data)

name: Script ki lines: ek saans, 4-15 shabd
when: Script likhte waqt
action: Ek line = ek sentence = ek saans, 4-15 shabd; abstract lines lagatar 3 nahi — teesri ko example bana do; ek viewer se baat karo ('you', 'you guys' nahi); chhote shabd, jo dost ko na kaho woh kato
why: Lambi, abstract lines bolne me bhi atakti hain aur sunne me bhi; ek-saans wali lines hi natural lagti hain
frequency: Har script ki har line par
evidence_note: Melvynx script-rules ka house style

name: AI wali banawat hatao (humanize)
when: Script ya koi bhi text finalize karne se pehle
action: AI ke nishan saaf karo: hype shabd (delve, unlock, game-changer jaisi khaali badi baatein) hatao ya number se badlo; preamble ('here's the thing') kato; recap ending hatao; engagement bait ('save this', 'tag someone') sirf asl ask se badlo; false contrast ('it's not X, it's Y') poori text me ≤1; tino-tino ki triads tod do
why: Chat-model jaisi banawat viewer ko turant 'ye asli insaan nahi' ka sanket deti hai aur bharosa girta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx ai-tells + humanize references ka creator framework

name: Clip standalone banao (long se short)
when: Lambi video se Short/Clip nikaalte waqt
action: Clip aisi jagah se kato jo bina context samajh aaye: pehli line 'so', 'as I said', 'this' jaisi bahari sahara wali na ho; ek hi idea poora ho; end finished thought par ho; long video ke references ('pichle part me') hata do; end payoff ya loop par
why: Jo clip context maangta hai woh feed me akela khada nahi ho pata
frequency: Har clip 20-60 s; Melvynx ka standalone score ≥7/10 (5 points × 0-2)
evidence_note: Melvynx clips skill ka scoring system + kmilo shorts recipe

name: Packaging pehle, production baad me
when: Har naye video idea par, script/shoot se pehle
action: Title aur thumbnail pehle design karo — ye idea ka test hai; agar compelling package na bane to idea kamzor hai, pehle wahi fix karo
why: Jo video click hi nahi hoga uski retention curve hi nahi banti; kamzori sabse saste stage par pakdi jati hai
frequency: Har video par 1 baar, pre-production me; Henterprise: har idea ke 3 packaging options bana kar best chuno
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Title/thumbnail ka vaada video me sach me pura karo
when: Opening aur payoff planning ke time
action: Thumbnail/title ne jo promise kiya hai use video me literally pay karo; curiosity sirf wahan rakho jahan video use sach me resolve kare
why: Unpaid promise turant drop karata hai aur unresolved curiosity viewer ko next time click na karne ki training deti hai
frequency: Har video, har vaade par; long-form hook payoff ≤15s (shorts ≤2.5s) — dekho B-006/B-017
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers + producer practice

name: Hook ke 3 variants — category mix karke
when: Short-form script ke liye hook chunne se pehle
action: 100 hook formulas ke 10 categories (appendix) se 3 candidate hooks banao: 1 stop-scroll category (negation / specificity / question) + 1 retention category (story / confession / emotional) + 1 free pick; har ek ke saath category label aur 'best for' note do
why: Pehla hook thumb rokta hai, dusra viewer ko 3 second ke aage rakhta hai; alag categories ke hooks aam taur par sabse strong hote hain
frequency: Har script par 3 variants; A/B test ya strongest fit ke liye
evidence_note: curated hook library / creator practice — creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Filled hook 12 shabdon se chhota rakho
when: Hook variant ko final karte waqt
action: Bracket bhara hua hook <12 words me rakho aur platform ke hisaab se native banao (TikTok/IG casual, LinkedIn punchy-declarative, YouTube title-style search-friendly, X short-contrarian)
why: Lamba hook pehle seconds me samajh nahi aata; chhota hook turant land karta hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: First-5-seconds checklist pass karo
when: Har video ke opening par, publish se pehle
action: Check: visual interesting/unexpected ≤1s; hook line boli gayi ≤3s; viewer ko milega kya, iska promise ≤5s tak implicit saaf; logo cold-open NAHI; 'Hi, I'm X' preamble NAHI — punch se shuru karo
why: Source ke data ke hisaab se aadhe viewers pehle 10 seconds me drop hote hain; hook hi tay karta hai ki baaki video exist karega ya nahi
frequency: Har video ke pehle 5 seconds par, bina exception
evidence_note: Wistia/Vidyard platform data par based skill (aadhe viewers pehle 10s me drop)

name: Cold open = hook, branding baad me
when: Long-form (10–55 min) video ki shuruaat par
action: Mid-content se kholo (threat/countdown, absurd exact number, universal observation, ya question ladder); 'hi, I'm X' 0:15–1:00 par rakho. Pehle 30s measured band: 65–98 words, 2–7 cuts, zero throat-clearing
why: Measured corpus me top explainers aise hi khulte hain; branding pehle rakhne se promise late hota hai aur drop badhta hai
frequency: Har long-form opening; first-30s words 65–98, cuts 2–7
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: Promise line jaldi bolo, payoff par verbatim dohrayo
when: Long-form script likhne/review karte waqt
action: Payoff line ('X because Y') shuru me state karo, video me use earn karo, aur end ke paas use verbatim restate karo
why: Viewer ko pehle se pata hota hai ki wo kis cheez ka intezaar kar raha hai; verbatim callback payoff ko band (close) kar deta hai
frequency: Har long-form video me 1 promise line; checklist: stated early AND restated at payoff
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: Har waqt ≥1 open loop zinda rakho
when: Poore long-form video ke structure me
action: Kam se kam ek open loop hamesha live rakho; loop 45 minute tak bhi chal sakta hai agar beech me re-tease ho aur payoff tease se ZYADA detail ke saath mile. Ek measured refrain (same benchmark artifact, har section naya number) permanently open loop ka kaam karta hai
why: Khula sawaal viewer ko band hone tak rokta hai; loop band hote hi nikalne ki wajah ban jati hai
frequency: Har pal ≥1 loop live; payoff hamesha tease se bada
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: Payoff ko aakhri 15–25% me rakho
when: Long-form structure plan karte waqt
action: Sabse bada payoff video ke last 15–25% hisse me rakho; beech wale loops uski taraf build karein, use jaldi close mat karo
why: Jaldi mila payoff baaki video ko dead weight bana deta hai (checklist me yahi violation flag hota hai)
frequency: Har long-form video ka main payoff 75–85% position ke aas-paas
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: Callback close + tez exit
when: Long-form video ke end par
action: Cold open ko echo karo (phrase/location/metaphor), CTA ko theme me buno (alag se ghusao mat), aur payoff ke ~30s ke andar video khatam kar do; bloopers end card ke baad
why: Callback kahani ko gol band karta hai; payoff ke baad lamba kheenchna end drop-off lata hai
frequency: Har long-form end; exit payoff ke ~30s ke andar
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: Sponsor/tangent ko container me rakho (20–33%)
when: Long-form me sponsor ya tangent aane par
action: Sponsor/tangent ko visually distinct container me rakho, joke segue se andar jao aur hard re-entry se bahar aao; placement runtime ke 20–33% hisse me
why: Measured corpus me containers aise hi chalte hain — viewer ko pata chalta hai ye alag hissa hai, aur re-entry kahani ko phir pakad leti hai
frequency: Har sponsor/tangent par; position 20–33% of runtime
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers
conflict_note: Henterprise ka B-012 kehta hai sponsor read pehle payoff ke BAAD hi aaye. Agar pehla payoff 33% ke baad hai to dono rules ek saath satisfy mushkil honge — Step 3 (Order) me iska faisla hoga.

name: Sponsor read pehle payoff ke baad hi
when: Long-form me sponsor read place karte waqt
action: Sponsor read ko hamesha pehle payoff ke baad rakho, kabhi usse pehle nahi
why: Vaada pura hone se pehle ad aana unpaid-promise jaisa lagta hai aur cliff bana sakta hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: Slopstudio ka B-011 sponsor ko 20–33% band me rakhta hai (measured). Agar pehla payoff der se hai to dono takra sakte hain — Step 3 (Order) decide karega.

name: Har seam par aage dekhne ki wajah do
when: Long-form ke har section transition par
action: Har transition/seam par explicit reason to continue rakho — ek open question, ek promised payoff, ya ek stated next step
why: Retention sections ke beech me nahi, seams (jod) par marti hai; bina wajah ke transition viewer ke liye exit point hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Chapter standalone + aage ki taraf ishara
when: Long-form ko chapters me baant-te waqt
action: Har section/chapter ko aisa banao ki wo akela bhi samajh aaye, aur uska end hamesha aage ki taraf point kare
why: Standalone chapters beech se ghusne wale viewer ko bhi pakadte hain; forward-pointing end seam ko majboot karta hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Value front-load karo, best part rok ke mat rakho
when: Long-form structure/value placement par
action: Sabse achhi value jaldi do; 'achha part' end ke liye withhold mat karo
why: End tak rokna us viewer ke liye optimize karta hai jo tab tak ja chuka hota hai
frequency: Har video; khaas taur par pehle hisse me
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Short-form: ek idea, payoff jaldi, loop wala end
when: Short-form script banate waqt
action: Ek hi idea rakho, koi setup nahi; opening frame motion jaisa padhe, aur payoff attention decay hone se pehle aa jaye. End wahan rakho jahan se beginning phir sense banaye (loop)
why: Short-form me dhyaan sabse tez girta hai; loop wala end rewatch ko badhata hai
frequency: Har short; duration = jitna lamba near-100% retention hold ho sake (B-053 dekho)
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Shorts me reverse structure: payoff pehle
when: Short banate waqt
action: Pehle payoff dikhao, phir explain karo (reverse structure)
why: Result pehle dekhne se viewer explanation sunne ke liye rukta hai
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: Short ke pehle 3s + aakhri 3s pehle likho
when: Short script/edit shuru karte waqt
action: Pehle first 3 seconds aur last 3 seconds author karo, phir beech bharo; end ko start se loop karo
why: Short ka faisla uske pehle aur aakhri palon me hota hai; loop rewatch ko support karta hai
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: BUTS chain: but = takraav, so = reaction
when: Short ki kahani aage badhane ke liye
action: Har beat ko 'but' (naya conflict) ya 'so' (uski reaction) se jodo — kahani kabhi rukti hui mehsoos na ho
why: Lagatar conflict+reaction narrative tension banaye rakhta hai; viewer ko 'kahani khatam' mehsoos hi nahi hota (Hoyos ki method)
frequency: Har short ke har beat par
evidence_note: creator practice (Jenny Hoyos profile) — creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Foreshadowing hook: pehle second me result ka ishara
when: Short ki opening design karte waqt
action: Pehle second me final result/comparison ka hint do, lekin reveal end ke liye rakho
why: Viewer ko end tak comparison dekhne ke liye rukna padta hai
frequency: Har suitable short ki opening me
evidence_note: creator practice (Jenny Hoyos profile) — creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: End sabse tez emotion par rakho
when: Short/long video ke end par
action: Video ko maximum emotion/climax ke pal par khatam karo; kamzor 'and so…' wala band mat karo
why: Viewer poori video ko aakhri pal ki emotion se judge karta hai (Hoyos); weak ending peeche ka saara kaam kharab karti hai
evidence_note: creator practice (Hoyos + MrBeast profiles) — creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Constant escalation + segment ke beech micro-cliffhanger
when: MrBeast-style long/short structure me
action: Har segment pichle se intensity me aage badhe; segments ke beech internal cliff-hangers rakho aur sabse bada payoff (prize/challenge/result) shuru me hi visible karo
why: Badhti tension aur micro-suspense viewer ko agle segment tak kheenchti hai (MrBeast profile)
evidence_note: creator practice (MrBeast profile) — creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: Slopstudio ka B-045 kehta hai pacing FLAT rakho, escalation nahi. Farak: ye rule kahani ke stakes/intensity ki escalation hai, B-045 cut/WPM pacing ki. Agar dono ek hi lever (cut speed) par lagu hon to takraav hoga — Step 3 (Order) decide karega.

name: Content buckets: pehchan wali recurring series banao
when: Channel/shorts series planning me
action: 3–4 recurring series (buckets) define karo — har bucket ek pehchan wala format; viewer ko pata ho ki use kya milega
why: Ek bucket pasand aane par viewer usi series ki baaki videos dekhta hai; pehchan expectation aur wapsi banati hai (Hoyos)
frequency: Channel level par; har nayi short kisi bucket me
evidence_note: creator practice (Jenny Hoyos profile) — creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Ek video = ek job
when: Video ka brief tay karte waqt
action: Har video ka sirf EK job rakho (awareness / conversion / education / trust aadi); explainer+demo+testimonial+brand ko ek video me merge mat karo
why: Sab jobs ek saath karne wala video koi job achhe se nahi karta — wo documentary ban jata hai, asset nahi
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Video type ke hisaab se beat template use karo
when: Script likhne se pehle type chunne par
action: Explainer (60–90s): Problem→Agitate→Solution→How→Proof→CTA. Demo (2–5m): Hook→Use-case setup→Walkthrough (3–5 features)→Result→CTA. Testimonial (60–120s): Result hook→Before→Decision→After→Endorsement. UGC (15–30s): Hook (1s)→Reveal→Result→CTA. Thought leadership: Specific claim→Framework→Examples→Takeaway→CTA
why: Har type ki proven structure hoti hai; wing karne se pehle 15 seconds me 80% viewers kho sakte ho (source ka daava)
frequency: Har script, type ke hisaab se
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Short infotainment ka emotional arc (0–30s)
when: 15–30s infotainment short banate waqt
action: Setup 0–5s = frustration/recognition ('ye to main hu'); Development 5–15s = ironic escalation (haal aur bhadke); Payoff 15–25s = smart solution/plot twist; CTA 25–30s = soft CTA
why: Pehchan → badhti absurdity → twist ka arc share/save wali reactions (solidarity, 'mujhe ye dikhana hai', 'ye nahi pata tha') ko trigger karta hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Direct-to-camera question hook
when: Short ke pehle 3 seconds me
action: Camera me dekh kar aisa sawal poochho jo target viewer ko turant engage kare (jaise 'How many X did you read this week?')
why: Seedha sawal viewer ko dialogue mode me dalta hai, passive rehne nahi deta
frequency: Hook ki ek technique ke roop me, suitable shorts me
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: 'If…' scenario hook
when: Short ke pehle 3 seconds me
action: 'If…' se shuru karo jo target audience ignore na kar sake ('If you've also spent 3 weeks on…, this video is for you')
why: Apni sthiti ko pehchanne wala viewer turant rukta hai — ye usi ke liye bana lagta hai
frequency: Hook ki ek technique ke roop me, suitable shorts me
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Deliberate boundary = attention reset button
when: Dhyaan reset karna ho — naya section, reveal, topic change
action: Us point par jaanboojh kar ek saaf situation change design karo (jagah, insaan, goal ya cause visibly badle) aur cut exactly usi par lagao — ek brain 'update' kharch ho raha hai, use wahan kharch karo jahan fresh start chahiye
why: Boundary par dimaag purana model band karke naya kholta hai — yahi natural fresh-start moment hai
evidence_note: Boundary responses situation changes se statistically mediated hain (Frontiers 2010 film study)

name: Ek baar me ek hi dimension badlo
when: Boundary banana ho
action: Place, people, goal, cause — ek baar me ek hi dimension badlo; chaaron ek saath badalna hard reset hai, wo climax ya naye chapter ke liye bachao, aadat mat banao
why: Zyada simultaneous situation change = zyada strong boundary response; roz-marra me ye disorientation banta hai
frequency: Har boundary par; hard reset sirf bade moments par
evidence_note: Mediation result 🟢 hai, lekin 'ek baar me ek, baaki bachao' wali dosage editorial inference hai

name: Chunk = ek event
when: Content structure karte waqt — topics, steps, scenes, chapters
action: Har chunk ko exactly ek event banao jiska saaf beginning aur end ho; adha-event ya do-event wala chunk mat banao
why: Viewer ki memory inhi event chunks me store hoti hai — ragged chunks matlab ragged recall
evidence_note: Boundaries baad me yaad rehne wali cheezon ko predict karti hain — memory experiments ka result
conflict_note: Chapters wale rule (C-046) se milta hai — chapter bhi ek event hona chahiye

name: Murch 1 — Emotion sabse upar (51%)
when: Koi bhi cut chunna ho, khaaskar jahan criteria takrate hon
action: Cut pehle is sawal se test karo: 'ye is moment ki emotion ke sach hai? audience ko kya mehsoos karana hai?' Emotion fail ho to cut reject/flag karo — EMOTION CHECK ENGINE KE BAHAR HAI: aise cut ko human check ke liye flag karo, engine khud emotion judge nahi karega
why: Murch ke hisaab se emotion akela (51%) baaki paanch criteria ke kul (49%) se zyada bhaari hai; emotion sahi ho to audience neeche ki khaamiyan notice hi nahi karti
frequency: Har cut par; emotion-veto ke roop me — technically perfect lekin emotion todne wala cut bhi reject
evidence_note: Ek master editor ki craft raay; Murch khud percentages ko 'slightly tongue-in-cheek' kehta hai — koi experiment nahi
conflict_note: User ke order (Kahani > Samajh > Rhythm > Style) me emotion Kahani ke andar band hai; Murch use Kahani se bhi upar rakhta hai — aur is system me emotion insaan ki aankh par hai, engine par nahi

name: Murch 2 — Story aage badhe (23%)
when: Cut ka faisla karte waqt
action: Wahi cut rakho jo kahani ko aage badhaye; jo cut kahani ko roke ya ghumaye, use neeche ke criteria (rhythm/continuity) ke liye mat bachao
why: Story dusra sabse bhaari criterion hai; emotion ke baad yahi cut ki asal justification hai
evidence_note: Craft wisdom, measured nahi (Murch, In the Blink of an Eye)

name: Murch meta — all-six pehle, qurbani neeche se upar
when: Do candidate cuts takrayein aur trade-off majboori ho
action: Pehle wo cut dhundo jo chhah criteria pure kare; na mile to neeche se upar qurbani do: 3-D space pehle, phir 2-D plane, phir eye-trace, phir rhythm, phir story — emotion kabhi nahi. Upar wala criterion neeche wale ke liye kabhi mat chhodo
why: Hierarchy sirf forced trade-offs ke liye hai; Murch: 'never accept less when more is available'
evidence_note: Craft framework; percentages pedagogical device hain, measurements nahi
conflict_note: User ke apne Order (Kahani > Samajh aana > Rhythm > Style/Effect) se qareebi rishta hai, lekin ek farak: Murch Emotion ko Story se strictly upar rakhta hai, user ke order me emotion Kahani ke andar/insaan ke paas hai — Step 3 me ye faisla final hoga

name: Pehle 30 second ki beat structure
when: Long-form video ka opening design karte waqt
action: 0-3s: cold line/clip — promise ya peak moment, koi greeting nahi. 0:03-0:10 (der se der 0:10 tak): title ka promise apni awaaz me restate karo. 0:10-0:18: stakes/obstacle naam karke loop kholo. 0:18-0:28: watch-contract — 'by the end you will...'. 0:28-0:30: body me hard pivot. Pehle 15s me teeno kaam pure hon: click confirm, aisa sawaal jo viewer band na kar paye, payoff ke saboot ki jhalak. Main point ki setup 2-minute mark se pehle screen par ho
why: Pehle 30s retention cliff hai — sabse zyada viewers yahi jaate hain; promise confirm na ho to viewer 0:08 par nikal jata hai
evidence_note: Teenon sources ki beat timings aapas me milti hain (Jake 15s ke 3 kaam, SkillMedev 30s cliff, serge ki beat table) — craft consensus, controlled study nahi
conflict_note: Jake hook ko 15s kehta hai, SkillMedev/serge 30s — takraav nahi: 15s hook ka core hai, 30s puri beat structure; dono is rule me jode gaye hain

name: Hook ko score karo — weakest property fix karo
when: Hook finalize karne se pehle
action: Har hook ko 5 properties par 0-100 score karo: Specificity, Address, Stakes, Curiosity, Brevity. Verdict = 60% mean + 40% sabse kamzor property. Sabse kamzor property ko fix karo (specificity kam = adjective hata ke number/naam/date; address kam = pehle 6 shabdon me 'you'; stakes kam = lagat naam karo; curiosity kam = khud jawab dene wala hissa kato; brevity kam = saans rukne wali jagah par roko). Low score = dobara dekho; high score = vaada kabhi mat samjho
why: Ek dead property wala hook usi property par leak karta hai; average use chhupa deta hai — isliye weakest-link weighting
frequency: Har hook par, recording se pehle
evidence_note: hookscore.py 74 real short-form hooks par calibrate hua (top-8/bottom-8 by views, 5 channels); kharab hooks ko asli se alag karta hai, lekin ek hi creator ke hits vs misses ko mushkil se alag karta hai — isliye 🟡, 🟢 nahi

name: Hook variants banao, test karke chuno
when: Kisi video ka hook tay karte waqt
action: Ek hook par mat ruko: long-form ke liye 5 hooks likho, score karke top 2 rakho aur dono dikhao; kam se kam 3 variants, har ek alag formula se, taaki A/B test ho sake aur pattern seekha ja sake. Sabse badhiya hook pehla draft lagbhag kabhi nahi hota
why: Variants ki tulna hi asli pasand batati hai; ek hook dena = andaza lagana
evidence_note: Dono sources ki workflow rule; koi measurement nahi

name: Cold-open payoff tease — result pehle, setup baad me
when: Video me ek dramatic moment/result maujud ho (build, transformation, reveal)
action: Sabse dramatic moment ya result ka 3-8 second ka flash sabse pehle dikhao, phir setup par cut karo — viewer wahan tak kaise pahunche, ye dekhne ke liye rukta hai. Tease kiya moment asal me video me hona chahiye aur intezaar ke layak bhi
why: Destination pehle dikhane se dheema hissa bik jata hai; setup par wapas cut hi khula loop hai
frequency: Har suitable video par ek baar, opening me
evidence_note: serge Y8 + Jake ke 'The Reveal' formula + SkillMedev Before/After — craft pattern

name: Vaada imandari — title/hook ka promise pehle 30s me cash ho
when: Title, thumbnail aur hook finalize karte waqt
action: Title/hook jo promise kare, video ka pehla hissa use imandari se pura kare — hook us payoff se zyada mat wada kare jo video de sakta hai. Inflate kiya hook ek view kharidta hai aur channel ka bharosa kharch karta hai; tez click-away ranking penalty hai
why: YouTube satisfied watch-time optimize karta hai: CTR x retention; over-promise wala click fast bounce me badalta hai aur modest title se zyada mehnga padta hai
evidence_note: serge ke heuristics YouTube ke public Creator Insider statements par adharit synthesis hain; baaki do sources bhi yahi rule dete hain

name: Promised artifact 20 second ke andar screen par
when: Hook/title ne koi cheez dikhane ka vaada kiya ho (prompt, screenshot, result, tool)
action: Wo artifact 20 second ke andar screen par dikhao. Reveal 8 minute par rakha to 1 minute par retention cliff pakka hai
why: Vaada kiya saboot jaldi na mile to hook clickbait padhta hai
evidence_note: hooks.json ki rule; craft heuristic

name: Turn (0:15-0:45) — ek sentence me plan
when: Hook ke baad body shuru hone se pehle
action: Ek sentence me batao video kya karne wala hai, aur karna shuru kar do. Channel intro, 'before we get started', subscribe pitch — kuch nahi; yehi 0:30 cliff ki sabse aam wajah hai
why: Viewer ko roadmap milta hai bina waqt kharch hue; throat-clearing sidha drop-off hai
evidence_note: yt-script ki structure rule

name: Har beat: mini-hook + delivery + bridge (loop zinda)
when: Long-form body ko 3-5 beats me structure karte waqt
action: Har beat ke teen hisse rakho: shuruaat me mini-hook (is beat ka micro-promise), phir point ki delivery, phir bridge jo agle beat me ek loop khole. Kisi bhi pal kam se kam 1 open loop zinda rakho
why: Bina bridge ke beats 'and then' ki chain banti hai; khula loop hi viewer ko agle beat tak kheenchta hai
frequency: 3-5 beats per video; har pal ≥1 loop zinda
evidence_note: SkillMedev youtube-script-writer ki architecture rule

name: Midpoint par re-engagement trigger
when: Video ke beech wale beat par
action: Beech me jaanboojh kar ek re-engagement trigger lagao — 'but here's the thing' jaisa mod ya stakes-raise — kyunki midpoint cliff ke baad dusra sabse bada drop-off hai
why: Unstructured body beech me ek-ek karke viewers kho deti hai; midpoint ka mod curve ko dobara uthata hai
frequency: Har long-form video me ek baar, midpoint par
evidence_note: SkillMedev ki craft claim; drop-off ranking ka koi cited dataset nahi

name: Payoff over-deliver karo — bonus insight lazmi
when: Video ka ending/payoff likhte waqt
action: Payoff hook ke vaade se zyada de: har beat ka takeaway ek sentence me recap karo, phir ek bonus insight do jo hook me zikr hi nahi tha. Yahi surplus santusht viewer ko subscriber banata hai aur end-screen retention uthata hai. Abrupt end mat karo — outro bhi retention signal hai
why: Promise se zyada milna hi 'satisfied watch' hai jise ranker optimize karta hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev ki payoff rule; Jake bhi payoff ko explicitly deliver karne ko kehta hai

name: Ek hi CTA — ek hi ask
when: Video ke close par
action: Sirf EK specific ask rakho, video ke topic se juda (jaise 'pricing script neeche link hai'). Subscribe-like-comment-bell ki string kabhi nahi; generic subscribe ask bhi nahi
why: Kai asks dhyaan baant dete hain; ek topic-specific ask convert karta hai
evidence_note: Teenon sources ki shared rule

name: Shorts spoken hook 12 shabdon se kam
when: Short/Reel/TikTok ka spoken hook likhte waqt
action: Spoken hook line 12 shabdon ke neeche rakho — lambi line speaking pace par 3-second window se aage nikal jati hai. Line ek specific claim kare, vague nahi
why: Short-form me pehle 3 second hi poora audition hai; har shabd ko apni jagah kamani padti hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev video-hook-writer ki hard limit
conflict_note: Long-form hook ke liye band 9-24 shabd hai (C-024); Shorts par ye sakht limit jeetegi

name: Short ke liye self-contained 20-55s moment
when: Long video se Short kaatna ho
action: Sirf wahi 20-55 second ka span chuno jo: (1) complete thought se khule (pehli line ko pichla minute na chahiye ho), (2) usme ek turn ho (claim, phir use complicate/prove karne wali cheez), (3) ek line par khatm ho, trail-off par nahi. Short ke liye NAYI pehli line likho (purani line context maangti hai jo is viewer ke paas nahi) aur score karo
why: 'Best moment' ka clip aksar context ke bina marta hai; survive wahi karta hai jo akele khada ho
frequency: Har candidate Short par teeno shartein lazmi
evidence_note: yt-shorts ki selection rule

name: Paach-beat spine (demo/launch videos)
when: Demo, announcement ya launch video plan karte waqt
action: Paach beats is order me rakho: Hook (pehle 3s — result/tension/claim, logo NAHI) → Problem (ek concrete dard) → Reveal (cheez kaam karti hui) → Proof (asli number/before-after, invented metric kabhi nahi) → CTA (ek action, ek URL). Beat sirf wajah ke saath drop karo; hook ke baad order mat badlo. Lambi walkthrough me Reveal+Proof har feature par repeat hota hai, Hook/Problem/CTA ek hi rehte hain
why: Ye order viewer ke faisle ki seedhi hai: rukna, dard pehchanna, jawab dekhna, yakeen karna, kadam uthana
evidence_note: SkillMedev video-storyboard ki spine rule

name: Scene order causality par — therefore/but, and-then nahi
when: Beats/scenes ka order tay karte waqt
action: Har beat pichle se caused ho aur agle ko cause kare — 'therefore / but' ki chain banao. 'And then, and then' wali chain sagging story ki structural nishani hai; sag ko naye events jod kar mat sudharo, connectives dobara banao
why: Causality hi woh cheez hai jo sequence ko kahani banati hai; bina uske beech hamesha sag karega
evidence_note: SkillMedev story-structure-architect ki diagnostic rule (fiction se aayi, video structure par lagu)

name: Load-bearing turns ki jagah (percentages)
when: Lambi kahani/format ki macro structure banate waqt
action: Bade turns ko in hisson ke aas-paas rakho: inciting incident pehle 10-12% ke andar; first-act break / point of no return ~20-25%; midpoint ~50% (reversal jo stakes uthaye aur goal ko recontextualize kare — sirf time mark karne wala midpoint sag ki jad hai); all-is-lost ~75-80%; phir climax aur resolution. First-act break 30% ke paar ya midpoint 60% ki taraf sarka ho to interrogate karo
why: Ye jagahen darshak ki umeedon ki ghadi se mili hui hain; mod der se aaye to beech ka hissa dheela padta hai
evidence_note: Percentages guides hain, law nahi — source khud kehta hai; screenwriting craft convention
conflict_note: Video par ye percentages seedha copy karna Step 3 me tay hoga — short/mid-form par ye scale badal sakta hai

name: Setups aur payoffs ka audit
when: Structure deliver/final karne se pehle
action: Har payoff (twist, reveal, capability, object) ki list banao aur confirm karo wo pehle fairly plant hua hai — telegraph kiye bina. Har prominent setup ko dekho: ya payoff kare ya cut ho. Bina chalayi banduk (loaded gun) mat chhodo; bina plant kiya payoff kahin se mat lao. Coincidence protagonist ko museebat me daal sakta hai, use bacha kabhi nahi sakta
why: Unplanted payoff dhokha lagta hai, unpaid setup jhoothi ummeed; dono bharosa todte hain
frequency: Har structure par, delivery se pehle ek pass
evidence_note: story-structure-architect ki diagnostic checklist

name: Tension curve — chadhai ke saath jaanboojh ki ghaatiyan
when: Poori video/kahani ki tension map karte waqt
action: Tension ko beat-by-beat upar chadhate hue rakho, beech me saans ke liye deliberate valleys ke saath. Flatline = sag; shuru me hi max out = aage chadhne ki jagah nahi. Do paas wale beats ek hi intensity par hon to ek ko vary ya reorder karo; har bada turn pichle se zyada stakes uthaye
why: Curve hi viewer ki urja ka budget hai; ek-jaisi intensity aadat (habituation) ban jati hai
frequency: Har structure par ek diagnostic pass
evidence_note: story-structure-architect ki tension diagnostic; Cutting ke waves (C-002) se taal-mel hai lekin ye kahani-level par lagta hai, shot-level par nahi

name: Thesis-breakdown format (runtime ke hisse)
when: Expert talking-head monologue ko format karte waqt
action: Runtime ko in hisson me baanto: 0-8% Hook (sawaal wala hook title), 8-13% Rebuttal (kata hua shabd/mithak), 13-23% Cause (thesis card), 23-38% Mechanism (diagram), 38-54% Breakdown (ek-ek karke bullets), 54-64% Turn (saaf speaker — saans ki jagah), 64-77% Consequences, 77-86% Climax (pull quote + maximum zoom), 86-100% Ending (CTA). 73s ke monologue par validate hua format hai
why: Ye hissa-bandhwari viewer ko har charan par 'main kahan hu' ka jawab deti hai aur climax ke liye jagah bachati hai
evidence_note: blazerior storyboard ki ek video (73s→68s) par validated format table

name: Hafte ka mix — cadence jo 12 hafte chal sake
when: Upload plan/calendar banate waqt
action: Mix stage ke hisaab se rakho: New (0-1k) 1 long-form + 4-5 Shorts; Growing (1k-50k) 1 long-form + 3 Shorts; Established (50k+) 1-2 long-form + 2-3 Shorts. Cadence wahi chuno jo kam se kam 12 hafte nibh sake — consistency volume ko harati hai. Har slot pre-paired ho: format, title angle, thumbnail angle, hook formula, goal (CTR/retention/subscribe — hafta teeno me banta ho, ek hi note nahi), posting window. Shorts ka long-form library se through-line lazmi. Ek anchor video hafte ka kendr, ek cheap video maujud cheez se, Shorts anchor se katein. Week slip ho to Short chhodo, long-form kabhi nahi
why: Shorts reach laate hain, long-form watch-time aur wafadar subscriber; bina through-line ke dono audiences alag marte hain
frequency: Har hafte ke plan par; mix ka review har 4 hafte
evidence_note: serge planner/pillars + Jake yt-plan ki cadence rules; ratios 'reported' starting points hain

name: Community posts — pehli line hook, ek hi ask
when: Uploads ke beech community tab par post karte waqt
action: Pehli line poora hook carry kare (feed truncate karta hai). Ek post = ek clear ask (vote, ek specific comment, ya video dekho) — do asks response baant dete hain. Poll: 2-4 options, mutually exclusive, koi false dilemma nahi. Hafte me 2-4 posts kaafi; lagbhag aadhi posts aane wale/recent video se judi hon (tease ya follow-up). Engagement bait ('comment 1 for yes') banned
why: Community tab between-uploads ka touchpoint hai — channel ko garm rakhta hai aur agle video ke early signals seed karta hai
frequency: Hafte me 2-4; har post par ek ask
evidence_note: serge community-post-writer ki rules

name: Comments se next video — 3+ baar wahi sawaal
when: Comments padh kar content ideas nikalte waqt
action: Comments ko themes me baanto; jo alag sawaal 3 ya zyada baar aaye, wahi next-video candidate hai — use potential title ke roop me naam do. Ek baar aaya comment trend nahi hota. Repeat commenters (superfans) ko naam se reply karo. Critical-but-specific comments sabse kaam ke hain — unhe dabao mat, surface karo. Pin us sawaal ko karo jo sabse zyada logon ka hai, sabse pyaare wale ko nahi
why: Comment section retention surface bhi hai aur demand signal bhi; dohraya sawaal hi sabit demand hai
frequency: Har video ke comments par ek pass
evidence_note: serge audience-insights + Jake yt-comment ki triage rules

name: Repurpose — spine nikalo, copy-paste kabhi nahi
when: Blog/thread/post ko YouTube surface me badalna ho
action: Source ka shell utaaro aur ek claim/story/number (spine) nikalo. Payoff se lead karo — source ka hook lagbhag kabhi survive nahi karta, use dobara likho. Listicle/numbered thread description me chapters ban jata hai (ek item = ek chapter). Off-platform artifacts ('link in bio', hashtag walls, dusri jagah ke @-handles, 'as I posted on...') sab hatao. Source ke claim, facts aur numbers bilkul na badlo — delivery badalti hai, matlab nahi
why: Galat platform ka format YouTube par marta hai; shabdon ko nahi, point ko carry karna hi repurposing hai
evidence_note: serge repurposer ki native-fit rules

name: Outlier research — channel ke apne median ka multiple
when: Niche me 'kya chal raha hai' research karte waqt
action: Videos ko raw views se rank mat karo — har video ko uske APNE channel ke median views ke multiple se rank karo (default threshold 1.5x-2x). Jis channel ke 4 se kam videos jama hon, use skip karo — 1-2 videos ka median, median nahi hota. Har outlier ke title ka formula naam do, lekin yaad rakho: formula TITLE ke shabdon par judgement hai, video ke chalne ki wajah ka dawa nahi
why: Raw views channel ka size naapte hain, idea ko nahi; median-multiple hi video ke baare me sawal ka jawab deta hai
evidence_note: swipe.py ki ranking method; statistical common sense, measured study nahi

name: Peaks ki hifazat — laugh/punchline ke aage reaction tak
when: Comedy/emphasis wale beats cut karte waqt
action: Hansi, punchline aur emphasis beats ko poora rakho; punchline ke aage reaction tak extend karo — hasi hi asal beat hai. Audio events ((laughs), (sighs), (applause)) beats ke signal hain, unke aage bhi badhao
why: Peak ko kaatna video ka sabse keemti pal kaatna hai; reaction bina punchline adhoora rehta hai
evidence_note: video-use cut-craft ki rule

name: Structural archetypes — shape pehle chuno
when: Multi-take/multi-clip video assemble karte waqt
action: Pehle ek archetype chuno (ya material ke hisaab se banao) aur beats usi se rakho: Tech launch/demo: HOOK → PROBLEM → SOLUTION → BENEFIT → EXAMPLE → CTA. Tutorial: INTRO → SETUP → STEPS → GOTCHAS → RECAP. Interview: (QUESTION → ANSWER → FOLLOWUP) repeat. Travel/event: ARRIVAL → HIGHLIGHTS → QUIET MOMENTS → DEPARTURE. Documentary: THESIS → EVIDENCE → COUNTERPOINT → CONCLUSION. Music: INTRO → VERSE → CHORUS → BRIDGE → OUTRO. Beats ko source clip ke order se nahi, beat ke order se jodo
why: Bina shape ke assembly sirf kronologi banti hai; archetype har take ko uski jagah deta hai
evidence_note: video-use editor brief ke archetypes — craft templates
conflict_note: SkillMedev ke 5-beat spine (C-050) se overlap hai — C-050 demo-specific hai, ye general archetype set hai

name: Chapters ke platform niyam
when: Lambi video (tutorial, podcast, explainer, lamba vlog) publish karte waqt, description me chapters likhte samay
action: Pehla timestamp/chapter 00:00 par ho, kam se kam 3 chapters ascending order me, har chapter kam se kam 10 second ka; timestamps edit ke asli times se lo, aankh se naap kar nahi. Har chapter ka title topic-words nahi, us section ka promise ho — 3-5 shabdon me, creator ki awaaz me; jo section 5 shabdon me naam na paye, wo ya do sections hai ya filler hai
why: Ek bhi platform niyam toota to chapter block render hi nahi hota — description me pada reh jata hai; sahi chapters viewer ko apne kaam ke hisse par seedha jump karate hain, wapas aana aasan karte hain, aur retention diagnostic ka kaam bhi karte hain (Guo 2014 me bhi yahi pattern)
frequency: Har long-form video par (Shorts par chapters nahi)
evidence_note: 00:00 / 3+ / 10s YouTube ke apne documented platform rules hain; 3-5 shabd wala promise-title hissa craft hai

name: B-roll exactness: bola wahi dikhe
when: Voice jo naam le use dikhaya ja sakta ho to
action: B-roll/punch wahi cheez literally dikhaye jo boli gayi (spoken noun phrase); exact asset na mile to speaker par hi raho — same-category ki tasveer (kisi bhi darwaze se 'hidden door') fallback nahi, defect hai; photo tabhi jab human-confirmed subject match kare, aur video hamesha photo se pehle
why: Alag ya sajawati visual dhyaan todta hai aur comprehension girata hai; exact visual baat ko pakka karta hai
evidence_note: Mayer (2008, peer-reviewed) ka coherence principle; mktkit ka owner rule ('exact or nothing', 2026-09-07) iska sakht roop hai — woh hissa 🟠

name: Graphic sirf jab samjhaye
when: Koi graphic ya on-screen text jodne se pehle
action: Graphic sirf tab: (1) jo camera nahi dikha sakta woh dikhana ho (concept, comparison, number, timeline, map), ya (2) structure mark karna ho (section title, naam, step counter); jo graphic hatane se kuch na ghate woh hatao; voice ki baat ko text me mat dohrao — text woh ho jo bola nahi gaya (naam, number, key term)
why: Shabd + tasveer saath sikhati hai, lekin bekaar graphic aur dohra hua text dono seekhna aur samajh girate hain
evidence_note: Mayer (2008, peer-reviewed) — multimedia, coherence aur redundancy principles

name: Graphic kabhi khaali nahi, word se bandha ho
when: Koi card, table ya graphic screen par aaye to
action: Graphic use shabd se zyada se zyada 0.5 s pehle enter kare jo use introduce karta hai; pehla content element 1 s ke andar aa jaye; har row/element us shabd ke ≤0.6 s ke andar enter kare jo use naam de; koi card 1 s se zyada khaali na rahe; aakhri phrase ke ~1.2 s baad graphic chala jaye; elements even stagger se nahi, shabdo se bandh kar aayein
why: Khaali frame intezaar karta hua graphic galti lagta hai aur viewer ka dhyaan wahi atakta hai
evidence_note: kmilo house rules (reference tutorial ke pehle cut ki review se bane)

name: On-screen text ka reading-time formula
when: Koi bhi text screen par rahe to
action: Text ki duration = max(1.5 s; words × 0.33 s + 0.5 s) rakho (0.33 s/shabd = 160-180 wpm padhne ki gati); jo label voice ke saath jata hai woh apne shabd ke saath enter kare aur bole jaane ke 0.6 s baad tak rahe — formula se kam kabhi nahi
why: Jaldi gayab text padha hi nahi jata; padhne se pehle use dhoondhne ka bhi samay lagta hai (+0.5 s isiliye)
evidence_note: BBC subtitle guidelines (160-180 wpm) se derived; +0.5 s aur label wala hissa kmilo house

name: Captions ke standard specs
when: Closed captions/subtitles banate waqt
action: ≤42 characters per line, ≤2 lines; reading speed ≤20 characters/s (bachchon ke liye 17); har event ≥20 frames (≈0.83 s); events ke beech gap ≥2 frames; line break punctuation ke baad ya conjunction/preposition se pehle rakho — article ko noun se, pehle naam ko upnaam se kabhi mat todo
why: Ye duniya bhar ke broadcast specs hain — inse tez ya lambe captions padhe nahi jate
evidence_note: Netflix Timed Text Style Guide (platform/broadcast spec)
conflict_note: mktkit vertical (1080 px wide) ke liye 32 chars × 2 lines rakhta hai kyunki wahan 42 fit nahi hota (DCMP Captioning Key bhi 32 kehta hai) — vertical me 32, 16:9 standard captions me 42

name: Caption cue join cross na kare, shabd drop na ho
when: Captions ko edit points ke saath rakhte waqt
action: Cue kabhi edit join ko cross na kare (har spine boundary par cue split karo); rakha hua koi shabd caption se drop na ho; speech agar cut ke 0.5 s ke andar shuru/khatm ho to cue ko cut par hi rakho, cross sirf tab jab speech khud cross kare
why: Join ke paar latka caption galti dikhta hai; range ke aakhir ke chhote shabd clamp me gayab hona ek asal defect raha hai
evidence_note: Netflix timing guide ke shot-change rules (platform spec) + mktkit ka engine-enforced house rule

name: Burned-in social captions ka tareeka
when: Shorts/Reels/TikTok ke liye captions burn karte waqt
action: Captions word-timed rakho; chunk chhota rakho; bola ja raha shabd accent color/highlight me dikhao; badi bold sans-serif, outline ya box ke saath; har page ≥20 frames rahe; jab board wahi shabd dikha raha ho to captions hide karo; numbers ko digits me likho (shabdon me nahi); caption engine ke defaults: min cue 0.8 s, max cue 2.8 s
why: 80%+ viewers muted ya kam awaaz me dekhte hain — wahan captions hi awaaz hain
evidence_note: Creator practice teeno sources me; muted-viewing wala aankda Melvynx shorts-codes ka (80%+)
conflict_note: Chunk size par farak: Melvynx 1-3 words per chunk, kmilo 1-5 words per page — dono chalte hain, ek channel par ek hi style consistent rakho

name: Safe zones: text platform UI se bahar
when: 9:16 video me text, captions ya CTA rakhte waqt
action: Text aur key visuals platform UI bands ke bahar rakho. Universal 9:16 zone: x 9-91%, y 14-86%; hook text y 15-22%; captions/CTA y 78% se neeche nahi; right 14% me kuch zaroori nahi. Pixel hisaab (1080x1920, mktkit): IG/FB top 270 bottom 672, TikTok top 130 bottom 484, Shorts top 180 bottom 350 — kai platforms ke liye sabse sakht intersection lo aur caption MarginV = strictest bottom + 24 px. 1:1/16:9 me text beech ke 80% me rakho
why: UI ke neeche dabaa text padha hi nahi jata — ye retention nahi, seedha samajh ka nuksaan hai
frequency: Har text placement par; check number se karo (text safe jab y ≥14, y+h ≤79, x+w ≤86)
evidence_note: mktkit ke specs Meta/TikTok sourced (platform specs); ExpoCut ke % vendor-measured (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com); Melvynx ke px zones house-measured
conflict_note: Sources ke numbers format aur platform ke hisaab se alag hain: Melvynx px (top 220, bottom 420, right 140 from y900) ExpoCut ke % aur mktkit ke px se thode alag hain — target platforms ka sakht intersection hi surakshit raasta hai

name: Phone par padhai: size aur contrast
when: Koi text screen par aaye to
action: Body text 1080p par ≥40-60 px uncha rakho; contrast ≥4.5:1; video ke upar text ko solid/scrim card ya outline do; label fit karne ke liye font chhota mat karo — label ke shabd chhote karo
why: Chhota ya halka text phone par gayab ho jata hai; jo padha na jaye woh information nahi, shor hai
frequency: Har text par; Melvynx ke floors: UI detail ≥34 px, labels 38-42 px, captions ~84 px
evidence_note: WCAG AA contrast 4.5:1 (WebAIM standard) + legibility.info; px floors creator practice

name: Boards illustrate karein, paraphrase nahi
when: Short me board/visual element lagate waqt
action: Board sirf woh dikhaye jo dikhaya ja sakta hai: number, command, folder, asli logo, before/after, asli screen; bola hua paraphrase karke board mat banao; board par 2-4 shabd se zyada text nahi; teen text-board lagatar nahi; har board theek us shabd par land kare jo use naam de
why: Jo board baat ko dohraata hai woh screen bharta hai, samajh nahi; jo dikhata hai woh baat ko pakka karta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx short-editing style.md ka house rule

name: Tutorial me screen lead kare, voice follow
when: Screen tutorial edit karte waqt
action: Screen jo dikhaye voice wahi kahe, usi pal: phrase tab aaye jab uska action screen par ho; phrase action se lambi ho to result ko usi second par freeze karo; clip kabhi peeche na jaye, na kisi chhode hue clip par wapas aaye
why: Shabd aur tasveer ka saath (temporal contiguity) hi tutorial ko follow karne layak banata hai; aage-peeche hona sabse bada confusion hai
evidence_note: kmilo house rule (reference tutorial review se); peeche Mayer ka temporal contiguity principle (🟢) khada hai

name: Tutorial chapter cards aur edge badge
when: Tutorial ke chapter badlein to
action: Har chapter 3 s ke title card se khule ('Step 2 of 5'), card ka content 0.55 s me enter kare; screen par step ke naam ka edge badge rakho taaki beech me land karne wale ko jagah samajh aaye; chapter ke andar hard cuts hi rakho
why: Tutorial viewers hisse dohraate aur jump karte hain; bade, saaf markers unhe sahi jagah pahunchaate hain
evidence_note: kmilo house rule; Guo 2014 (🟡) ka bade-text-at-transitions wala support

name: Lower third pehli pehchan par
when: Podcast/interview me koi vyakti pehli baar dikhe to
action: Us vyakti ka naam aur role lower third me dikhao, aur lambe break ke baad dobara dikhao
why: Bina pehchan ke viewer baat ko sahi insaan se jod nahi pata
frequency: Har naye speaker ki pehli appearance par
evidence_note: kmilo podcast recipe ka creator practice

name: Auto captions review zaroor karo
when: Publish se pehle captions finalize karte waqt
action: YouTube ke auto captions ko bina review publish mat karo (accent, dialect, background noise se woh speech ko galat dikha sakte hain) — caption file upload karo ya auto wali sudharo; burned-in ho to word-by-word check karo; numbers hamesha video se verify karo
why: Galat caption samajh ko ulta kar deta hai, aur burn ho jaye to galti permanent dikhti hai
evidence_note: YouTube official auto-caption warning (platform) + Melvynx clips ki practical chetaavni

name: Music awaaz se 18-25 dB neeche
when: Bolne ke neeche music lage to
action: Background music ko voice se 18-25 dB neeche rakho (voice -16 LUFS ho to music lagbhag -34/-41 LUFS)
why: Awaaz se ladta music seedha samajh khatm karta hai — viewer shabd pakadne me thakta hai
frequency: Jahan bhi speech ke neeche music hai
evidence_note: Creator source (Pure Audio Insight) kmilo ki tagging me; koi peer-reviewed number nahi
conflict_note: Melvynx ke measured style-copy me ek creator ka beat ~12 dB under naapa gaya tha — woh us style ka naapa hua apvaad hai; aam niyam 18-25 dB hi hai, copy karna ho to original ko naapo (dekho A-091)

name: Ducking: bolte waqt music 6-12 dB dabao
when: Speech ke neeche music chale to
action: Jab koi bole to music ko 6-12 dB duck karo — soft attack 10-50 ms, release 250-700 ms (sidechain compressor, auto-ducking ya keyframes se); Melvynx ke mix defaults: bed -28 LUFS, duck ratio 0.5
why: Ducking se music rehta bhi hai aur shabd saaf bhi rehte hain; bina duck ke ya to music gayab ya awaaz dabti hai
evidence_note: Creator sources (Zella; Auphonic ka official default 18 dB apne tool ke liye hai — isiliye range 6-12 creator wali rakhi)

name: SFX ke level aur jagah ke niyam
when: Sound effect lagate waqt
action: SFX voice se 12-24 dB neeche rakho; effect ka transient visual change se 2-4 frames pehle rakho taaki peak dikhne ke pal mile; key word (number, naam) ke upar effect kabhi nahi; ek hi sound lagatar 3 baar se zyada nahi; jo awaaz asal recording me pehle se kaam kar rahi hai (real click, darwaza) us par effect mat chadhao; gain ke default andaze: SFX ~15 dB, ambience ~30 dB under
why: Galat jagah ya zyada tez effect shabd ko kha jata hai; sahi jagah wala effect dikhne wali cheez ko pakka karta hai
evidence_note: Creator sources (Storyblocks) + kmilo library ke house defaults

name: Master loudness destination ke hisaab se
when: Final master banate waqt
action: Ek hi master, destination ke target par, naap kar (guess nahi): YouTube ke liye -14 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤-1 dBTP; podcast feed ke liye -16 LKFS ±1; dono jagah jana ho to do masters banao; loudnorm two-pass lagao (pehle measure, phir linear apply)
why: Zyada loud ghusane se kuch nahi milta (platform neeche kar dega), bahut kam rakho to padosi videos se halka sunai dega
frequency: Har export par ek master; mktkit apni pipeline me -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP / LRA 11 rakhta hai
evidence_note: Apple Podcasts official spec + YouTube ke measured normalization behaviour + EBU R128 references — platform specs
conflict_note: YouTube target -14 LUFS (kmilo/Melvynx) vs mktkit ka house master -16 LUFS: dono apni jagah sahi hain — mktkit ka tark hai ki -16 wala master platform ke ~-14 normalization par bina limiting artifacts ke pahunchta hai; jo pipeline chuno, ek hi target rakho

name: Room tone har gap ke neeche
when: Recording aur edit dono par
action: Har location par 30-60 s ka room tone record karo; edit me har cut-gap ke neeche wahi bichao — awaaz kabhi digital silence par na gire; room tone na ho to recording ke sabse saaf khaali hisse se copy karo
why: Digital silence dropout jaisi lagti hai aur har cut par background ka jump sunai deta hai
evidence_note: Creator source (StudioBinder) — kmilo ki tagging me creator

name: Dialogue saaf karne ka kram
when: Voice/dialogue clean karte waqt
action: Isi kram me chalo: sabse achha source/mic chuno (jo na bole uske mics mute) → halki noise reduction → high-pass ~80 Hz → EQ (clarity) → compression → de-esser (zarurat ho to) → har clip ka level barabar → aakhir me ek master; har breath mat hatao, awaaz robotic ho jati hai
why: Har kadam pichle ke output par behtar kaam karta hai; ulta kram artefacts banata hai
frequency: Har video ki dialogue processing par
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo audio reference)

name: Gain andaze se nahi, formula se
when: Kisi sound ko voice ke neeche set karte waqt
action: Gain hamesha naap kar nikalo: gain = 10^((voice_lufs − under − sound_lufs)/20), cap 1 par; 'under' ke defaults — SFX 15 dB, music ~20 dB, ambience/room tone ~30 dB; gain 1 se upar aaye to woh sound us kaam ke liye halka hai, dusra chuno, amplify mat karo
why: Andaze wale levels har video me badalte rehte hain; formula har baar wahi rishta deta hai
evidence_note: kmilo house method (library ke measured catalog par chalta hai)

name: Podcast mics: jo na bole uska band
when: Multicam podcast/interview edit karte waqt
action: Jo vyakti nahi bol raha uska mic mute ya gate karo (dusri awaaz late pakad kar echo/phasing na bane); sab speakers ka level ek barabar rakho; music sirf intro, outro aur topic breaks me rakho, baat-cheet ke neeche nahi
why: Khule mics ka echo aur alag-alag levels hi podcast ko sabse zyada 'amateur' sunate hain
evidence_note: kmilo podcast recipe ka creator practice

name: Join fades: cut par click na aaye
when: Talking spine ke segments judte hon to
action: Har kept segment ke join par 0.05-0.08 s ka audio fade rakho
why: Bina fade ke range joins click karte hain — chhoti awaaz, lekin har cut par sunne wale ko khichti hai
evidence_note: mktkit cut-video engine ka rule (reviewer catches se bana)

name: Pehla frame bina awaaz ke kaam kare (1-second rule)
when: Short-form/social video ke pehle frame par
action: Frame one par payoff result, bold caption line, ya subject mid-action dikhao — itna saaf ki bina audio ke 1 second me topic samajh aa jaye (clear text overlay, impactful image, ya immediate action). Black frame, logo sting, slow zoom, slow fade, bina-context talking head, intro/greeting — sab banned. Frame 0 hi thumbnail aur scroll-stopper hai
why: Autoplay muted hota hai aur viewer 1 second me tay karta hai; pehla frame 'kuch hai yahan' kehne me fail ho ya mute par samajh na aaye to scroll/swipe pakka hai (Hoyos ki 1-second rule)
frequency: Har short-form/social video ke first frame par
evidence_note: Creator practice — Jenny Hoyos profile (filnik) + SkillMedev (video-hook-writer, social-video-formatter) aur serge (retention beats) ki shared rule; measured study nahi

name: Text overlay jaldi + har number/naam screen par
when: Edit ke dauraan text overlays lagate waqt
action: Pehla text overlay pehle 10 seconds ke andar lao; aur jo bhi numeric ya named cheez boli jaye (number, stat, key term, naam) use screen par text me dikhao
why: Bole gaye numbers/naam viewer retain nahi karta; screen text samajh aur yaad dono pakki karta hai
frequency: Pehla overlay ≤10s; har key number/stat/term/naam par
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Show, then say — footage bole to jumla kato
when: Script/edit me jahan footage point carry kar sakti hai
action: Jahan footage khud point dikha sakti hai wahan use bolne do aur use samjhane wala jumla kaat do
why: Dikhayi gayi baat boli gayi baat se tez samajh aati hai; dohra explanation samay khata hai
frequency: Har aisi jagah jahan visual available ho
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: B-roll ko apni jagah kamani padegi
when: B-roll chunne/lagane par
action: B-roll sirf wahi lagao jo wo dikhaye jo shabd nahi dikha sakte; decorative B-roll mat lagao — wo 'dead air with pictures' hai
why: Bina kaam ka B-roll samajh nahi badhata, sirf dhyaan ghumata hai aur seam kamzor karta hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: Cadence wale rules (B-055 Craig: B-roll har 30–60s; B-056 Classic: har 5–10s) frequency mangte hain, ye rule relevance mangta hai. Takraav par relevance pehle — cadence ke liye sajawati B-roll mat dalo (Step 3 Order bhi yahi kahega: Samajh > Style).

name: Captions hamesha — shorts aur social par lazmi
when: Har short/social video, aur bolne wale har hisse par
action: Captions hamesha rakho (shorts me captions always); auto-generated captions ko accuracy ke liye review karo
why: Zyada tar social video mute par dekha jata hai (source: 80%+ muted); bina captions ke message pahuchta hi nahi
frequency: Har video, har spoken section par
evidence_note: platform data (80%+ muted viewing, Wistia/Vidyard hawala) + measured corpus (shorts captions always)

name: Script kaan ke liye likho: ek jumla = ek idea
when: Script likhte waqt
action: Har line bol kar padho; ek jumle me ek hi idea; viewer ke liye second person ('you') use karo; jargon ko concrete bhasha me badlo ('workflow automation platform' → 'tool that does X automatically'); jo line comma ke bina na bache use kato
why: Boli gayi bhasha padhi gayi bhasha se alag hoti hai; saaf jumla hi turant samajh aata hai, corporate/press-release awaaz hamesha haarti hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Har line ke saath uska visual jodo
when: Script likhte waqt, har line par
action: Har voiceover line ke saath uska visual pair karo; jis line ka visual soch na sako wo line zyada abstract hai — use dobara likho
why: Bina visual wali line viewer ke dimaag me tikti nahi; visual pairing hi samajh ko anchor karta hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Title front-load + title/thumbnail ek dusre ko dohrayein nahi
when: Packaging (title/thumbnail) banate waqt
action: Title me distinguishing word aage rakho (titles truncate hote hain), specific rakho clever ke upar; thumbnail ka text ~4 shabdon se kam ya bilkul nahi (B-037 dekho); title aur thumbnail EKK hi baat na kahein — mil kar dono se zyada kahein
why: Truncate hone par asal baat kat jati hai; dohra message CTR ka mauka khota hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Thumbnail: ek subject, tez contrast, shabd kam se kam
when: Thumbnail design karte waqt
action: Ek hi subject rakho jo phone-thumbnail size par padha jaye; high contrast; asli chehra (strong emotion ke saath) aam taur par objects se behtar; text ke liye MrBeast data 0–2 words kehta hai, Henterprise 'about 4 words se kam ya none' — 0–2 ko target rakho, 4 se upar kabhi nahi. Thumbnail ko film karne se pehle test karo
why: Thumbnail hi tay karta hai ki video dekha jayega ya nahi; bheed me ek saaf subject hi rukta hai
evidence_note: creator practice (MrBeast profile + producer practice) — creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: Sources ke numbers alag hain: MrBeast profile 0–2 words (sabse zyada views wale), Henterprise 'under about four words'. Rule me bada wala hard cap (4) aur chhota wala target (0–2) rakha hai.

name: Pre-emptive on-screen text: text pehle, awaaz baad me
when: Short ki opening me anticipation banane ke liye
action: On-screen text ko speaker ke bolne se PEHLE lao (jaise '200 resumes. 3 hours. Zero candidates lost.')
why: Pehle aaya text anticipation banata hai — viewer awaaz ka intezaar karta hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Power words pehle 3 second / title / overlay me
when: Short ki hook aur packaging me
action: Power words use karo — Curiosity (secret, hidden, nobody knows), Urgency (banned, last time, before it disappears), Value (free, $1, half price), Exclusivity (for the first time, never seen, sneak peek) — aur ye pehle 3 seconds, title ya text overlay me aayein
why: Ye shabd turant click/watch trigger karte hain (Hoyos ka system)
frequency: Har suitable short ki shuruaat me
evidence_note: creator practice (Jenny Hoyos profile) — creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Retention curve ko order me diagnose karo
when: Published video ki analytics dekhte waqt
action: Is order me check karo: (1) Low CTR → packaging (title/thumbnail). (2) High CTR + pehle 30s me bada drop → hook ne title/thumbnail ka vaada nahi nibhaya, ya start slow hai — opening recut karo, mid-action shuru karo, intro animation/'hey guys' hatao. (3) Steady decline (1–2%/min) → pacing flat hai — visual variety har 15–30s, retention beats har 2–3 min. (4) Beech me 10%+ cliff → exact timestamp pakdo — aam taur par tangent/boring/confusing hissa, transition ya galat jagah sponsor; use kato/restructure karo ya usse pehle re-hook lagao. (5) End drop-off → ending chhota karo, CTA pehle lao. (6) Spikes (retention UPAR) → ye achha hai — wajah pakdo aur use zyada karo. (7) Retention achhi par growth nahi → packaging impressions nahi kama raha ya topic ka audience maujood subscribers se aage nahi
why: Har curve pattern ki wajah aur ilaaj alag hai; bina diagnosis ke edit karna andaz hai
frequency: Har published video ke review par, isi order me
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Refresh trigger: retention 20%+ gire to restructure/replace
when: Purane video ki performance review par
action: Agar retention peak se 20%+ gir jaye to video ko restructure ya replace karo; yahi trigger product UI badalne, testimonial customer churn hone, ya nayi positioning aane par bhi lagu hai
why: Purana pada video audience ko thaka deta hai aur galat/stale message deta rehta hai
evidence_note: house threshold (skill ki quality bar) — creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Safe zone + platform ke hisaab se captions ghumao
when: Vertical video (Reels/TikTok) edit/export par
action: Text/captions safe zone me rakho — Reels: top 250px (username) aur bottom 400px (CTA/comments) se bacho; TikTok par bhi upar-neeche bacho. Cross-post karte waqt subtitles ko har platform ke safe zone ke hisaab se reposition karo aur dusre platform ka watermark kabhi mat rakho (TikTok watermark wali video Reels par nahi)
why: UI ke neeche daba text padha nahi jata; watermark wali cross-post dono platforms par penalize/laggy lagti hai
frequency: Har vertical video, har platform variant par
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Distribution + repurposing plan production se pehle
when: Har video ke brief stage par
action: Pehle tay karo video kahan rahega, kaun dhundhega, aur usse kaun se derivative assets banenge (repurposing matrix: 1 lambi video → clips, quote graphics, blog/transcript aadi). Jo segments akele shorts banke khade hone hain, unhe shoot hi aise karo ki akele khade hon
why: Bina plan ke bana video decoration hai; baad me kaate gaye shorts ko wo context nahi milta jo unhe chahiye
frequency: Har video, brief stage par hi
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Ek shot = ek hi attentional magnet
when: Koi important shot design/select karte waqt
action: Shot ko EK dominant magnet do (face, motion onset, ya bolti awaaz) aur competing motion hatao; do magnets ladenge to synchrony tootegi
why: Dhyaan involuntary roop se motion/face/speech se khinchta hai; do competing cues gaze ko baant dete hain
frequency: Har shot par; khaaskar key beats par sakht
evidence_note: Motion-onset capture aur gaze clustering eye-tracking se measured hai

name: Ek beat = ek idea, on-screen bhi mark karo
when: Body ki beats likhte/edit karte waqt
action: Har beat me sirf ek idea rakho, aur har beat ke saath likho ki screen par kya dikhega — sirf bolta sir (talking head) bina dekhe jaane wali cheez ke podcast hai, video nahi
why: Ek beat me do ideas dono ko kamzor karte hain; visual mark editor ko aur viewer dono ko orientation deta hai
evidence_note: yt-script ki craft rule; SkillMedev ke inline [B-ROLL]/[GRAPHIC] cues bhi yahi kehte hain

name: Narration-action sync — ek instruction, ek action
when: Tutorial/demo ki voiceover likhte waqt
action: Ek on-screen action ke liye ek hi instruction; shabd action ke saath ya ek beat pehle land hon — jo click ho chuka, use narrate mat karo ('ab humne save kar liya' save ke baad dead air hai). Screen par kuch complex ho raha ho to bolna roko aur visual ko saans lene do
why: Viewer ek saath kar bhi raha hai aur sun bhi raha hai; peeche chali narration aur aage badha visual dono ko harate hain
evidence_note: SkillMedev narration-script ki cardinal rule

name: Har step ka shape: Goal → Action → Confirmation
when: Tutorial ke steps likhte waqt
action: Har step teen hisso me rakho: Goal (kya karne wale hain aur kyun), Action (ek concrete instruction), Confirmation (success kaisa dikhega). Steps ke beech halki signposting rakho. On-screen UI labels bilkul wasi bolo jase button par likha hai — button 'New project' kehta hai to 'create a project' mat bolo
why: Shape viewer ko har pal oriented rakhta hai; label mismatch seedha confusion hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev narration-script ki structure rule

name: Likhne ki safaai — em dash aur AI shabdawali ki hadd
when: Koi bhi publish hone wala text (title, description, script, post) likhte waqt
action: Em dash lagbhag 1 per 100 shabd se zyada nahi (title/post me zyada se zyada 1); zyada hon to comma, colon ya line break lagao — period kabhi nahi. AI-vocabulary markers (leverage, significant, streamline, foster...) ek paragraph me 1 hai to English hai, 3 hon to poora paragraph dobara likho; ek-line title me ek bhi marker cluster hai. Sincerity openers ('let me be honest', 'not gonna lie') aur reveal bridges ('here's what nobody tells you') bina dated fact ke banned. Keywords stuff mat karo — asal search phrase ek baar, natural
why: Density hi AI-likhai ki pehchan hai; stuffing ranking nahi deta, spam padhta hai
frequency: Har text par, publish se pehle ek pass
evidence_note: serge bundle ki voice rules — house craft standard

name: Captions ke reading niyam (phrase captions)
when: SRT/VTT caption track banate waqt
action: Cue speech ke saath aaye aur usi ke saath jaye; screen par kam se kam ~1s, zyada se zyada ~7s (lamba ho to baanto). Cue me 1-2 lines, kabhi 3 nahi; ~32-42 characters per line; reading speed ≤ ~17 characters/second (~160-180 wpm) — zyada ho to cue baanto ya duration badhao. Line clause boundary par todo, mid-phrase kabhi nahi. Tutorial ke liye clean captioning: filler ('um', 'uh', false starts) hatao, matlab verbatim rakho; technical terms aur UI labels bilkul sahi rakho. Raw ASR kabhi ship mat karo — galtiyan hamesha sabse keemti shabdon par hoti hain
why: Captions accessibility bhi hain aur muted viewers ko pakadne wala jaal bhi; tez ya galat captions dono kaam kharab karte hain
evidence_note: SkillMedev captions-from-transcript ki line/reading rules — broadcast captioning ke aam standards se milti hui craft values
conflict_note: Ye phrase-caption mode hai; word-level mode ke liye C-077 dekho

name: Sirf word-level verbatim ASR
when: Transcription ka tareeka chunte waqt
action: Hamesha word-level verbatim ASR lo. SRT/phrase mode kabhi nahi (sub-second gap data khota hai) aur fillers ko normalize kabhi nahi (editorial signal khota hai). Transcript pehli aur aakhri line khud padho — Whisper khamoshi par bani-banayi line (fake subtitler credit/outro) hallucinate kar sakta hai, normal confidence ke saath
why: Cut ke saare faisle gap aur word timing par tikke hain; phrase data unhe andaze me badal deta hai
evidence_note: video-use Hard Rule 8 + blazerior ki hallucination chetaavni (troubleshooting #17) — dono production pipelines ka sabak

name: Self-eval gate — output ko har cut par check karo
when: Render ke baad, user ko dikhane se pehle
action: RENDERED output (sources nahi) par har cut boundary ke ±1.5s window me dekho: visual discontinuity/flash, waveform spike (bacha hua audio pop), overlay ke peeche chhupa subtitle, galat frames dikhata overlay. Saath me pehle 2s, aakhri 2s aur 2-3 midpoints sample karo (grade consistency, subtitle readability). Kuch fail ho to fix → re-render → re-eval; zyada se zyada 3 passes — uske baad bachi khamiyan user ko flag karo, loop mat chalao
why: Apna output khud verify kiye bina dikhana aadhi galtiyon ko user tak pahuncha deta hai
frequency: Har render par, dikhane se pehle
evidence_note: video-use process step 7 — workflow rule, ek production pipeline ki aadat

name: Visual change ki cadence (short-form)
