when: Short-form (TikTok/Reels/Shorts) edit karte waqt
action: Har kuch seconds me screen par kuch badal ho — baseline: 5 s ke andar kam se kam ek visual change (cut, punch-in, overlay, B-roll, text swap); ExpoCut ki kasauti: koi bhi 5 s ka window bina change ke = swipe risk
why: Short-form me rukti hui screen hi swipe ka sabse seedha karan hai
frequency: Pacing offsets: Melvynx har 2-4 s, ExpoCut har 3-5 s, mktkit har 3-7 s (pehle 5 s me aur tight), trend/entertainment me cuts 0.5-1 s
evidence_note: Teeno sources creator playbook/house numbers hain (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com — ExpoCut ka hissa)
conflict_note: Cadence ke numbers sources me alag hain — Melvynx 2-4 s, ExpoCut 3-5 s, mktkit 3-7 s; content type faisla kare (samjhane wala dheema, entertainment tez), lekin 5 s se upar kahin bharosa nahi

name: Film se pacing ka benchmark
when: Kisi bhi format ka shot length sochte waqt
action: Reference rakho: aaj ki filmein ~4-5 s average shot length par chalti hain; dialogue wale hisse isse lambe, action wale chhote; apne format ka pacing isi ke aas-paas napo, usse bad-zada tez mat karo
why: Ye das saal ke data ka pattern hai — viewer's aankh is cadence ki aadi hai
frequency: Sirf benchmark; koi sakht target nahi
evidence_note: James Cutting (2011) — peer-reviewed film data (kmilo me 'study / official' tag)
conflict_note: Ye film ka naapa hua average hai, short-form ke liye target nahi — wahan cadence A-051 wali hi chalegi

name: Type ke hisaab se shot lambaai
when: Har segment ka shot length tay karte waqt
action: Talking head: 2-5 s per shot; verticals: 2-3 s per shot, 4 s se upar kabhi nahi, aur text wala shot kam se kam ~2 s; tutorial: shot ≥5 s; vlog: clock se nahi, event ke hisaab se kato (ek kaam = ek block)
why: Har format ki samajh-gati alag hai — tutorial ko sochne ka samay chahiye, vertical ko nahi
evidence_note: kmilo creator reference (type-wise shot lengths)

name: Explainer ke pattern interrupts
when: Lambe explainer/talking video me dhyaan bachana ho to
action: Pehla pattern interrupt (angle, B-roll, graphic, zoom) 25-35 s ke andar laao, phir har 2-3 minute me ek; micro-hook (caption, question, tease) isse ghana rakho
why: Bina badlaav ke dhyaan sabse tez yahi girta hai — interrupt ek nayi shuruaat jaisa kaam karta hai
frequency: Pehla ≤35 s par; phir 2-3 min ke antar par; micro-hook har 30-90 s
evidence_note: Creator source (air.io) kmilo me; micro-hook ke numbers TubeBuddy/vidIQ ke alag-alag reports hain
conflict_note: Micro-hook interval par sources aapas me takrate hain — TubeBuddy 30-60 s kehta hai, vidIQ 60-90 s; dono creator reports hain, koi pakka number nahi

name: Phrases ke beech ka gap
when: Dead air/silence hatate waqt
action: Phrase gaps type ke hisaab se rakho: talking head 200-400 ms, Shorts 200-300 ms, tutorial ≥0.4 s (3 s bina voice = warning, 6 s = hard cap jab tak screen khud na samjhaye); saans ki jagah puri tarah zero mat karo — gap hamesha kuch rakho
why: Saans hi bolne ko insaani banati hai; gap type ke samajh-waqt ke barabar ho to edit natural lagta hai
evidence_note: Creator/house numbers teeno sources se (kmilo, Melvynx pauses.json defaults, mktkit engine defaults)
conflict_note: Numbers style ke hisaab se bahut alag hain: Melvynx ka super-fast style sirf 30-80 ms saans rakhta hai (sentence .08, comma .05, word .03); mktkit engine defaults talking 0.40 s, manifest 0.85 s; ExpoCut silence removal me min gap 450-500 ms + 80 ms padding (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com) — ek channel par ek style pakdo

name: Har cut ke paas reason ho
when: Koi cut lagane se pehle
action: Cut tabhi jab woh ek kaam kare: (1) dead time hataye, (2) information badle, ya (3) action ko follow kare; word ke beech me cut kabhi nahi
why: Bina reason ke cut viewer ko jhatka deta hai; reason wala cut dikhai hi nahi deta
evidence_note: kmilo house rule (yeh editor test); YouTube official bhi 'cuts that do not serve a purpose confuse viewers' kehta hai

name: Cut motion/action par — action shuru hone ke just baad
when: Kisi action/movement ke beech cut lagana ho
action: Match-on-action: cut us pal ke just BAAD lagao jab action shuru ho chuka ho (darwaza khulna, haath uthna) — movement cut ko dhak deta hai aur motion onset aankh ko cut ke paar le jata hai. Movement shuru hone se pehle ke dead moment me cut mat lagao; gesture ya blink ke beech me bhi cut mat karo
why: Aankh movement ko follow karti hai; cut natural attention shift ka kaam karta hai — motion onset gaze ko naye shot me carry karta hai aur cut invisible ho jata hai
evidence_note: Eye-tracking studies me measured aur replicate hua result; AToCC (Tim Smith) isi par bana peer-reviewed theory hai; kmilo editing reference me bhi yahi creator practice ke roop me hai

name: J/L cuts scene badlaav naram karne ke liye
when: Scene ya speaker badle aur transition kathin lage to
action: Agli awaaz ko tasveer se pehle aane do (J cut) ya pichli awaaz ko tasveer badalne ke baad rehne do (L cut); offset kuch frames se ~2 s tak; tutorial me inka istemal kam
why: Awaaz ka nirantar flow scene ka badlaav mehsoos hi nahi hone deta
frequency: Scene/speaker changes par zarurat ke hisaab se
evidence_note: Creator source (TechSmith) — offset ke liye koi pakka number source nahi deta

name: Jump cuts ka sahi istemal
when: Single-camera talking head se filler hatana ho to
action: Jump cuts hi sahi tareeka hain; inhe naram karne ke liye alternate cut par punch-in ya B-roll cover lagao; interview/multicam me jab asli angle maujood hai to jump cut kabhi nahi; subject ko mid-gesture me pakde hue mat chhodo
why: YouTube khud tight talking head ke liye jump cuts ki salah deta hai; bina cover ke lagatar jump cuts kathin lagte hain
frequency: Har take me filler positions par
evidence_note: YouTube official recommendation (platform) + kmilo creator refinements

name: Pacing varied rakho, metronome nahi
when: Poori edit ka rhythm banate waqt
action: Tez hisso ke baad wohi lamba hold rakho jahan key point land karta hai; ek hi scene ke andar bhi sabse dheemi animation sabse tez ki ~3 guna ho sakti hai; har cheez ko ek hi gati par mat chalao
why: Ek-si gati thoda samay baad sunai/dikhai dena band ho jati hai; contrast hi dhyaan banata hai
evidence_note: kmilo creator rules + motion-principles reference

name: Cuts music ki phrase par
when: Music ke saath edit karte waqt
action: Cuts aur loops music ki phrases par rakho, mid-note par nahi; video ka ant music ke asli ending ya saaf fade par ho; foreground music (music video/promo) me key cuts downbeat par rakho; music-led video me cuts beats par rakho
why: Phrase ke beech kata music bina bole hi galat lagta hai; phrase par kata hua mehsoos hi nahi hota
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo music reference; ExpoCut ke music-beat cuts iske saath — Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com)

name: Punch ki hadd: lambaai, doori, ginti
when: Talking reel me visual punch (clip/still/board/super) lagate waqt
action: Clip punch <3.0 s rakho (zyada lamba = woh cutaway ho gaya); still punch 3.5 s; super wala segment 3.5-4.0 s; do punches ke beech A-roll ≥3.0 s rakho, warna punches ko butt karo; punches ≤10/min; stills ≤2 per reel aur lagatar kabhi nahi; still apne noun ke 0.3 s ke andar shuru ho, clip punch ki window 0.8 s
why: Bina hadd ke punches poori reel ko shor bana dete hain aur punch ka matlab hi khatm ho jata hai
frequency: Har reel par (yeh mktkit ke QA gates se enforce hote hain)
evidence_note: mktkit owner/reviewer ke khade kiye hue rules (asal reviewer catches se bane)

name: B-roll ki ginti (paper-stage shorts)
when: Short ke liye B-roll lagate waqt (Melvynx system)
action: B-roll zyada se zyada har 8-15 s me ek, 2-5 s ka; do B-roll ke beech ~5 s creator screen par; clip tabhi jab image sentence se fit ho; achha hit na mile to board ya creator hi rakho, random clip kabhi nahi
why: Har doosri line par clip pura lagne ki jagah pura hi bekaar lagta hai; kam aur fit B-roll hi premium feel deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx shorts broll house rules
conflict_note: mktkit ke punch system me punches 10/min (har ~6 s) tak ja sakte hain — woh talking-reel ka alag system hai; ye 8-15 s wali cadence paper-stage shorts ki hai; format ke hisaab se chuno, dono ko mat milao

name: Retakes aur false starts hatao
when: Talking footage ki pehli safaai karte waqt
action: Har line ka aakhra complete attempt rakho; false starts, half-words, 'uh', off-script awaazein ('wait, redo that') drop karo; chhupe retake ke nishan pehchano: 0.6 s se lamba koi shabd, bola hua phrase dohraaya, ya be-matlab shabd
why: Retake wali gandagi hi raw footage ko amateur banati hai; saaf spine ke bina koi style kaam nahi karta
frequency: Har take par, style se pehle
evidence_note: Melvynx script-first pipeline ka house rule + kmilo retake rules

name: Podcast me camera jo bole us par
when: Multicam podcast/interview cut karte waqt
action: Jo bol raha hai uska close-up rakho; speaker badle to badlaav ke ek beat baad cut karo; reaction shot sirf tab jab woh kuch kahe; wide shot shuruaat, topic change aur cross-talk ke liye rakho; timer par angle kabhi mat badlo; lambi monologue me close/medium/wide ya punch-in ghumao
why: Camera speaker ko follow kare to baat-cheet dekhna aasan hota hai; timer wale cuts nakli lagte hain
frequency: Poore episode par; koi pakki frequency nahi — speaker changes hi trigger hain
evidence_note: kmilo podcast recipe; source khud kehta hai iske liye koi authoritative frequency number nahi hai

name: Hard-out hamesha shabd ke end par
when: Clip ya reel ka ant tay karte waqt
action: Video ka end hamesha aakhri rakhe hue shabd ke END par rakho; ant kabhi SRT cue ke end se mat nikalo (wah aadha sentence late ho sakta hai)
why: Cue timing aur asli awaaz ka end alag hote hain — galat ant par video latka hua ya kata hua lagta hai
evidence_note: mktkit cut-video engine ka rule (asal defect se bana)

name: Tutorial shots aur speed
when: Tutorial edit karte waqt
action: Shots ≥5 s rakho; navigation, clicks aur results 1x par; typing zyada se zyada 1.5x; dead time ko speed se nahi, clean cut se hatao; app ki apni animation (modal khulna, loading) ke beech cut mat karo; form kabhi screen par kata hua mat dikhao (submit sirf clicked state me)
why: Tutorial ka kaam follow karwana hai — tez ya kata hua step viewer ko kho deta hai
evidence_note: kmilo house rules (reference tutorial review se)

name: Bolne ki gati type ke hisaab se
when: Script ki lambaai aur pace tay karte waqt
action: Technical/tutorial narration 120-150 wpm rakho; short script ka default pace ~160 wpm; script ki lambaai shabdo ki ginti ko pace se bhaag de kar napo (bole hue runtime ke hisaab se likho)
why: Gati hi samajh ka samay deti hai; tez script bechne me bhi aur samjhane me bhi haarti hai
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo pacing + Melvynx script-length defaults)

name: Short ki lambaai ke targets
when: Short-form video ki lambaai tay karte waqt
action: Targets rakho lekin idea ko lambaai tay karne do, platform ki max ko nahi: TikTok entertainment 21-34 s (educational 60-90 s), Shorts 15-30 s, Reels 7-15 s punchy ya 30-60 s value; Melvynx ke naape hue hits 25-40 s aur 30-60 s aam range hai, 45 s se neeche completion behtar
why: Jo lambaai idea se zyada hai woh completion% gira kar video ko dabati hai
evidence_note: Creator guidance (ExpoCut playbook — Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com; Melvynx ke measured ranges)

name: Lambe content ko 6 min ke blocks me baanto
when: Lamba educational content banate waqt
action: Content ko 6 minute se chhote blocks/chapters me baanto; lambi process ho to ek step = ek video rakho
why: Measured data (6.9M sessions) me 6 minute ke baad engagement girna shuru hota hai — chhote blocks wale videos zyada dekhe jate hain
frequency: Har lambe video ki planning par
evidence_note: Guo et al. 2014 — edX ke 6.9 million sessions ka measured study

name: Verify loop: dikhane se pehle filmstrip check
when: Render ya delivery se pehle
action: Poori video ko filmstrip/contact sheet par check karo: pehle 3 s (hook frame 0 par padh sakte ho?), poori lambaai (koi 5 s window bina change ke to nahi?), text ke safe-zone numbers (y ≥14, y+h ≤79, x+w ≤86); mktkit ka machine QA gate pass karo; render se pehle stills par iterate karo — stills seconds me bante hain, renders minutes me
why: Jo galti sheet par dikh jati hai woh publish ke baad pakadne se sasti padti hai; aadha kaam yahi pakda jata hai
evidence_note: Teeno sources ke house QA workflows (ExpoCut SVR loop — Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com; mktkit gate; Melvynx stills rule)

name: Pattern interrupt har 15–30s (CraigHewitt wala cadence)
when: Long-form main content ke edit par
action: Viewer ka dhyaan har 15–30s reset hota hai — itne gap ke andar kuch visual zaroor badlo: cut, angle change, text overlay, B-roll, zoom ya SFX. Koi frame 30s se zyada static na rahe
why: Autopilot par gaya viewer chala jata hai; regular pattern interrupt use jagaye rakhta hai (editor ka anubhav)
frequency: Har 15–30s kam se kam 1 visual change; static frame max 30s
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: ⚠️ Seedha takraav slopstudio ke B-045 se: wahan measured corpus me pacing FLAT mili aur pattern interrupt sirf ~1 per ACT hai, per minute nahi. Dono rules rakhe gaye hain — Step 3 (Order) me faisla hoga ki kis format/genre par kaun sa jeetega.

name: Pacing FLAT rakho, interrupt ~1 per act (slopstudio wala cadence)
when: Long-form (10–55 min) explainers ke edit par
action: Per-minute pacing poori video me flat rakho — words aur cuts kisi minute me decay na hon, beech saggy na ho, end par frantic ramp bhi nahi. Pattern interrupt sirf ~1 per act rakho (skit/prop/gag/location change), per minute wala interrupt mat lagao. Consistency escalation se jeet-ti hai
why: Measured corpus (5 top explainers, 54 min tak ki videos) me pacing flat mili — yahi invariant tha, cut count nahi
frequency: ~1 pattern interrupt per act; har minute ka pacing lagbhag ek jaisa
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers
conflict_note: ⚠️ Seedha takraav CraigHewitt ke B-044 se: wahan interrupt har 15–30s manga gaya hai. Dono rakhe gaye hain — Step 3 (Order) decide karega (genre/format ke hisaab se alag jeet sakte hain).

name: Visual floor = perceived motion, cut count nahi
when: Long-form edit ki review par
action: Cut count ka koi fixed number mat rakho (corpus range 2.8–7.5 cuts/min — koi invariant nahi). Asli floor: screen par kuch relevant hamesha MOVING ho — footage/diagram ke neeche floating host, in-shot animation (bars bharna, typewriter), ya bare host ke peeche ambient-motion backdrop. Static host + static frame >~15s = violation; 30–50s ka ek shot sirf tab bachta hai jab in-shot animation ya high narrative tension use uthaye
why: Naapa gaya invariant motion hai, cuts ki ginti nahi; ruka hua frame hi asal retention hole hai
frequency: Har shot par; static host+frame ~15s se zyada nahi (animation/tension exception ke saath)
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: Hook/fast sections me visual change har 3–5s
when: Video ke hook (0:00–0:30) aur fast sections me
action: Har 3–5s me cut/B-roll/zoom/angle/text me se kuch badlo; pehle 15s me text overlay, zoom aur B-roll — teeno ki high density rakho. Classicchins ki general rule bhi yahi hai: static talking head har 3–5s me todo
why: Shuruaat ki energy spoken hook ke barabar honi chahiye; static head sabse tez viewers khota hai
frequency: Hook section me har 3–5s; hook ke pehle 15s me teeno interrupts
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: Slopstudio ke measured cold open (B-048) me pehle 30s me sirf 2–7 cuts hain — ye usse tez hai. Aur shorts ke liye B-053 (2–4s) isse bhi tez hai. Format ke hisaab se alag number — Step 3 me saaf hoga.

name: Measured cold-open density: pehle 30s me 2–7 cuts
when: Long-form cold open ki review par
action: Pehle 30 seconds me 2–7 cuts rakho (aur words 65–98, dekho B-006); isse tez काटना measured corpus ke pattern se bahar hai
why: Top explainers ke naape gaye cold opens isi band me hain — tez hona hi retention nahi hai
frequency: Har long-form cold open; cuts 2–7 per first 30s
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers
conflict_note: CraigHewitt/Classicchins ka B-047 hook me har 3–5s change mangta hai (30s me 6–10 changes) — ye measured band (2–7 cuts) se upar ja sakta hai. Dono rakhe hain; Step 3 faisla karega.

name: Section ke hisaab se pace badlo
when: Long-form ke sections (Setup/Main/CTA) par
action: Setup (0:30–2:00): medium pace, cut har 5–10s, context ke liye text overlay aur referred situations ke liye B-roll. Main (2:00–8:00): content ki energy ke hisaab se pace. CTA/Outro (aakhri 30–60s): medium-to-slow, winding down, end screen overlay + final text reinforcement
why: Har section ka kaam alag hai; ek jaisa pace sab jagah galat hai
frequency: Setup me cut har 5–10s; outro aakhri 30–60s medium-slow
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Edit ki energy = content ki energy
when: Poori video ke pacing decisions par
action: Edit rhythm ko content ki natural energy se milao — slow reflective pal par tez cuts/zooms mat lagao, high-energy listicle par dheela pace mat rakho. Pace ko deliberately vary karo: uniformly intense video utna hi thakane wala hai jitna flat video
why: Contradiction wala edit viewer ko khichta hai; har jagah ek jaisi intensity thakan ban jati hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Dead air aur filler beherahmi se kato
when: Edit par, khaaskar pehle 30 seconds me
action: 'Ums', pauses, throat-clearing, repeated points aur tangents kato. Silence >1s kato (exception: intentional dramatic pause + dramatic visual). Pehle 30s me har pause/restart/filler BINA exception kato; baad me thodi breathing room chalegi — relentlessly tight edit thaka deta hai. Poori video ka total unintentional dead air <5s rakho
why: Dead air retention ka dushman hai; lekin saans ki jagah marna bhi delivery ko synthetic/thakane wala banata hai
frequency: Silence >1s = cut; first 30s zero tolerance; total dead air <5s
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: Filnik ke performance rule (B-071) me 1–2s ki jaan-boojh wali khamoshi 'extremely powerful' kahi gayi hai. Takraav nahi hai agar pause INTENTIONAL ho aur visual use uthaye (CraigHewitt khud yahi exception deta hai) — bina wajah ki khamoshi hamesha kategi.

name: Narration 160–195 WPM band me rakho
when: Long-form narration/voiceover par
action: Narration speed 160–195 WPM rakho (energetic, rushed nahi). <150 WPM sirf dense math/technical beats ke liye rakho — purana 130–150 default is genre ke liye zyada dheema hai
why: Paanchon measured reference videos isi band me mile; dheemi narration pacing ko saggy banati hai
frequency: Har minute 160–195 WPM (flat pacing ke saath, B-045)
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: Shorts cadence: cut har 2–4s, VVSA target 70–90%
when: Shorts (portrait, natural-rate speech) par
action: Cut har 2–4s rakho; har 20s me 6–12 visual changes; captions hamesha (B-033). Target VVSA (viewed vs swiped-away) 70–90%. Short ki length wo rakho jahan tak near-100% VVSA hold ho — 30s ki cap mat lagao. (Filnik ki post-production checklist bhi fast cuts har 2–4s kehti hai.)
why: Shorts ka algorithm swipe-away se darta hai; naapi gayi cadence aur VVSA band top shorts ke pattern hain
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers + Filnik practice checklist

name: Long-form APV target 40–55%
when: Long-form ki performance target/review par
action: Average Percentage Viewed ka target 40–55% rakho (≥50% = A-grade). Raw minutes nahi, percentage + hook ko optimize karo
why: Lambi video ka asal score uska dekha gaya hissa hai; percentage hi formats ke beech tulna ke layak hai
frequency: Har long-form video ka target APV 40–55%
evidence_note: measured reference corpus (5 top explainers, 246k–1M views) se nikale gaye numbers

name: Long-form B-roll/screen-share cadence (CraigHewitt)
when: Long-form talking-head edit par
action: B-roll insert har 30–60s me kam se kam ek baar aaye; aur har 2 minute me kam se kam ek B-roll segment ya screen share zaroor ho
why: Lambi talking-head monotony retention ko dheere-dheere khaati hai; regular visual break use rokta hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: Classicchins ka B-056 marketing videos ke liye B-roll har 5–10s mangta hai — ye usse kahin dheema hai. Farak format ka hai (lamba talking-head vs chhota marketing video); B-032 ka relevance gate dono par lagu rahega.

name: Marketing video me B-roll har 5–10s (Classicchins)
when: Chhote marketing/social videos ke edit par
action: Har 5–10s me B-roll lao — screen recording, stock footage, chart/animation/data-viz, ya customer/team photo
why: Chhote format me dhyaan ka cycle tez hota hai; regular visual badlav hi pace banata hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: CraigHewitt ka B-055 long-form ke liye 30–60s ka gap deta hai — format ke hisaab se alag number. B-032 (relevance gate) dono par lagu: cadence ke liye bekaar B-roll nahi.

name: Music change = tonal shift ka signal
when: Major section transitions par
action: Music sirf major section transitions par badlo, taaki wo tonal shift ka signal bane
why: Music ka badlav viewer ko bina kahe batata hai ki kahani naye hisse me gayi
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Retention beat par visual punctuation
when: Script ke har retention beat par (aur steady-decline fix me har 2–3 min par)
action: Retention beat aate hi visual punctuation lagao: zoom + text overlay + brief pause ka combo
why: Beat ka kaam viewer ko phir jodna hai; sirf shabdon se wo jod kamzor padta hai
frequency: Har retention beat par; steady decline dikhe to beats har 2–3 min par rakho
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: CTA/Outro ghatao: CTA segment aakhri 5–10s
when: Video ke end par
action: Outro ko winding-down rakho — end screen overlay + final text reinforcement. CTA (logo + URL + clear CTA visual) aakhri 5–10s me aaye. Agar end drop-off dikhe to ending aur chhota karo aur CTA ko pehle le aao, aur end screen content ko tease karo ('Before you go — the next video I'd recommend is…')
why: Content 'khatam' mehsoos hote hi viewer CTA se pehle nikal jata hai; chhota outro aur specific CTA use rokta hai
frequency: CTA aakhri 5–10s; outro total ~30–60s se zyada nahi
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: End screen tab rakho jab retention 70–80% ho
when: MrBeast-style videos ke end par
action: Video ko aakhri second tak high attention par rakho aur end screen us point par rakho jahan retention 70–80% ke aas-paas ho
why: End screen tabhi kaam karta hai jab viewer wahan tak ruka ho; tez retention wala end next video ka click lata hai (MrBeast profile)
frequency: Har aise video ke end par; target retention-at-end-screen 70–80%
evidence_note: creator-reported retention practice (MrBeast profile) — measured claim creator ki taraf se, independent study nahi

name: Platform duration windows (Reels/TikTok)
when: Short-form ka format chunne par
action: Reels: optimal 15–30s (reach ka sweet spot), max recommended 60s, 9:16, 1080×1920. TikTok: optimal 15–45s, max recommended 60s (is content type ke liye), 9:16
why: Har platform ka dhyaan window alag hai; sweet spot se bahar ki length distribution ko nuksan karti hai (playbook ke numbers)
frequency: Har short, platform ke hisaab se
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: ASL modern band me rakho
when: Fast-paced popular-format video ki shot planning/cutting par
action: Average shot length lagbhag 3-6 second ke band me rakho; isse kahin lambi stretches modern audience ko slow/old lagti hain
why: Cutting ke 150-film corpus (1935-2005) me ASL ~15s se ~3.5s tak gira aur hit films isi band ki taraf evolve hui
frequency: Poori video ka average is band me; individual shots isse bahar ja sakte hain
evidence_note: Measurement 🟢 hai (peer-reviewed corpus), lekin 'is band se retention badhega' ek inference hai, A/B test nahi

name: Metronome cut kabhi nahi, lehren (waves) banao
when: Consecutive shots ki length sequence set karte waqt
action: Shot lengths ko fixed beat par mat rakho; paas wale shots ek jaise lambai ke hon, lekin sequence me chhote shots ke clusters bade stretches ke andar neste hue waves (1/f jaisi rhythm) banein
why: Modern films ki shot-length sequence human attention ke natural 1/f fluctuation pattern ki taraf evolve hui hai
frequency: Poori video par lagu; lambi ek-jaisee length wali run = violation
evidence_note: 1/f pattern corpus me measured 🟢 hai; use editing rule banana application-level inference hai

name: Climax par shots chhote, payoff ke baad lambe
when: Sequence apne climax/payoff ki taraf badh rahi ho
action: Payoff ke paas jaate jaate shots progressively chhote karo aur motion badhao; payoff ke baad shots lambe karo taaki moment land kare
why: Cutting ke 'evolution of pace' pattern ke mutabiq films climax ki taraf pace accelerate karti hain
frequency: Har bade payoff/climax par ek baar
evidence_note: Ye pattern sirf search-result abstract me dikha, paper full nahi khula — UNVERIFIED-in-full, isliye pakka 🟢 nahi

name: Cutting speed ki ceiling — re-fixation ka waqt do
when: Cutting rate bahut tez ho jaye (action montage, intensified style)
action: Itna tez mat kato ki viewer do cuts ke beech dobara fixate hi na kar paye; us point ke aage slow karo ya ek shot hold karo — zyada cuts wahan excitement nahi, fatigue aur habituation dete hain
why: Hyper-fast cutting me gaze centre-frame par jam jati hai, arousal flatten ho jata hai aur viewer bore hota hai (Smith ki Bond/Bay analyses)
frequency: Jab bhi cutting rate extreme ho; lambe tez sequences par khaas dhyaan
evidence_note: Centre-fixation collapse measured observation hai; 'fatigue/boredom' wala nishkarsh Smith ki apni interpretation hai
conflict_note: Tez-cadence wale dusre rules (jaise pattern interrupts) se takraav ho to ye ceiling jeetni chahiye — Step 3 confirm kare

name: Cut situation-change par lagao
when: Situation badle — nayi location, naya goal, naya character interaction me aaye, nayi cause/topic shuru ho
action: Cut exactly us boundary par lagao; wahan cut invisible lagta hai kyunki dimaag waisi hi apna event model update kar raha hota hai
why: Dimaag experience ko events me baant ta hai; boundary prediction fail hone par mehsoos hoti hai aur fMRI responses exactly unhi palon par aate hain
evidence_note: EST: Psychological Bulletin theory paper + film par fMRI study (n=24, The Red Balloon) — converging evidence

name: Mid-event flow ki hifazat — be-wajah cut nahi
when: Situation wahi hai, event chal raha hai, prediction smoothly chal raha hai
action: Bina wajah ke mid-event cut mat lagao; aisa cut viewer ko ek model-update par majboor karta hai jo use chahiye hi nahi tha — jolt/error jaisa lagta hai
why: Jab kuch nahi badla, dimaag ka event model stable hai; zabardasti ka cut usi stability ko todta hai
evidence_note: Segmentation automatic hai aur passive viewing me bhi hoti hai — behavioural + fMRI evidence
conflict_note: Pattern-interrupt rules (C-033/C-034) se satahi takraav hai; interrupt ek deliberate design hona chahiye, aadat nahi

name: Murch 3 — Rhythm sahi pal par (10%)
when: Cut ka exact pal chunna ho
action: Cut us pal par lagao jo rhythmically 'sahi' lage — na jaldi, na der; rhythm story aur emotion ke neeche hai, unke upar kabhi nahi
why: Rhythm teesra criterion hai; top-3 (emotion+story+rhythm) aapas me gehri tarah jude hain
evidence_note: Craft wisdom; rhythm ka hona measured hai (Cutting/Smith) lekin ye weight Murch ki raay hai

name: Hook ki lambai 9-24 shabd
when: Spoken hook line likhte waqt
action: Hook line 9-24 shabdon ke band me rakho — ~150 wpm par ye 10 second ke andar boli ja sakne wali lambai hai. Isse chhoti = signal kam, lambi = saans aur dhyaan dono khatm
why: hookscore.py ka brevity band calibrated hooks ke data se aaya hai
evidence_note: 74-hook calibration set se derived band hai
conflict_note: Shorts ke spoken hook ke liye SkillMedev ki limit aur sakht hai (<12 shabd, C-037) — Shorts par wahi jeetegi

name: Pattern interrupt har 90-120 second
when: Long-form body chalte waqt
action: Har 90-120 second me ek pattern interrupt lagao: naya camera angle, bold on-screen graphic, rhetorical question, ya chhoti story. 150 wpm par ye har 225-300 shabdon me ek hai. Script me [PATTERN INTERRUPT] flag karo taaki editor use jaanboojh kar lagaye, accident se nahi
why: Ek jaisi presentation par dhyaan decay hota hai; interrupt attention reset karta hai
frequency: Har 90-120s; poori video me barabar phaila hua
evidence_note: SkillMedev ki timing rule; koi measured study cited nahi
conflict_note: Isi cluster ke CraigHewitt (cluster B) wale 15-30s cadence se ye bahut dheema hai, aur slopstudio ke flat-pacing se tez — Step 3 is takraav ka faisla karega

name: Har section break par re-hook
when: Long-form me natural section break aaye; khaas taur par 30-60s ke aas-paas
action: Har section break par chhota re-hook lagao: aane wali cheez ki ek-line tease ('lekin teesri wali ne asal me numbers hilaye'), ya pattern interrupt (B-roll cut, location change, on-screen callout), ya ek chhota payoff bump jo curve uthaye. 30-60s ke paas ek re-hook lazmi rakho
why: Retention sirf pehle 30s me nahi rehta; flat/rising curve suggested placement dilata hai
frequency: Har section break par; 30-60s par ek pakka
evidence_note: serge retention-beats ki rule
conflict_note: C-033 (har 90-120s interrupt) se sambandhit hai lekin placement logic alag hai — ye waqt par nahi, section boundaries par lagta hai

name: Loop design jaanboojh kar chuno
when: Short-form video ka ending design karte waqt
action: Teen me se ek loop type chun kar design karo: seamless (last frame = first frame — position, scale, color same), hook-back (aakhri line/visual viewer ko shuruaat par wapas bheje), ya hard stop (puri kahani ke liye saaf CTA end card). Loop apne aap par mat chhodo
why: Feed turant replay karta hai; deliberate loop muft ka extra watch-time hai aur loop-through Shorts ka sabse mazboot signal mana jata hai
frequency: Har Short par ek type, jaanboojh kar
evidence_note: SkillMedev social-video-formatter + serge Y10 + Jake yt-shorts (loop point) — teenon sources

name: Dead air trim — gap beech se, saansein bacha kar
when: Transcript se edit decision list banate waqt
action: Spoken cues ke beech floor (default 0.45s) se bade gaps ko BEECH se trim karo — dono taraf breath bache (floor/2 each side). Speech se chipka kar cut karne se take gasping lagta hai
why: Dead air pacing ko marta hai, lekin zero-breath cut bhi unnatural lagta hai; beech se trim dono bacha leta hai
frequency: Har gap > 0.45s par (floor badla ja sakta hai)
evidence_note: deadair.py ka default floor aur trim logic — tool author ki craft setting
conflict_note: Pause ke teen alag model is cluster me hain: ye (floor + beech-trim), blazerior ka remainder 0.2-0.3s (C-072), pifferologo ke silence thresholds + padding (C-091/C-092) — Step 3 me ek model final hoga

name: Filler-only cues hatao
when: Transcript clean karte waqt
action: Jo cue sirf filler hai ('um', 'so yeah', 'basically', 'you know') use poora hatao — wo koi information nahi deta
why: Filler-only hissa sirf runtime aur susti badhata hai
evidence_note: deadair.py ki FILLER category
conflict_note: Dhyaan: filler HATAO sirf jab cue sirf filler ho; bolne ki natural texture bachane wali baat dusre cluster (PandaStudio) me hai — takraav Step 3 dekhega

name: Retake/restart pehchano aur kato
when: Ek hi sentence dobara shuru hui ho
action: Restart ko pichle ASAL speech cue se compare karo (beech wala 'um' cue asli pichla nahi hota); pehle 5 shabd match hon to pehli koshish hatao, dusri rakho
why: Zyada tar retakes ke beech ek filler hota hai — literal pichle cue se compare karne se wo miss ho jate hain
evidence_note: deadair.py ki REPEAT detection logic

name: Retention diagnosis — leak, cliff, slide alag ilaaj
when: Publish hue video ki retention report padhte waqt
action: Teen problems ko alag pehchano: HOOK LEAK (pehle 30s ka nuksan; 25% se kam = healthy; ilaaj hamesha pehli 15s ki script hai, edit nahi), CLIFFS (ek tez drop = ek moment — bina signpost ka topic change, sponsor read, lamba setup; transcript se dekho wahan kya kaha ja raha tha), SLIDE (beech ka steady bleed = pacing; ilaaj cutting hai, rewriting nahi). Sabse bada ek leak naam karke ek hi badlav batao
why: Teeno ke kaaran aur ilaaj alag hain; galat diagnosis galat fix deta hai
evidence_note: retention.py ke thresholds (25%/40% bands, 0.8% cliff) tool author ke heuristics hain, published study nahi

name: Bolne ki raftaar budget — 150 wpm
when: Script ki lambai aur beat ki timing tay karte waqt
action: Script ko 150 words per minute par budget karo; instruction/narration ke liye band 140-160 wpm hai. Har beat ke shabd uske time budget se zyada na hon — 8 second ka beat ~20 shabd hai, 50 nahi
why: Isse tez bolna follow karne walon ko peeche chhod deta hai; budget hi beat sheet ko sach banata hai
evidence_note: Dono sources ka shared convention (Jake runtime estimate, SkillMedev beat sheet + narration pace)

name: Scene-type ke hisaab se duration
when: Storyboard me har scene ki lambai tay karte waqt
action: Scene type se duration do: Hook/title card 2.5-3.5s; Text statement 2.5-4s (padhne ki speed ~2.5 shabd/sec — 7-shabd line ko ~3s chahiye); UI/product demo 4-6s (aankh ko dwell time chahiye); Proof/data 3-5s; Logo/CTA outro 2.5-4s. Hook sabse tez cut, Proof sabse slow. Total lamba ho to ek scene KATO — har scene ko speed up mat karo, rushed video nervous lagta hai
why: Alag scene types ko alag samay chahiye; flat ek-jaisa pacing slideshow banata hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev video-storyboard ki duration table (30fps par)

name: Cut phrase ke end par, stopwatch par nahi
when: Talking-head footage cut karte waqt
action: Pauses kato, ideas kabhi nahi. Cut hamesha phrase ke end par lagao; 'har N second me cut' wala stopwatch tareeka ideas ko beech se kaat deta hai. Jahan subject move kar raha ho wahan cut mat lagao — majboori ho to us pal ko infographic card se dhako
why: Talking-head me har sentence matlab uthata hai; aggressive cutting logic ko tod deta hai
evidence_note: blazerior pipeline ki cutting rules — asal builds par seekhi hui
conflict_note: pifferologo ke word-boundary rule (C-090) se milta hai lekin alag hai: ye phrase-level craft hai, wo word-level technical correctness

name: Har pause ka 0.2-0.3s bacha kar rakho
when: Pause trim karte waqt
action: Har pause ka 0.2-0.3 second hissa rehne do. Pause ko zero par collapse karna stutter jaisa sunai deta hai
why: Bolne ki natural saans hi take ko insaani rakhti hai; poori tarah chipka hua speech ghut ta hai
evidence_note: blazerior ki build-tested rule
conflict_note: Jake ke dead-air model (floor 0.45s, beech se trim, ~0.225s har taraf) se talab mel khata hai; pifferologo ke padding (30-200ms) aur silence thresholds (≥400ms clean) se numbers ki bhasha alag hai — Step 3 me ek model bane

name: Dramatic pause ko haath mat lagao
when: Sawaal ke baad ya conclusion se pehle wala pause dikhe
action: Use trim hi mat karo — wahan khamoshi hi kaam kar rahi hai (tension, ummeed, wazan)
why: Dramatic silence retention ka hissa hai, dead air nahi; use kaatna moment ko halka kar deta hai
evidence_note: blazerior ki do jagah dohraayi hui rule
conflict_note: Dead-air rules (C-042/C-092) ka ye jaanboojh kiya exception hai — engine ko dramatic pause pehchanna hoga ya human flag lagega

name: Panel rhythm — 2-8 second per panel
when: Storyboard ke panels ki timing tay karte waqt
action: Panel 2 second se kam aur 8 second se zyada na rakho — kam me padha nahi jata, zyada me wallpaper ban jata hai. Panels ke beech 0.3-1s saaf frame chhodo, warna wo aapas me ghul jate hain. Ek minute ke video me 8-12 panels. Ek hi panel type back-to-back kabhi nahi (list ke baad list = ek lambi text wall)
why: Panel screen ki state hai; uski umar hi padhne aur bore hone ke beech ki lakeer hai
evidence_note: blazerior storyboard ki rhythm table

name: Har segment boundary par 30ms audio fade
when: Segments jodte (concat) waqt
action: Har segment ke shuru aur aakhir par 30ms ka audio fade lagao (afade in/out, d=0.03). 20ms se neeche click bachta hai, 50ms se upar audio sunai dene wala dip aata hai
why: Waveform ko zero-crossing se door kaatna click paida karta hai; fade use khamoshi se mita deta hai
evidence_note: Do sources ka ek hi number (pifferologo Hard Rule 3 + blazerior troubleshooting #12) — dono ke asal builds par fix hua technical rule

name: Shabd ke beech me cut kabhi nahi
when: Koi bhi cut edge tay karte waqt
action: Har cut edge ko transcript ke word boundary par snap karo. Shabd ke beech ka cut hamesha kharab lagta hai aur timing data use nasht karta hai
why: Cut ki sabse chhoti sahi ikai shabd hai; isse neeche jaana guesswork hai
evidence_note: video-use Hard Rule 6 — technical correctness rule

name: Cut edge padding 30-200ms ki window
when: Har cut edge ko final karte waqt
action: Har cut edge ko 30-200ms ke beech pad karo. ASR (Scribe) timestamps 50-100ms drift karte hain — padding wahi drift socheta hai. Fast-paced ke liye tight, cinematic ke liye loose. Shipped example: pehle rakhe shabd se 50ms pehle, aakhri ke 80ms baad
why: Bina padding ke drift shabd ke kinare kaat deta hai; zyada padding pacing dheeli karti hai
evidence_note: video-use Hard Rule 7 — ek proven video par shipped values; window house standard hai
conflict_note: Pause models ka takraav C-042/C-072 me note hai — ye padding cut EDGE ki hai, pause ki lambai ki nahi; Step 3 teeno ko ek saath rakhega

name: Silence ke cut thresholds (400 / 150 / 150)
when: Silence gaps ko cut candidates ke roop me judged karte waqt
action: Silence ≥400ms = aam taur par sabse saaf cut jagah. 150-400ms wale phrase boundaries visual check ke saath usable hain. <150ms = unsafe (mid-phrase hone ka khatra), wahan mat kato
why: Silence ki lambai hi batati hai ki wo phrase boundary hai ya shabd ke andar ki rukawat
evidence_note: video-use cut-craft ke numbers — ek production pipeline ke tested thresholds

name: Speaker handoff me 400-600ms hawa
when: Ek speaker se dusre speaker par cut ho
action: Do utterances ke beech 400-600ms ki hawa rakho. Fast-paced me kam, cinematic me zyada — ye taste call hai, lekin zero hawa hamesha galat hai
why: Handoff par saans hi 'ab dusra bol raha hai' ka signal hai
evidence_note: video-use cut-craft ke common values

name: Animation ka payoff bolne wale shabd par land kare
when: Narration ke saath overlay sync karte waqt
action: Payoff shabd ka timestamp nikalo aur overlay ko reveal_duration pehle shuru karo, taaki landing frame bilkul us shabd par aaye. Bina is sync ke animation bolti baat se kata hua lagta hai
why: Drisht aur shabd ka ek pal par milna hi 'ye isi ke liye bana tha' wala ehsaas hai
evidence_note: video-use ki payoff-timing rule
conflict_note: blazerior ke graphic timing (shabd se pehle card — cluster B) se sambandh Step 3 dekhega

name: Punch-in sirf motivated, hadd ke andar
when: Talking video me zoom/punch-in lagane se pehle
action: Zoom sirf us detail, reaction ya usi line par rakho jis par voice baat kar rahi hai; talking-head punch-in ka scale 110-120% rakho (source resolution ke andar hi, soft frame crop nahi); Melvynx ke naape hue limits: punch-in har ~4 s se zyada baar nahi, ≤1.15x, agle cut tak hold, ek hi shot me in aur out dono nahi; zoom cut ko kabhi cross na kare; screencast me do zooms ke beech 5-7 s ka gap
why: Bina wajah ka zoom sabse pehchani jaane wali amatuer harkat hai; wajah wala zoom dhyaan ko sahi jagah le jata hai
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo; Envision ke screencast numbers) + Melvynx measured style-copy ke exact numbers
conflict_note: ExpoCut cadence ke saath har 2nd ya 3rd cut par punch-in ki salah deta hai (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com) — ye kmilo/Melvynx ke 'sirf motivated' niyam se takrata hai; entertainment short me cadence wali chal sakti hai, samjhane wale content me motivated wali hi surakshit hai

name: Snap punch-in ki technique
when: Punch-in lagate waqt (ExpoCut tareeka)
action: Zoom ko ramp mat karo — do hold keyframes lagao (jaise scale 1.0 se 1.1), cut par alternate karo; agar settle chahiye to easeOut key rakho aur 400 ms baad scale 1.0 wapas karo
why: Ramp wala zoom dheere-dheere ghista hua lagta hai; snap cut jaisa saaf lagta hai
frequency: ExpoCut style wale har punch-in par
evidence_note: ExpoCut playbook ki technique (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com)

name: Entrances aur exits ki timing
when: Koi element screen par aaye ya jaye to
action: Cards/headlines 0.35-0.6 s ease-out me enter karein (bounce nahi), rows 0.3 s; exit hamesha entrance se chhota (0.25 s); elements 20-40 px offset aur opacity ke saath slide-in karein; Melvynx ka niyam: exit entrance se chhota rakho (.26 s smoothstep), theek 0 par khatm karo — spring wala exit ghost chhodta hai; springs kabhi overshoot na karein
why: Yahi chhoti timings 'professional' aur 'PPT jaisa' ke beech ka farak hain
evidence_note: kmilo motion reference (Material Design ke UI numbers 225/195 ms sirf reference ke roop me) + Melvynx reads ke measured exits

name: Bounce, elastic aur emoji nahi
when: Animation style ya visual language chunte waqt
action: Serious content par bounce/elastic easing kabhi nahi (sirf halka overshoot promotional CTA par chal sakta hai); ye bilkul mat use karo: pulse, bounce, elastic, overshoot, glow, shake, spin, confetti; beat ko emoji se illustrate mat karo — motion design, asal logo ya typography use karo
why: Ye effects video ko sasta aur baccho jaisa dikhate hain; ek forbidden cheez poora premium feel tod deti hai
frequency: Har project par (style system me band)
evidence_note: kmilo forbidden list + Melvynx motion rules — dono house style

name: Ek moment, ek hi accent color
when: Board ya graphic design karte waqt
action: Kisi ek pal me screen par sirf ek accent color rakho; dusra accent kabhi na aaye
why: Do accents ek saath ladte hain aur design ka focus khatm ho jata hai
evidence_note: Melvynx design system ka rule

name: Har beat action, khadi tasveer nahi
when: Koi beat banate waqt
action: Har beat kuch karta hua ho — screenshot, still illustration, akela logo ya text card screen par 'baitha' rahe to woh beat redo hai; screenshot sirf reference hai — UI ko recreate karke animate karo
why: Ruki hui screen hi short ko marta hai; action hi premium motion ka ehsaas deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx short-editing style.md ka rule

name: Hero then place; ek idea ek tableau
when: Naya object screen par laate waqt
action: Naya object pehle bada aur center me dikhao (scale 1.3-1.7), phir apni jagah (slot) me glide karo, aur agla item aane se pehle use land kar do; ek idea ke saare sentences ek hi tableau par badhte rahein — board har 1.5-2.5 s tabhi badlo jab speech ka idea badle; board ≥3 s hold ho to .025 ka slow push-in rakho
why: Bade pehle dikhne se aankh samajhti hai kya aa raha hai; tableau badalte rehne se viewer har baar nayi jagah seekhta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx style.md hero-then-place aur tableau rules

name: Asli logos hi, nakli kabhi nahi
when: Screen par kisi tool/product ka naam aaye to
action: Us tool ka asal logo/icon rakho (press kit, App Store listing ya official site se); letter glyph, emoji ya look-alike kabhi nahi; logo na mile to creator se file mango, khud mat banao
why: Nakli logo ek jhalak me pakda jata hai aur poori video ki credibility gira deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx style.md logo rule

name: Layout teen tarah ka ghumao
when: Short ka layout banate waqt
action: Teen views ghumao: split (paper/board upar, camera neeche — aam), paper-only (bada moment: key number ya screen), full camera (story, emotion, punchline, CTA — ≥5 s ke stretches); proof (paper) aur face (full camera) ko alternate karo taaki aankh ko aaram mile
why: Ek hi layout poori video me monotonous lagta hai; layout ka badlaav hi bina effect ke variety deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx edit skill ke teen layouts

name: Hook ka visual ek mini-story ho
when: Hook ka visual design karte waqt
action: Hook ka visual 2-3 acts ki mini-story ho — reversal ke saath, kai layers saath move karein, har keyword par impact (stamp + thud) aaye, aur payoff badge ki tarah land kare; ek object rakh kar use slide kar dena kaafi nahi
why: Hook ka visual hi pehle 2 s me 'ye alag hai' ka saboot hai; sust visual vaade ko khokhla kar deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx hook-design reference (house craft)

name: Music bed emotion se chuno, dohrao mat
when: Short ke liye music bed chunte waqt
action: Bed ko hook ke emotion se chuno; busy ya dynamic track voice ke neeche kabhi mat rakho (aise tracks test me reject ho chuke hain); pichle short me use hua bed is short me dobara mat use karo
why: Galat bed poori video ka mood ulta kar deta hai, aur dohraaya bed 'wahi purana' ka ehsaas deta hai
frequency: Har short par nayi bed chuno
evidence_note: Melvynx music defaults aur test-rejected tracks ka house record

name: Music ka offset payoff par land karana
when: Track ko timeline par rakhte waqt
action: Bade payoff ko track ke kisi mazboot pal par land karana ho to offset = c − P rakho (jaise full section payoff par aaye, usse pehle 10-20 s ka break pocket ho); full-camera emotional line ke liye offset = brk − E; aam default: offset = a point (10 s ki intro skip, pulse frame 1 se); offset + lambaai kabhi track ke 'out' pal se aage na jaye
why: Track ka sabse mazboot pal video ke sabse mazboot pal par mile to dono ek dusre ko uthate hain
evidence_note: Melvynx edit plan ke music rules (reads se naape gaye a/b/brk/c points)

name: Movement shor nahi, sirf payoff hits
when: Sound design/hits lagate waqt
action: Thud sirf number land/die hone par, pop sirf asal arrival par rakho; ek aam short me music ke alawa 2-4 sounds hi rakho; entrance clicks, whooshes aur risers copy ya add mat karo (riser bhi shor hai — sirf hit bache); bundled hit gains: impact-boom −8 dB, zhhh −6 dB, riser −12 dB (voice ke neeche)
why: Har harkat par awaaz lagane se awaaz ka matlab khatm ho jata hai; kam aur sahi jagah wale hits hi mehsoos hote hain
frequency: Har short par 2-4 sounds (music se alag)
evidence_note: Melvynx style-steal learnings (galat copies ko reject karke bane house rules)

name: Color grade ka kram aur shot matching
when: Color correction/grade karte waqt
action: Isi kram me chalo: pehle normalize (log ko delivery color space me) → exposure scopes se set karo → white balance → scene ke saare shots ko hero shot se match karo (consistent grade hi sabse bada professional farak hai) → look/LUT aakhir me, sirf normalized footage par; skin tones ka red/green ka santulan mat bigado; screens aur graphics ko kabhi grade mat karo
why: Galat kram me grade karne se har shot alag lagta hai aur look footage ko tod deta hai
evidence_note: kmilo color reference (creator practice) + Melvynx grade system ka ek hi kram

name: Transitions ke matlab
when: Do shots ke beech transition chunte waqt
action: Har transition ka apna matlab rakho: cut = nirantarta (continuity), dissolve = samay/jagah/topic ka badlaav, fade to black = ek block ka ant; Premiere ka default dissolve 1 s hai — use tabhi rakho jab badlaav asal me ho; flashy transitions (spin, glitch) har cut par kabhi nahi
why: Har cut par flashy transition dhyaan ko kahani se hata kar khud par le jata hai
evidence_note: Creator source (StudioBinder) + Adobe official docs

name: Thumbnail ke niyam
when: YouTube thumbnail banate waqt
action: File 1920×1080 JPG, 2 MB se kam; text 1-5 shabd (ideal 3-4) heavy sans-serif me, ~180 px par padh sakne wale; thumbnail title ko repeat na kare — use complement kare; ek hi dominant subject, 2-3 elements se zyada nahi; bottom-right corner khaali rakho (duration wahan aata hai); thumbnail jo vaada kare woh video ke pehle 30 s me milna chahiye
why: Mobile feed me thumbnail chhota dikhta hai — wahan padh sakne wala, ek-subject wala design hi click lata hai, aur jhootha vaada retention ko marta hai
evidence_note: YouTube official spec (1920×1080, <2 MB) + creator testing ke legibility numbers

name: Title ki lambai (≤100 chars) aur front-loading
when: Video ka title likhte/finalize karte waqt
action: Title 100 characters ke andar rakho (hard cap); sweet spot 40-60 rakho aur click decide karne wale shabd SABSE PEHLE (colon se pehle) — desktop search ~60 par aur mobile home feed ~40 par truncate karta hai, mobile truncation subject ko hi kaat sakta hai. Search video ke liye wohi shabd rakho jo log type karte hain, discovery video ke liye curiosity ya stakes pehle rakho; poora caps ya clickbait mat rakho
why: Lamba title feed me kat jata hai aur truncation dono jagah alag tareeke se fail karta hai — desktop par tail jata hai, mobile par subject ja sakta hai; galat iraade wala title galat viewer lata hai jo turant chala jata hai
evidence_note: YouTube official title limit (100 chars) + truncation points platform behaviour (dono clusters me documented); sweet spot aur front-loading craft recommendation hai

name: Cover frame / title card
when: Short/Reel ka cover banate waqt
action: Cover par public-safe line ≤7 shabd me rakho (ExpoCut: frame 0 par padh sakne wala 3-5 shabd), center-anchored, ~2.0 s hold, 1-2 lines; Reels ke 1:1 center crop ke liye text x 22-78% ke andar rakho; cover frame video ke 0.3-0.4 s se render karo; test: cover dekh kar koi ajnabi topic bata sake
why: Cover hi grid me video ki pehchan hai — wahan se samajh na aaye to click bhi nahi aata
evidence_note: mktkit cover rules (public-safe gate) + ExpoCut frame-0 hook (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com)

name: Shorts reframe subject par rakho
when: 16:9 footage ko vertical me badalte waqt
action: Crop ko shot-by-shot subject par rakho — fixed center crop kabhi nahi; do speakers hon to dono ko sikoṛne ke bajaye unke beech cut karo ya stack karo; screen ya wide shot ka relevant hissa bada karke dikhao; clips nikalne ka plan ho to 4K me record karo
why: Center crop aksar subject ko hi kaat deta hai; subject-centered reframing hi vertical ko asal lagta hai
evidence_note: kmilo shorts recipe ka creator practice

name: Style copy karna ho to pehle naapo
when: Kisi creator ki editing style copy karne se pehle
action: Pehle original ko naapo: cuts/sec (scene detection se), spectrogram se SFX aur hit ke pal, face screen ka kitna % hai, zoom jumps, music ki BPM aur voice ke neeche uski level — sirf frames dekh kar copy mat karo (wahan sound aur rhythm gayab rehte hain, aur copy isi liye nakli lagta hai); apne numbers original ke andar rakho (zyada jumps nahi, bada face nahi); result side-by-side compare karke hi dikhao
why: Do baar ki nakli copies (zyada zoom, bada face, har entrance par whoosh) isi sabak se bane rule hain — naap hi style ka asal DNA deti hai
evidence_note: Melvynx steal skill ke learnings (rejected copies ke aadhar par)

name: Zoom in = zor, zoom out = naya topic
when: Edit me zoom use karte waqt
action: Zoom in (push) key point par zor dene ke liye — important palon me 2–4 per minute. Zoom out (pull) naye topic ke transition par
why: Zoom direction ka matlab hota hai: andar = 'ye zaroori hai', bahar = 'hissa badla'
frequency: Zoom in 2–4/min (sirf important palon me); zoom out har topic transition par
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Jump cut: dead air hatao, pace tez karo
when: Fast sections ke edit par
action: Jump cut ka kaam dead air hatana aur pacing tez karna rakho; fast sections me har 5–10s me jump cut aaye
why: Jump cut energy ko banaye rakhta hai bina naye footage ke
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: SFX kam rakho: poori video me 3–5 max
when: Sound effects lagate waqt
action: SFX sirf joke ko punctuate karne ya transition par zor dene ke liye; poori video me kul 3–5 se zyada nahi
why: Zyada SFX apna asar kho dete hain aur sasta lagne lagte hain
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Split screen sirf comparison/transformation par
when: Split screen use karte waqt
action: Split screen sirf before/after ya comparison/transformation wale palon par use karo
why: Split screen ka matlab hi tulna hai; bina tulna ke wo sirf shor hai
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Subtitle emphasis sirf quotable palon par
when: Captions ke upar emphasis style lagate waqt
action: Subtitle emphasis (highlight/bold) sirf quotable moments ya key takeaways par lagao — har line par nahi (poori captions wali lazmi rule B-033 alag hai)
why: Har jagah zor = kahin zor nahi; chune hue pal hi yaad rehte hain
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Music awaaz ke neeche, levels me koi jhatka nahi
when: Audio mix karte waqt
action: Background track −20 se −25 dB par rakho aur voice −6 se −10 dB par (music kabhi voice se takraye nahi). Audio levels poori video me consistent rakho — jarring volume changes nahi. Music speech ke neeche low, non-speech palon me upar; strategic silence bhi ek tool hai. Trending audio tabhi use karo jab content se relevant ho, force mat karo
why: Competing music samajh ko khata hai (Samajh > Style); consistent levels viewer ko bina wajah jhatka nahi dete
frequency: Poora mix; music −20..−25 dB, voice −6..−10 dB
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Color grade saare clips me ek jaisa
when: Post-production / grade par
action: Saare clips ki brightness/contrast match karo aur ek subtle LUT ya color preset lagakar brand consistency rakho
why: Badalte rang har cut par dhyaan kheench lete hain — kahani se hata kar technique par
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Opening visual pattern interrupt ke 4 roop
when: Short ke pehle 3 seconds me visual hook chahiye to
action: In me se koi ek chalao: (1) sudden movement (jump up, turn, desk par kuch patakna), (2) strong facial expression (shock/exasperation/huge smile), (3) out-of-context object (absurd sign, badi pile, countdown), (4) unexpected color/lighting
why: Feed scroll ko todne ke liye sabse tez hathiyar visual surprise hai
frequency: Suitable shorts ki opening me, koi ek
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Har beat ka 5-layer storyboard banao
when: Short-form script/storyboard likhte waqt
action: Har beat ko 5 layers me likho: (1) VISUAL — framing, expression, props, graphics, transition; (2) AUDIO — word-for-word dialogue, tone, pacing; (3) ON-SCREEN TEXT — text, position (top/center/bottom), timing; (4) DIRECTING — cuts kahan, zoom in/out, editing pace; (5) MUSIC/SFX — music type, SFX, volume (speech ke neeche low, non-speech me high)
why: Jo layer script me nahi likhi gayi wo edit me andaze se banti hai; 5-layer format har beat ko pehle se tay karta hai
frequency: Har beat, har short-form script me
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya

name: Speaker performance: natural, camera se baat, jaan-boojh ke pauses
when: Recording ke dauraan (founder/creator on camera)
action: Camera me aise dekho jaise colleague se baat kar rahe ho, audience se nahi; expressions natural, rehearsed nahi; haath dikhai dein (natural gestures); emphasis ke liye 1–2s ke short pauses — ye khamoshi 'extremely powerful' hoti hai; chhoti galtiyan theek hain, imperfection authentic lagta hai. Har segment ke 2–3 takes lo taaki edit ke paas options hon; saaf audio (background noise nahi)
why: Natural delivery bharosa banati hai; jaan-boojh ki khamoshi boli gayi line se zyada zor deti hai
frequency: Har recording session; har segment 2–3 takes
evidence_note: creator/editor opinion ya house rule — source me measured data nahi diya gaya
conflict_note: Dead-air rule (B-051) se takraav lag sakta hai: wahan bina-kaarann wali khamoshi kat-ti hai, yahan 1–2s ka pause jaan-boojh kar emphasis ke liye hai aur visual use uthata hai. Dono ka faisla intention se hoga — Step 3 me note rahe.

name: Production value platform aur job se milao
when: Production tier chunne par
action: Polish platform/job ke hisaab se rakho, brand ke ego ke hisaab se nahi: performance ads (Meta/TikTok) par scrappy iPhone/UGC video mehngi animated production ko peeche chhod deta hai (source: 2024 Meta studies me 3:1 tak). MrBeast ka siddhant bhi yahi: goal 'best YOUTUBE video' hai, 'best produced video' nahi
why: Galat tier par paisa lagana sabse mehengi galti hai — mehenga hona hi dekha jana nahi hai
evidence_note: platform study claim skill me cited (Meta creative studies 2024) + creator practice

name: Frame declutter — closer, saaf framing
when: Kisi frame me competing subjects ya clutter ho
action: Closer aur cleaner framing chuno — frame me elements kam rakho taaki dhyaan ek jagah rahe
why: Cutting ke programme me century-lambi trend fewer elements per frame ki hai; ye attention control hai, fashion nahi
evidence_note: Trend measured hai; 'isiliye retention badhega' application inference hai
conflict_note: Tim Smith ke 'one magnet per shot' (C-007, 🟢) se milta-julta hai — wahan dhyaan do

name: Eye-trace landing — subject wahi jahan aankh hai
when: Cut ke baad wala shot compose/select karte waqt
action: Shot B ka main subject lagbhag usi screen area me rakho jahan shot A ke end par viewer ka focus tha (ya use sabse strong motion/face cue banao), taaki aankh ko cut ke baad dhundna na pade
why: Attentional synchrony: sab viewers ek saath ek hi jagah dekhte hain; sahi landing par cut mehsoos hi nahi hota
evidence_note: Gaze clustering frame-by-frame eye-tracking se measured, kai studies me replicated
conflict_note: Murch ka eye-trace criterion (C-017) yahi baat 🟠 craft ke roop me kehta hai; ye uska measured version hai

name: Murch 4 — Eye-trace ka khayaal (7%)
when: Cut aur composition ka faisla karte waqt
action: Dekho ki audience ka focus frame me kahan aur kis taraf move kar raha hai, aur cut usi trace ko acknowledge kare
why: Eye-trace chautha criterion hai — cut ke paar nazar ka safar smooth rahe to cut ghulta hai
evidence_note: Murch ki raay 🟠 hai, lekin isi baat ko Smith ke eye-tracking ne baad me measure karke 🟢 support diya (C-006)

name: Murch 5 — 2-D plane / screen direction (5%)
when: Cut par stage line ya screen direction ka sawal aaye
action: Screen ki 2-D grammar (stage line, screen direction) ka samman karo — lekin ye upar ke chaar criteria ke liye qurban ho sakta hai
why: Planarity paanchva criterion hai; iska kaam asli 3-D space ko 2-D screen par padhne layak rakhna hai
evidence_note: Craft wisdom, koi measurement nahi

name: Murch 6 — 3-D space continuity (4%)
when: Characters ki asal spatial positions ka sawal aaye
action: Asli 3-D space ki continuity rakho jab muft me mile; ye sabse halka criterion hai — sabse pehle yahi qurban hoga
why: Sirf 4% weight: perfect spatial continuity bhi emotion-fail cut ko nahi bacha sakti, aur audience engaged ho to spatial jumps notice hi nahi karti
frequency: Har spatial cut par, sabse kam priority
evidence_note: Murch ki raay; audience ke spatial details na notice karne wali baat ko Smith ke attention findings se partial support milta hai

name: Shorts overlay — dusra hook, 5-7 shabd
when: Short-form hook ke saath on-screen text lagate waqt
action: Overlay 5-7 shabdon me rakho; spoken line ki tamam — wahi promise, alag shabd — taaki sound-on aur muted dono viewers ko pura hook mile
why: Autoplay aksar muted chalta hai; overlay hi muted viewer ka hook hai
evidence_note: SkillMedev ki rule; Jake bhi Shorts ke pehle 2s ke liye spoken se alag shabdon wala on-screen text kehta hai

name: Title formulas — corpus-validated ko pehle
when: Title likhte waqt formula chunna ho
action: Formulas me se chuno: Y1 Curiosity-Gap, Y2 Number/Listicle, Y3 How-I Outcome, Y4 Mistake/Negativity, Y5 Transformation, Y6 Versus, Y11 Third-Party Success Story. Corpus me Y1/Y3/Y5 confirmed over-performers hain (214-video pull); Y11 sabse zyada frequent uncaptured shape tha. Har title me curiosity ke saath ek concrete noun rakho; number wala dawa sach aur apna ho
why: Formula hi title ko summary se promise banata hai; corpus validation batata hai kaunse shapes asal me over-perform karte hain
frequency: Har title par 1 formula; 3-5 variants kam se kam 2 formulas se
evidence_note: 214-video corpus (July 2026, business/creator niche, subscriber-normalized) me Y1/Y3/Y5 validated aur Y11 discover hua — measured corpus, controlled experiment nahi; sirf title formulas is data se test ho sakte hain, opening hooks nahi
conflict_note: Y2/Y4/Y6 is corpus me kamzor ya gayab mile (Y4 aur Y6 business niche me essentially absent) — ye formulas gear/tutorial niches me kaam kar sakte hain, lekin 'proven' mat mano

name: Title ki samagri — number/naam/date, vague shabd nahi
when: Title ke shabd chunte waqt
action: Ek number, naam ya date rakho — ye har adjective ko harata hai. Vague shabd (amazing, incredible, insane, ultimate, best, secret...) hatao. Pehle 3 shabd sirf filler na hon — subject aage lao. Title sawaal par khatm ho to open question ka plus milta hai
why: Concreteness hi click ka sabse bharosemand single fix hai; vagueness andaza lagwati hai
evidence_note: title.py ke checks + serge ki voice rules — craft heuristics
conflict_note: All-caps par sources me halka farak: Jake ceiling 2 caps shabd deta hai, serge full-caps title banned aur 1 emphasized shabd tak rakhta hai — sakht wala (serge) surakshit rahega

name: Thumbnail core — ek focal point, sachhi emotion, 120px test
when: Thumbnail concept banate waqt
action: Ek hi focal point rakho (face + specific emotion, ya object/result). Emotion video ki asal feeling se match kare — shaant tutorial par shocked face retention se mehnga padega. High contrast aur subject separation rakho (rim light, darkened/blurred background). Har concept ko 120px par shrink karke dekho: wahan padhna aaye tabhi pass. 3 se zyada visual elements kabhi nahi
why: Thumbnail aadhe second me, 120px par, ek darjan competitors ke beech padha jata hai; do competing subjects impact aadha kar dete hain
evidence_note: Teenon sources ke thumbnail rules ka sangam; 120px test teeno me hai

name: Thumbnail text — target 3 shabd, title se alag
when: Thumbnail par text overlay likhte waqt
action: Overlay ke shabd title ke shabdon se bilkul alag rakho — dono aadhi click surface ek hi baat do baar keh kar barbaad karte hain. Lambai ka target 3 shabd rakho. Text bottom-right third me kabhi nahi (duration badge dhakta hai). Ek emphasis shabd all-caps/color me chalega
why: Title aur thumbnail ek unit hain; duplication aadhi jagah ki barbaadi hai, aur feed size par chautha-paanchva shabd grey smear ban jata hai
evidence_note: Teenon sources overlay ko title se alag rakhne par ekmat hain; ginati par farak hai (neeche conflict dekho)
conflict_note: Shabd-limit par sources takrate hain: Jake '3 maximum' kehta hai (tool 4 par flag karta hai), serge '4 ya kam', SkillMedev '2-5, target 3, hard ceiling 5'. Target 3 sab me surakshit hai; Step 3 ek number final kare

name: Thumbnail ke 2-3 concepts, ek bada element vary karo
when: Thumbnail finalize karne se pehle
action: Hamesha 2-3 concepts banao (jaise face-forward / object-result / text-heavy minimal) aur har concept me sirf EK bada element badlo (face vs object, text vs no-text, warm vs cool color) taaki Test & Compare ka result padhne layak ho. Ek lead concept recommend karo — jeet watch-time share se naapo, sirf CTR se nahi
why: Ek concept dena andaza hai; ek-saath paanch chhoti cheezein badalne se test kuch nahi batata
evidence_note: serge + SkillMedev ki shared workflow rule

name: Description — pehle 150 characters hi hook
when: Description likhte waqt
action: Pehli ~150 characters ko dusra hook banao: payoff ya sawaal + primary keyword natural tareeke se. Yehi 'Show more' se pehle dikhta hai aur search snippet hai. Kul lambai 5,000 characters ke neeche. Keywords natural sentences me (primary phrase pehle 150 me ek baar, body me ek baar), comma-dump kabhi nahi. Hashtags aakhir me 3-5; 15 se zyada hon to YouTube sab ignore kar deta hai. Tags sirf disambiguation ke liye, 15 kaafi
why: Pehli lines ke alawa description zyada tar koi padhta hi nahi; wahi hissa search ko bhi khilati hai
evidence_note: 5,000-char cap aur 150-char visibility platform ke documented behaviour hain; baaki structure craft hai

name: Channel page — trailer, banner safe area, About ki pehli 2 lines
when: Channel page audit/setup karte waqt
action: Trailer non-subscribers ke liye 30-90s ki bana-banayi pitch rakho (random recent upload nahi) — ye subscriber conversion ka sabse bada lever hai. Banner 2560x1440 par banao lekin value prop + cadence centered 1235x338 safe area ke andar rakho (mobile/TV par kinare cut te hain). About ki pehli 2 lines me poora value prop: kiske liye, kya milta hai, kitni baar, ek proof. Ek hi primary link rakho
why: Video se click karke aaya viewer ek pal me faisla karta hai; trailer/banner/About hi use subscriber banate hain
frequency: Channel setup par aur har audit par
evidence_note: serge channel-optimizer ki scorecard rules; banner dimensions platform spec hain

name: Zoom neighbouring segments me alternate karo
when: Cut par punch-in/zoom lagate waqt
action: Paas wale segments ke beech zoom alternate karo (jaise 1.00 / 1.045 / 1.09); climax par maximum zoom rakho. Isse cut angle badalne jaisa padhta hai, galti jaisa nahi
why: Ek jaisa frame cut par 'jump' lagta hai; halka scale farak use deliberate choice bana deta hai
evidence_note: blazerior ki EDL practice (segments me zoom 1.00/1.045 pattern)

name: Ek stretch bina graphics ke — viewer ko hawa do
when: Minute-bhar ke video me overlays/cards lagate waqt
action: Har minute me kam se kam ek 4-6 second ka saaf stretch rakho jisme koi graphic na ho. Cards ki thos deewaar viewer ko thaka deti hai
why: Bina saans ki visual bharmar dhyaan ko hi kha jati hai; khaali stretch hi accents ko wazan deta hai
evidence_note: blazerior ki do jagah (SKILL rule 7 + storyboard rhythm) dohraayi rule

name: Card face ke upar — kabhi face PAR nahi (safe zones)
when: 1080x1920 vertical video me card/panel rakhte waqt
action: Card ko face ke UPAR (above) rakho, face ke upar (on) kabhi nahi — panel beech frame me gira to aankhein dhak jati hain, aur speaker ki nazar hi video ke bharose ka aadha hissa hai. Zones rakho: top 0-150 platform UI (kuch nahi), graphics ka working area 200-1250, face aam taur par 700-1300 (bahar rakho), subtitles 1380-1520, bottom 1600-1920 platform UI (kuch nahi). Zoom wale segment par face bada/unar hota hai — card ki jagah usi hisaab se check karo
why: Aankhein dhakna sabse aam pehli-galti hai; safe zones platform UI se takraav bachate hain
evidence_note: blazerior design-system ki zones table — is skill ke tested layout numbers
conflict_note: SkillMedev ke per-platform safe-area percentages (TikTok/Reels/Shorts ke insets) se ye alag number set hai — dono ek hi sach ke do roop hain; Step 3 me ek zone table final hogi

name: Word-level subtitles — line me zyada se zyada 3 shabd
when: Vertical video ke liye burned-in word-level subtitles banate waqt
action: Line me zyada se zyada 3 shabd rakho; 0.7s se bada pause nayi line tod de. Active (bola ja raha) shabd tint karo aur 8% bara karo (108% scale; 110% se aage line hilne lagti hai). Font size 72, WrapStyle 0 lazmi (2 par lambi line screen se bahar jati hai). Subtitle text proofread karo — galti picture me jal jaye to permanent hai
why: Shabd-dar-shabd highlight bolne ki gati se milta hai; zyada shabd aur galat wrap padhne ko marta hai
evidence_note: blazerior make_ass.py ke constants (MAX_WORDS 3, MAX_GAP 0.7) — is pipeline ke shipped numbers
conflict_note: Caption ke teen mode is cluster me hain: ye word-level (3 shabd), SkillMedev ki phrase captions 32-42 chars/line (C-085 ke saath dekho), pifferologo ki 2-shabd chunks (C-098) — mode content ke hisaab se batega, Step 3 tay kare

name: Loudness −14 LUFS (social standard)
when: Social platforms ke liye final audio normalize karte waqt
action: Final loudnorm I=-14 LUFS, TP=-1.5, LRA=11 rakho (two-pass zyada accurate hai). Isse shaant = amateurish, isse tez = platform khud neeche kar dega
why: Reels/TikTok/Shorts ka normalization target yahi hai; platform ki apni ceiling se ladna bekaar hai
evidence_note: Platform loudness standard ke roop me widely documented; blazerior cookbook bhi yahi spec deta hai (mean ~-18 dB expected after loudnorm)

name: Grade tulna karke chuno, moderate rakho
when: Colour grade tay karte waqt
action: Grade aankh se andaze par mat chuno: ek frame nikalo, candidate grades us par chalao, frames ko stack (hstack) karke saath-saath dekho, phir chuno. Grade moderate rakho — 8-bit phone footage par aggressive curves gradients par banding la dete hain (khaaskar subject ke peeche wali deewaar par)
why: Akele frame par achha lagne wala grade তুলna me hi sach batata hai; banding ek baar render ho to poora video kharab
evidence_note: blazerior cookbook ki method rule
conflict_note: pifferologo ke CDL reasoning (C-097) se milta hai — dono 'ek badlav, phir dekho' kehte hain

name: Base grade recipe (tested values)
when: Talking-head ko backlight/mixed light se sudharna ho
action: Base grade ye rakho: eq contrast=1.13, brightness=0.012, saturation=1.07, gamma=1.07; curves se shadows uthao (0.22→0.285) aur halka warm (red up, blue down); vignette=PI/9 (subtle; PI/5 strong hai); unsharp 5:5:0.45 scale/crop ki softness ke liye. Alternatives: neutral punch (contrast 1.12, sat 1.06), warm cinematic, pastel/film fade, ya ready .cube LUT (lut3d)
why: Ye values hard backlight par test hue hain: face shadow se uthta hai aur alag locations ek jaise lagte hain
frequency: Har naye project ka starting grade; phir material ke hisaab se badlo
evidence_note: blazerior cookbook ke tested filter values; ek hi pipeline ke numbers hain, universal law nahi

name: Transitions me sakhti — hard cut default
when: Do clips ke beech transition chunte waqt
action: Default hard cut rakho — pause par hard cut lagbhag invisible hota hai aur har effect ko harata hai. Cross-fade (xfade 0.3s) sirf wahan kamata hai jahan frame me movement ho (baithna, khada hona, mudna). Talking head par fade/dissolve se aage ke effects amateur lagte hain. Yaad rakho: xfade result ko transition ke barabar chhota kar deta hai — baad ki saari timings (subtitles, overlays) shift ho jati hain; ya timings dobara ginno ya transitions chain ke aakhir me rakho. Audio par matching acrossfade 0.3s
why: Effect bina wajah ke dhyaan khinchta hai; timing shift chhupa hua kharcha hai jo subtitles ko bigaad deta hai
evidence_note: blazerior cookbook ki transition guidance

name: Design restraint — 2 accent rang, type ki floor
when: Overlay design system tay karte waqt
action: Zyada se zyada 2 accent colours rakho; accent frame me maujud cheez se chuno (kapde, deewaar, roshni) ya brand colours se. Type ka floor 36px hai (sirf captions ke liye bhi); chhota type phone par marta hai. Neon rang aur 4px outlines expert content ki credibility khatm kar dete hain. Panel par shadow lazmi hai, warna chipka hua lagta hai
why: Restraint hi design ko 'banaya hua' padhata hai; rangon ki bheed aur chhota type dono sasta lagte hain
evidence_note: blazerior design-system ki 'what not to do' list

name: Animation me restraint — 0.25s fade kaafi hai
when: Card/overlay ko animate karte waqt
action: Sirf 0.25s ka fade rakho; fly-ins aur bounces dhyaan bolne wali baat se kheench lete hain. Animation apne aap ke liye kabhi nahi — motion tabhi jab wohi matlab uthaye
why: Overlay ka kaam speech ko support karna hai, usse compete karna nahi
evidence_note: blazerior design-system ki rule
conflict_note: pifferologo ke animation durations/easing (C-099/C-100) se takraav nahi: wahan information-cards ki baat hai, yahan simple overlays ki

name: Social export — captions burned-in, safe area ke andar
when: Kisi platform ke liye export tay karte waqt
action: Captions pixels me burn karo (uploaded .srt sidecar har platform par inconsistent aur un-styleable hai); zyada se zyada 2 lines, phrase chunks me speech ke sync; position platform ke safe area ke andar. Har platform ke insets rakho (% me, top/right/bottom/left): TikTok 6/11/17/3, Reels 7/12/18/3, Shorts 5/12/13/3, X 4/4/12/4, LinkedIn 4/4/10/4. Ek 9:16 master TikTok/Reels/Shorts teeno ko de (sabse tang inset — Reels ke bottom — par design karo) aur X/LinkedIn ke liye alag 1:1 ya 4:5 master. Ek hi 16:9 file har platform par mat bhejo — vertical feed me wo stripe ban jati hai
why: Safe area ke bahar rakhi cheez device par dikhti hi nahi (preview me theek lagti hai); sidecar captions style aur bharosa dono kho dete hain
evidence_note: SkillMedev social-video-formatter ke compiled platform specs; file khud kehta hai specs drift hote hain — shipping se pehle current creator docs se verify karo
conflict_note: Safe-zone numbers blazerior ke pixel zones (C-076) se alag set hain — dono ko ek table me Step 3 merge karega

name: Reframe ki quality seedhi — re-layout sabse upar
when: Aspect ratio badalna ho (16:9 se 9:16 ya ulta)
action: Quality ke is order me chuno: (1) Re-layout — pixels crop mat karo, scene ko naye canvas ke liye dobara compose karo (stack karo, type bada karo, subject vertical center me); (2) Punch-and-track — crop window action ko follow kare (keyframes do); (3) Center crop — sirf tab jab subject poore samay dead center ho, warna outer thirds ke saath subject bhi jayega; (4) Blur-pad — aakhri upay, talking-head/screen par chalega, motion piece par 'repost' ka signal deta hai. Subject move karta ho to blind center-crop kabhi nahi
why: Re-layout hi video ko platform ke liye 'banaya gaya' padhata hai, 'ghusaya gaya' nahi
evidence_note: SkillMedev social-video-formatter ki strategy ranking

name: Subtitles filter chain me SABSE LAST
when: Render pipeline ki order tay karte waqt
action: Subtitles hamesha har overlay ke BAAD lagao. Pehle lagaye to overlays unhe dhak dete hain — aur ye silent failure hai, koi error nahi aata
why: Galat order kharab output deti hai bina kisi chetaavni ke; ye taste nahi, correctness hai
evidence_note: video-use ki Hard Rule 1 — production-correctness rule; house standard hai, koi bahari spec nahi (technical invariant)

name: Per-segment extract → lossless concat; grade per-segment
when: Cuts ko render karte waqt
action: Har segment alag extract karke lossless (-c copy) concat karo — overlays ke saath single-pass filtergraph mat chalao, warna har segment do baar encode hota hai. Grade bhi per-segment extraction ke waqt lagao, post-concat nahi
why: Double encoding quality khaata hai aur samay bhi; per-segment tareeka dono bachata hai
evidence_note: video-use Hard Rule 2 + grade section — pipeline correctness rule

name: Grade ko CDL se socho — ek badlav, phir dekho
when: Kisi frame ka grade theek karte waqt
action: ASC CDL model se socho: slope = highlights, offset = shadows, power = midtones, phir global saturation. Ek frame dekho, galat cheez pehchano, EK cheez adjust karo, dobara dekho. Grade per-segment lagao; skin tones test kiye bina aggressive kabhi mat jao
why: Ek-saath kai badlav karna andaza hai; ek-badlav-iterative tareeka hi batata hai kis cheez ne kya kiya
evidence_note: video-use ki grade method; CDL khud ek industry standard model (ASC) hai, lekin 'ek badlav' wali vidhi house craft hai
conflict_note: blazerior ki comparison method (C-079) se milta hai — dono ek dusre ko mazboot karte hain

name: Subtitle chunking ke do tested style
when: Burned-in subtitles ka style chunte waqt
action: Short-form/fast social ke liye 'bold-overlay': 2-shabd chunks, UPPERCASE, punctuation par break, bold, MarginV=35. Narrative/documentary/education ke liye 'natural-sentence': 4-7 shabd chunks, sentence case, natural pauses par break, MarginV=60-80, bada font. Dono me subtitles LAST aur output-timeline offsets lazmi
why: Chunking, case aur placement ka sahi combo content par nirbhar hai; galat combo ya to chillata hai ya padha nahi jata
frequency: Har project ke style faisle par
evidence_note: video-use ke shipped worked styles (ek asal launch video se) — ek style dusre context ka law nahi
conflict_note: Caption modes ka teesra roop C-077 (word-level 3 shabd) aur C-085 (phrase 32-42 chars) me hai — teeno content-type se batega

name: Animation ki muddatein (cards/diagrams/accents)
when: Overlay animation ki duration tay karte waqt
action: Narration ke saath chalne wali explanation: floor ~3s, aam taur par simple cards 5-7s, complex diagrams 8-14s (viewer ko 1x par parse karna hai). Beat-synced accents (music/montage): 0.5-2s theek hai — wahan niyam 'parseable' nahi, 'recognizable at 1x' hai. Final frame kam se kam 1s hold karo (universal). Voiceover ke upar overlay ki kul duration narration + 1s se kam kabhi nahi
why: Information ko padhne ka samay chahiye; accent ko sirf pehchanna hai — dono ki ghadiyan alag hain
evidence_note: video-use ke duration rules of thumb — ek shipped video ke numbers, 'context-dependent' source khud kehta hai

name: Easing kabhi linear nahi; parallel reveal kabhi nahi
when: Animation ka motion design karte waqt
action: Easing hamesha cubic rakho: single reveals ke liye ease_out_cubic (slow landing), continuous draws ke liye ease_in_out_cubic. Linear robotic lagta hai. Do independent elements ek saath reveal mat karo — aankh do nayi cheezein ek saath track nahi kar sakti: ek cheez, pause, phir agli
why: Linear motion machine jaisa padhta hai; parallel reveal dhyaan ko baant kar dono ko adhura chhodta hai
evidence_note: video-use ki universal-kahi hui rules; parallel-reveal wali baat Smith ke one-magnet (C-007, 🟢) se taal rakhti hai

name: Split edit default — audio/video ek point par na kaato
when: Dialogue/interview editing me koi bhi cut lage
action: Audio aur video ke cut points ko 6–12 frames offset rakho: J-cut (agle scene ki awaaz pehle) anticipation/transition ke liye, L-cut (pichli awaaz nayi tasveer par) reaction/emotional carry-over ke liye
why: Seedha cut baatcheet me jarring lagta hai; split edit se baat ka pravah aur ehsaas cut ke paar beh jata hai
frequency: Dialogue me lagbhag 80% cuts split edits hone chahiye (source ka daava)
evidence_note: Craft parampara/house rule (note); measured study nahi

name: Match cut — katne wale do shots me ek rishta rakho
when: Do shots ke beech cut lage aur seedha cut kamzor lage
action: Match cut ki 4 kismo me se ek rakho — graphic (shape), movement, sound, ya idea/concept match
why: Bina rishte ka cut darshak ko jhatka deta hai; match se do alag shots ek soch ban jate hain
frequency: Har kamzor cut par kam se kam ek match prakar
evidence_note: Editor craft parampara (note)

name: Invisible cut ko harkat/roshni ke peeche chhupao
when: Cut dikhai de raha ho lekin kahani me seam nahi dikhana
action: Cut ko whip pan, frame cross karte object, light flash ya rack-focus blur ke peeche chhupao
why: Darshak ki aankh harkat/roshni ke saath beh jati hai aur seam ghayab ho jata hai
