frequency: Har dikhne wale problem cut par
evidence_note: Editor craft parampara (note)
conflict_note: koptsev63 ke misdirection rule (D1-079) se sambandhit hai — wo khaas taur par movement/sound spike ki baat karta hai; takraav nahi

name: Rhythm editing — cut ko kisi taal par rakho
when: Sequence ki cutting ki lay tay karni ho
action: Cuts ko in chaar taal me se kisi ek par rakho: music ke beats, tension ke saath badhti speed (emotional rhythm), shaant hisso me saans ki gati (breathing rhythm), ya bolne wale ki cadence
why: Bina taal ke cuts yaad nahi rehte; taal hi pacing ko ehsaas banati hai
frequency: Poore sequence me ek chuni hui taal consistent
evidence_note: Editor craft parampara (note)

name: Grade ka kram aur LUT ki matra
when: Colour grade lagana ho (Premiere Lumetri ya Resolve nodes)
action: Kram rakho: Basic/Primary correction (scopes se black/white point, white balance) → Creative (LUT/Look hamesha kam intensity par) → Curves → Wheels/Secondary → skin-tone protection. Creative LUT ki intensity 50–70% rakho; Rec709 material par blend ≤55% rakho
why: Poori taakat ka LUT rang bigaad deta hai; sahi kram se correction aur look alag-alag control me rehte hain
frequency: Har grade par; LUT intensity 50–70% (Rec709 par ≤55%)
evidence_note: Do sources ke craft numbers (note + MIT skill); band ka sangat hissa 50–55% hai
conflict_note: Andar ka halka takraav: ADAM-0S 50–70% kehta hai, koptsev63 Rec709 par ≤55% ki hadd deta hai — sangat hissa 50–55%; Step 3 addendum me material-wise hadd tay ho

name: Pehle hero shot grade karo, phir baaki ko milao
when: Ek scene ke kai shots ka grade match karna ho
action: Pehle scene ka ek hero shot grade karke uska still bachao; phir har shot ko waveform (exposure), parade (balance), histogram (contrast), vectorscope (skin line) se usi still se milao
why: Har shot ko alag se grade karne se scene ke andar rang badalta rehta hai; hero shot se mel consistency deta hai
frequency: Har scene par ek hero shot pehle
evidence_note: Colourist craft (note)

name: Dialogue cleanup ka kram aur numbers
when: Dialogue/voice track saaf karna ho
action: Isi kram me: normalize (peaks −12..−6 dBFS) → high-pass filter 80–100 Hz → room-tone noise print se de-noise → de-ess 4–8 kHz → halki compression 2:1–3:1
why: Galat kram me safai awaaz ko patla/kritrim kar deti hai; ye kram pehle badi gadbad, phir bareeki sambhalta hai aur baat saaf sunai deti hai
frequency: Har dialogue track par ek baar, mix se pehle
evidence_note: Audio craft numbers (note)

name: Har edit point par chhota audio crossfade
when: Koi bhi audio cut lage
action: Har edit point par 2–4 frames ka audio crossfade lagao
why: Bina crossfade ke cut par click/pop sunai deta hai jo darshak ko baat se bahar kheenchta hai
frequency: Har audio edit point par, bina apvaad
evidence_note: Audio craft (note)
conflict_note: ZeusSheen ka 2-frame fade rule (D1-089) isi baat ka khaas roop hai — sangat hai, takraav nahi

name: Mix levels ki seedhi (dBFS)
when: Final mix ke levels tay karne hon
action: Seedhi rakho: dialogue −12..−6 dBFS (sabse upar), dialogue ke neeche music −18..−24, bina dialogue ke featured music −12..−6, SFX −18..−6 (content ke hisaab se), ambience bed −24..−18
why: Levels ki seedhi hi tay karti hai ki kya sunai dega aur kya sirf mehsoos hoga; ulta-pulta mix baat dabaa deta hai
frequency: Poore mix me ye seedhi barkarar
evidence_note: Audio craft numbers (note); ye absolute dBFS band hai
conflict_note: Purana niyam (ORDER #11) music ko voice ke RELATIVE 18–25 dB neeche kehta hai; ye band ABSOLUTE dBFS hai (−18..−24) — sankhya milti-julti hai lekin naap ka aadhar alag hai; Step 3 addendum me basis ek karna hoga

name: Broadcast/Netflix loudness ke naye band
when: Delivery broadcast TV ya Netflix/cinema ke liye ho
action: Integrated loudness destination ke hisaab se rakho: broadcast TV −24 LUFS, Netflix/cinema −27 LUFS (Netflix par true peak max −2 dBTP)
why: Har platform ki loudness shart alag hai; YouTube wala −14 wahan chalega nahi aur file reject/normalize hogi
frequency: Har delivery par destination-wise ek target
evidence_note: Platform delivery specs ka house sangrah (note)
conflict_note: Purane rules sirf −14 (YouTube) aur −16 (podcast/house) band dete hain — ye −24/−27 wale band naye hain; Step 3 addendum me destination-wise poori table banni chahiye (YouTube −14 / podcast −16 / broadcast −24 / Netflix −27)

name: Delivery bitrate ki hadd (quality bachane ke liye)
when: Final export ki quality tay karni ho
action: VBR 2-pass rakho; bitrate ke band: 1080p par lagbhag 10–24 Mbps, 4K par 35–68 Mbps, vertical (Reels/TikTok 1080×1920, 30 fps) 10–15 Mbps; master hamesha ProRes 422/DNxHR HQ jaisi quality me rakho
why: Bahut kam bitrate par saaf edit bhi keechad (muddy) dikhta hai — quality ka faisla export par bhi hota hai
evidence_note: Do sources ke delivery bands (note + MIT skill) — neeche conflict dekho
conflict_note: Sources ke beech farak: ADAM-0S 1080p 16–24 Mbps / 4K 45–68 Mbps kehta hai; iart-ai H.264 delivery 1080p ~10–16 Mbps / 4K ~35–50 Mbps kehta hai — aam sangat hissa 16 Mbps (1080p) ke aas-paas hai; Step 3 addendum me ek band tay ho

name: Cut ke dono taraf kam se kam 60 ms asli khamoshi
when: Speech par cut lage (word-boundary par)
action: Har cut edge ke dono taraf kam se kam 60 ms ki asli (true) khamoshi chhodo taaki audio crossfade saans le sake
why: Khamoshi ke bina laga cut shabd ke kinare ko kaat deta hai aur click deta hai; 60 ms crossfade ki saans hai
evidence_note: Agent ki hard rule (note)

name: Pause-removal ki perceptual floor — 250 ms
when: Khamoshi hatane (silence removal) ka threshold tay karna ho
action: Threshold 250 ms se neeche kabhi mat rakho: boli hui connected speech me shabdon ke beech 30–200 ms ke articulation gaps hote hi hain — ye dead air nahi, awaaz ka hissa hai. Asli editorial pause (saans, hichkichahat, soch) lagbhag 250–300 ms se shuru hota hai; ladder 800 ms se 250 ms tak hi rakho
why: 250 ms se neeche ka threshold ek jumle ko ek-shabd wale tukdo me kaat dega — video saaf nahi, kata-kata lagega
frequency: Har silence-removal pass par floor 250 ms
evidence_note: Perceptual tark ke saath di gayi house rule (note)
conflict_note: SEEDHA TAKRAAV purane pause model se: purana model (ORDER #6) silence ≥400 ms = cut zone kehta hai; eacp1991 250 ms ko floor aur 250–300 ms ko editorial pause ki shuruaat manta hai — cut threshold 400 vs 250 ka faisla Step 3 addendum me hona chahiye

name: Lead/trail margins — ASR drift ko soak karo
when: Transcript/word timings se cut points banein
action: Cut se pehle lead margin rakho jo ASR ki aam 50–100 ms drift ko soak kare aur sunne wale ko shabd se pehle saans ki jagah de; margins ki working window 30–200 ms rakho (Calm preset me 500 ms tak ja sakti hai)
why: Word timings hamesha thode idhar-udhar hote hain; bina margin ke cut shabd ke kinare par girta hai
evidence_note: House rule (note)
conflict_note: Purana padding model bhi 30–200 ms window kehta hai (sangat hai), lekin Calm preset ka 500 ms us window se bahar hai — preset-wise apvaad Step 3 addendum me tay ho. ZeusSheen ke sentence padding (0.25/0.35 s, D1-085) se bhi sambandh hai — wo isse bade hain

name: Pacing preset bina confirm kiye edit shuru mat karo
when: Kisi naye video/session ki editing shuru ho
action: Pehle pacing preset tay karo — Calm / Measured / Paced (default) / Energetic / Jumpy — aur har preset ko chaar numbers me kholo: kitni lambi khamoshi hatani hai, kitni chhoti baat rakhne layak hai, lead margin, trail margin
why: Bina preset ke har cut ka faisla alag mood me hota hai aur video ki lay beech me badal jati hai
frequency: Har session/video me ek baar, shuruaat me
evidence_note: Workflow rule (note)

name: Comedy incident ki 4-act ghadi
when: Koi comedy incident/mazaak wala pal kata jaye
action: Incident ko ek lagatar 4-act ghatna ki tarah kaato: Premise/Setup 2.0–3.5 s (max 4.0) → Escalation 1.5–3.0 s (max 3.5) → Punchline/Climax 1.5–2.5 s (max 3.0) → Aftermath/Reaction 2.0–4.0 s (max 4.5); kul lambai 8–14 s (zyada se zyada 15 s)
why: Comedy ka samay hi uski jaan hai — setup chhota to prediction nahi banti, reaction chhota to hasi nahi uthti
frequency: Har comedy incident par ye ghadi
evidence_note: Suite ki measured-si craft ghadi (note); koi published study nahi
conflict_note: koptsev63 ki pacing table comedy beat ko 4–5 s kehti hai (D1-075) — wo ek shot/beat ki baat hai, ye poore incident (4 acts) ki; dono ka paimana alag hai, Step 3 addendum me saaf ho

name: Reaction ko bachao — punchline ke baad kam se kam 1.5 s
when: Comedy/action ke climax ke baad ka hissa kata jaye
action: Vaardaat ke baad kam se kam 1.5 s ka reaction rakho; OUT sirf tab lo jab reaction settle ho jaye; reaction ko beech me kaatna sakht mana hai
why: Darshak ki hasi/ehsaas reaction me hi poora hota hai — use kaatna matlab punchline ko aadha karna
frequency: Har climax ke baad, bina apvaad
evidence_note: Craft rule (note)

name: Ek incident = ek hi lagatar cut; lambi scene me climax window
when: Comedy incident ya isolated scene ka hissa chunna ho
action: Ek incident ko ek hi lagatar cut rakho (4–11 s). Agar isolated scene 9 s se lambi ho to window climax ke aas-paas rakho: peak se 4 s pehle se peak ke 3.5 s baad tak. Bahut tang window (sirf peak −1.5 s) kabhi mat lo — premise mar jayegi
why: Beech se kaata incident apna setup kho deta hai; climax window me poori chhoti kahani bachti hai
evidence_note: Craft rule (note)

name: Zero frame bleed — padosi scene ka ek frame bhi nahi
when: Compilation/scene isolation me cut edges tay hon
action: Kisi bhi cut edge par padosi scene ka 1–2 frame bhi bleed na ho. Compilation rips ke kinaro par chipke hue pichle/agle clip ke 2–5 s ko isolation me (±0.08 s safety ke saath) poora hatao
why: Ek bhi ajnabee frame darshak ko jhatka deta hai aur edit ko kaccha dikhata hai
frequency: Har cut edge par, bina apvaad
evidence_note: Craft rule (note)

name: Climax par music ko −12 dB tak duck karo
when: Kisi scene ka climax/action peak aaye
action: Background music ko climax moments par −12 dB tak auto-duck karo, aur climax SFX (punch/impact) ko apni alag jagah (track) par rakho taaki wo music se na lade
why: Climax par music aur asar ek saath chillayein to dono marte hain; duck se pal ki taakat saaf uthti hai
evidence_note: Suite ka template number (note)
conflict_note: Purana ducking niyam (R-103) dialogue ke neeche 6–12 dB duck kehta hai — ye climax par −12 dB ki khaas hadd hai; sangat disha, alag mauqa — Step 3 addendum me dono ki jagah saaf ho

name: 1 second ya lambi khamoshi hamesha kategi
when: Pause removal/cleanup ka pass chale
action: 1 second ya usse lambi bina-wajah ki khamoshi hamesha kaato
why: Ek second ki khamoshi video ko ruka hua mehsoos karati hai — retention wahi girta hai
frequency: Har cleanup pass me, bina apvaad
evidence_note: Skill ki sakht rule (note); neeche takraav dekho
conflict_note: Yahi suite 10 ms tak ke chhote pauses kaatne ki kshamata bhi rakhti hai — wo sakhti eacp1991 ke 250 ms perceptual floor (D1-013) aur purane 400 ms threshold se seedha takraati hai; kshamata ko default mat bano — faisla Step 3 addendum me

name: Chhote target par W-curve reordering
when: 30 s jaise chhote target ke liye clips sajane hon
action: Clips ko chronological kram ki jagah retention curve (W-curve) ke hisaab se dobara sajao — ya tez chronological fast-cut rakho; beech ka aadha-adhura kram nahi
why: Chhoti video me har second ko darshak ko pakadna hai; seedha chronological kram sabse mazboot pal ko beech me dubo deta hai
evidence_note: Suite ki retention soch (note)

name: Animation timing ki frame-ghadi (Disney ghadi)
when: Kisi element ki animation ki lambai (frames me) tay karni ho
action: Frames se ehsaas chuno: 2–4 frames = snappy/instant, 6–8 = quick/energetic, 12–15 = normal pace, 20–30 = slow/heavy, 40+ = dramatic/weighted
why: Frames hi animation ki bhasha hai — galat ghadi par halki cheez bhaari aur bhaari cheez khilona lagti hai
frequency: Har animation ki duration tay karte waqt
evidence_note: Disney craft parampara ke frame counts (MIT skill sheet); fps ke hisaab se ehsaas badalta hai
conflict_note: LobzyJay ki ms-ghadi (D1-059) isse sangat hai: <150 ms instant, 150–250 halka, 250–500 standard, 500 ms–1 s bhaari, >1 s cinematic — 30 fps par dono takreeban milte hain

name: Anticipation ki bani-banai banawat (frames)
when: Koi bada action animate ho (jump, launch, reveal)
action: Timeline ko aise banao: 0–10 frames wind-up (crouch/pull back) → 10–12 frames transition → 12–30 frames main action → 30–40 frames settle. Wind-up ke keyframes par easy ease rakho
why: Bina taiyaari ke action achanak teleport lagta hai; wind-up aankh ko aane wale zor ke liye taiyaar karta hai
frequency: Har bade action par; chhote UI moves par anupaat se chhota
evidence_note: Disney parampara ki frame banawat (MIT skill sheet)
conflict_note: LobzyJay anticipation ko main action ka 20–30% kehta hai (D1-060) — ye 40-frame banawat me wind-up ~25% hi banta hai; sangat hai, paimana alag (absolute frames vs %) — Step 3 addendum me ek bhasha tay ho

name: Follow-through — child elements ko 2–5 frames peeche rakho
when: Multi-part element (character, lockup, card system) rukta/move karta ho
action: Child layers ke keyframes ko 2–5 frames offset rakho (ya ~0.05 s ka time-delay) taaki hisse ek saath na ruk kar ek ke baad ek settle hon
why: Sab kuchh ek hi frame par rukna nakli lagta hai; peeche chalte hisse wajan aur zindagi dete hain
evidence_note: Disney parampara (MIT skill sheet)
conflict_note: Stagger wale merged rule (D1-044) se sambandhit hai — ye khaas taur par rukne/settle hone ki follow-through hai

name: Exaggeration — asal se 20–50% aage
when: Character/brand animation me koi action padhne layak banana ho
action: Values ko realistic se 20–50% aage badhao — bade scales, chaudi rotations, zyada dramatic timing
why: Camera/screen par asal jitna hi dikhana feeka padta hai; thoda badha hua hi saaf padhta hai
frequency: Character/brand motion par; product UI par nahi (wahan D1-052 dekho)
evidence_note: Disney parampara (MIT skill sheet)
conflict_note: BADA TAKRAAV overshoot ki matra par: Maciejdziuba premium UI/product ke liye overshoot sirf 1.5–3% kehta hai (D1-052), LobzyJay follow-through ko move-distance ka 10–20% kehta hai (D1-061), aur LobzyJay ka pop example 110% (10% overshoot) hai — teen alag duniyayein (character animation / brand motion / premium UI); Step 3 addendum me context-wise faisla zaroori

name: Squash & stretch me volume constant rakho
when: Koi object dabta/kheenchta (squash-stretch) ho
action: Jab Y compress ho to X ko ulta expand karo — X × Y lagbhag constant rakho taaki object ka volume bana rahe
why: Bina volume-bachat ke deformation object ko phula hua ya pichka hua khilona bana deta hai
evidence_note: Disney parampara (MIT skill sheet)

name: Staging ki takneek — aankh ko ek hi jagah le jao
when: Frame me main subject ko ubharna ho
action: Depth of field/blur se background ko peeche rakho, vignette lagao, secondary elements ki opacity ghatao, aur main subject ko sabse zyada roshan rakho
why: Aankh sabse saaf/roshan cheez par jati hai — staging se darshak wahi dekhta hai jo dikhana hai
evidence_note: Disney parampara ki takneek (MIT skill sheet)
conflict_note: Dhyaan-anushaasan wale merged rule (D1-057) se sambandhit hai — ye usi baat ke haath ke upaay hain

name: Selects pehle, master baad me
when: Kisi naye project ki edit shuru ho (Premiere/AE dono)
action: Pehle bins/labels/markers ke saath ek selects sequence banao; structural beats aur shot ke maksad par markers lagao; master sequence uske baad hi banao
why: Seedha master banane se chunav aur banawat ek dusre me ghul jate hain aur galti mehngi padti hai
frequency: Har project me ek baar, shuruaat me
evidence_note: Workflow discipline (MIT skill notes)

name: Effect-heavy kaam alag rakho, intensity revise ho sake
when: Koi bhaari effect/compositing lagana ho
action: Effect-heavy kaam adjustment layers ya nests par rakho taaki uski intensity baad me revise ho sake; aur hamesha sabse chhota native tool chuno jo kaam kare
why: Clip par seedha chipka effect badalna mushkil hota hai; alag parat par rakha effect ek slider se kam-zyada ho sakta hai
evidence_note: Workflow discipline (MIT skill notes)

name: AE sirf zaroori shots ke liye — editorial structure ka badal nahi
when: Koi shot After Effects me bhejna ho
action: AE ko tracked graphics/compositing/typography ke liye rakho, editorial structure ke badle ke roop me nahi; sirf wahi shots bhejo jinhe zaroorat ho, handles bachakar bhejo, aur color management + motion blur wahan verify karo
why: Har shot ko AE me ghumana samay aur structure dono kharab karta hai; kataav (editing) NLE me hi rehta hai
evidence_note: Workflow discipline (MIT skill notes)

name: Editing DNA naapo — andaz se style copy mat karo
when: Kisi editor/brand ki style copy karni ho ya apni house style tay karni ho
action: Purane approved edits ko naap kar DNA nikalo: ASL (average shot length), pehle 5 s ka Hook ASL, cuts per minute, silence threshold, min silence, cut padding, SFX/music ke dB offsets — style ko shabdon me nahi, numbers me pakdo
why: Style ka andaz har baar badalta hai; naape hue numbers hi style ko dohrane layak banate hain
frequency: Har nayi style/brand ke liye ek baar; phir wahi numbers har video par
evidence_note: Method rule (MIT skill); numbers house ke apne corpus se aate hain

name: House pacing ka udaharan — Hook ASL 1.6 s, Body ASL 2.8 s
when: Tez house style ki pacing ka starting point chahiye
action: Udaharan DNA ke numbers se shuru karo: Hook ASL 1.6 s (pehle 5 s; scene-detect threshold gt(scene, 0.26)) aur Body ASL 2.8 s; phir apne corpus se inhe badlo
why: Ek kaam karke dikhaya gaya house number bina-naap ke andaz se behtar shuruaat deta hai
frequency: Pacing ka reference point; har video par sakhti se nahi
evidence_note: Ek editor ke style-template ke udaharan numbers (MIT skill) — universal study nahi
conflict_note: koptsev63 ki film/teaser pacing table (D1-075) isse bahut dheemi hai (hooks 4–6 s) — farak format ka hai (short-form house style vs film/teaser); Step 3 addendum me format-wise pacing saaf ho

name: Silence cutting ka house DNA — −35 dB, 0.28 s, padding 0.08 s
when: Silence-based cutting/auto-cut chalana ho
action: House settings: silence detect threshold −35 dB, kaatne layak kam se kam khamoshi 0.28 s, har cut ke aas-paas padding 0.08 s (80 ms)
why: Ye teen numbers milkar tay karte hain ki kataav kitna tez aur kitna saaf hoga
frequency: Har auto-cut pass par yehi DNA (jab tak naya naapa na jaye)
evidence_note: House DNA numbers (MIT skill)
conflict_note: TAKRAAV: min silence 0.28 s purane pause model (≥400 ms cut zone, ORDER #6) aur eacp1991 ke 250 ms floor (D1-013) ke beech me hai — teen alag thresholds (250/280/400) ka ek faisla Step 3 addendum me. Padding 0.08 s (80 ms) purane 30–200 ms window ke andar hai — sangat

name: Punch-in alternating — har dusre cut par 100% ↔ 112%
when: Talking-head/A-roll me jaan-boojh ki house style ke tor par punch-in lagana ho
action: Har dusre cut par scale badlo: ek cut 100%, agla 112% — isi alternating lay me poora video
why: Regular lay wala punch-in style ki pehchan ban jata hai aur static frame me harkat deta hai
frequency: Har dusre cut par, poore video me consistent
evidence_note: Ek house ki Editing DNA (MIT skill)
conflict_note: SEEDHA TAKRAAV purane faisle se (ORDER #5): punch-in sirf motivated, ≤10/min, gaps ≥4 s. Ye house style bina-wajah har dusre cut par punch-in karta hai — Body ASL 2.8 s par har dusra cut ≈ 10–11 baar/min banta hai, yaani purani hadd ke bilkul kinare/par. Step 3 addendum me house-style apvaad tay ho

name: B-roll dialogue ke upar — A1 ko kaate bina
when: B-roll schedule karna ho
action: Track banawat rakho: V1 = A-roll, V2 = B-roll, V3 = overlays/text; A1 = dialogue, A2 = SFX, A3 = music. B-roll ko transitions aur key points ke upar rakho lekin A1 dialogue ko kabhi mat kaato
why: B-roll ka kaam baat ko dikhana hai, kaatna nahi; dialogue ki nirantarta hi samajh ki neev hai
frequency: Har edit me yehi track anushaasan
evidence_note: Workflow/layout discipline (MIT skill)

name: House mix offsets — SFX −9 dB, music bed −20 dB
when: House style me final mix ke offsets tay karne hon
action: Dialogue ko 0 dB reference rakho; SFX uske −9 dB par, music bed −20 dB par (dialogue ke neeche ducked)
why: Reference ke saapeksh offsets har video me ek jaisi awaaz ki pehchan banate hain
evidence_note: House DNA numbers (MIT skill); dialogue ke relative naap hai
conflict_note: Music −20 dB purane relative band (18–25 dB neeche, ORDER #11) ke andar hai — takraav nahi. Lekin ADAM-0S ki absolute dBFS seedhi (D1-009) se naap ka aadhar alag hai — dono ko ek table me rakhna Step 3 addendum ka kaam

name: Element entrance ki ghadi — 0.4–1.2 s
when: Koi text/object/graphic screen par aaye
action: Har element ke entrance ko 0.4–1.2 s ke beech rakho — isse tez par hichki, isse dheere par susti; aur final state ko padhne layak der tak rukne do
why: Entrance ki ghadi hi element ka wajan batati hai; padhne ki rukawat ke bina aaya-gaya element register nahi hota
evidence_note: AE workflow craft (MIT skill sheet)
conflict_note: ishu86 ke bands (D1-092: UI 0.3–0.5 s, text reveal 0.8–1.2 s) is range se aadhe overlap karte hain — element ke prakar se band chunna Step 3 addendum me saaf ho

name: Timing ki hierarchy — ahem pehle, container pehle, focal aakhir me
when: Koi lockup/scene kai elements ke saath animate ho
action: Kram rakho: sabse ahem element (primary mark/logo) pehle ya 50 ms ki head-start ke saath aaye; container apne content se pehle move kare; baaki uske baad lay me aayein (jaise wordmark +80 ms, tagline uske +200 ms baad); sabse sajawati element sabse aakhir me aur sabse dheere land kare; focal element sabse aakhir ya sabse strong land kare
why: Jo pehle/strong land karta hai wahi aankh ka malik banta hai — hierarchy ka ulta matlab dhyaan ka ulta
evidence_note: Do AE skills ke sangat craft numbers

name: Overshoot me poora object react kare
when: Koi element overshoot ke saath land kare
action: Overshoot sirf ek dimension (jaise height) par mat rakho — poori cheez react kare (width, scale, position sab saath), aur element apni momentum ko aage carry-through kare
why: Aadha react karta object rubber ka khilona lagta hai; poora react karta object wajan wala lagta hai
evidence_note: AE craft (MIT skill sheet)
conflict_note: Overshoot ki MATRA par takraav D1-052/D1-061/D1-026 me darj hai — ye rule sirf react karne ke DHANG ki baat karta hai

name: Ek object ki saari properties ek hi frame par finish hon
when: Ek hi object ki kai properties (position/scale/opacity) animate hon
action: Un sabko ek hi frame par khatm karo — sync me; aur saath aane wale text/group ko ek saath treat karo, tukdo me nahi
why: Alag-alag frame par rukti properties object ko bikhra hua aur animation ko adhura dikhati hain
evidence_note: AE craft (MIT skill sheet)
conflict_note: Follow-through (D1-025) iska ulta nahi hai — wahan alag-alag OBJECTS offset hote hain, yahan EK object ki properties sync hoti hain

name: Number counter ki ghadi — 0.3 s ruk, 1.2 s ginti
when: Koi number/statistic animate hokar gina jaye
action: Counter ko 0.3 s ki delay ke baad shuru karo aur 1.2 s me ease ke saath target value tak pahunchao
why: Turant shuru hua counter nazar se chook jata hai; bina ease ki ginti machine jaisi lagti hai
evidence_note: AE preset craft (MIT skill sheet)

name: Motion blur — har moving layer par, shutter 180 default
when: Koi layer/element move kare (AE/motion work)
action: Motion blur har moving layer par ON rakho. Shutter angle ka default 180° (natural); crisp UI ke liye 90–120°, tez sweeps ke liye 200–300°; samples ~32. Blur ki matra velocity ke anupaat me rakho — jo element frame me sirf kuch pixels hi hilta hai us par blur OFF
why: Bina blur ke tez motion strobe karta hai; zyada blur chhoti harkat ko keechad bana deta hai
frequency: Har moving layer par; shutter context ke hisaab se
evidence_note: Do AE skills ke sangat craft numbers

name: Stagger — 2–5 frames ki lay, padhne ki disha me
when: Kai related elements (letters, cards, list items, sections) ek ke baad ek aayein
action: Elements ke beech 2–5 frames ka stagger rakho (text layers par 3–5 frames); stagger hamesha har element ki apni duration ka 10–20% rakho aur poori cascade ko ~24 frames ke andar band rakho. Samay me: letters ke liye tight 20–50 ms, lists/cards/words ke liye 50–100 ms, sections ke liye 100–200 ms. Kram padhne ki disha me rakho (upar se neeche, baayein se daayein); exits par stagger ulta chalao
why: Ek saath aate elements ek dhakka lagte hain; sahi stagger se aankh ek lay me poori list padh leti hai
evidence_note: Chaar AE sources ke sangat numbers ka merged band (2–5 frames)
conflict_note: Naap ki ikai sources me alag hai — koi frames deta hai, LobzyJay ms bands (20–200 ms) deta hai; 30 fps par dono takreeban milte hain, lekin fps badalne par frames wala band hi pakdo — Step 3 addendum me ikai tay ho

name: Motion piece = beats ki shrinkhala, ek lambi animation nahi
when: 10–15 s ka koi motion piece/intro/title sequence bane
action: Use 3–6 alag beats ki shrinkhala ki tarah banao — har beat visual roop se padhne layak, ek hi visual system ke andar; final lockup ko padhne layak samay do
why: Ek lambi behlti animation me koi pal yaad nahi rehta; beats ki shrinkhala hi chhoti kahani banti hai
frequency: Har 10–15 s motion piece par 3–6 beats
evidence_note: Motion-direction craft (MIT skill)

name: Attack tez, settle lamba — 2–4 frame attacks
when: Koi transition/move apne sabse tez hisse par ho
action: Attacks ko 2–4 frames me rakho aur settles ko usse hamesha lamba; ladkhadaata hua (sloppy) beech ka hissa kahin na ho
why: Tez attack urja deta hai, lamba settle wajan aur aitbaar — ulta karne par motion sust aur nakli lagta hai
evidence_note: Motion-direction craft (MIT skill)

name: Transition me hard cut pehle, crossfade aakhir me
when: Motion piece me scenes/beats ke beech transition chunna ho
action: Hard cuts, matte wipes, shutters aur element-led transitions ko pehle chuno; crossfade ko default mat bano
why: Crossfade sabse kamzor aur sabse zyada istemal hone wala transition hai — nirnayak transition hi piece ko professional deta hai
frequency: Har transition par pehle nirnayak vikalp socho
evidence_note: Motion-direction craft (MIT skill)

name: Ek piece, ek hi dominant visual grammar
when: Motion piece ka visual system tay ho
action: Poore piece me ek hi dominant visual grammar rakho (ek hi bhasha: type-led, ya shape-led, ya image-led); beech me dusri bhasha mat ghusao
why: Har scene nayi bhasha bole to piece bikhar jata hai; ek grammar hi pehchan aur aitbaar banati hai
evidence_note: Motion-direction craft (MIT skill)

name: Motion piece me nirnayak transition har 1.5–3 s
when: 10–15 s ka motion piece chal raha ho
action: Har 1.5–3 s par ek nirnayak (decisive) transition rakho — isse lamba sukha antaral piece ko thanda kar deta hai
why: Motion piece ki urja transition ki lay se banti hai; lambi khamoshi wahan susti hai
evidence_note: Motion-direction craft (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Purana default max visual gap 5 s (ORDER #2, talking video ke liye) isse dheema hai — ye 1.5–3 s ki lay SIRF motion-graphics pieces ke liye hai; Step 3 addendum me context alag saaf ho

name: Text zones hamesha saaf — microcopy ka bandobast
when: Frame me text/copy ke saath decorative elements hon
action: Decorative systems ko copy ke peeche ya kinare par rakho, text ke paas clutter kabhi nahi; aur chhota gray microcopy mat rakho — secondary text bhi padhne layak size/rang me ho
why: Text ke paas ki bheed padhna rok deti hai; na-padha-jane-wala text sirf shor hai
evidence_note: Motion-direction craft (MIT skill)

name: Amateur lage to pehle element count ghatao
when: Koi motion scene banana par bhi amateur/sasta lage
action: Pehla ilaaj hamesha dikhne wale elements ki ginti ghatana hai; aur final lockup ko beech ke scenes se simple aur zyada confident rakho
why: Zyada elements = zyada shor; sadgi hi mehenga dikhne ka sabse sasta raaz hai
frequency: Har amateur lagne wale scene par, effects badhane se pehle
evidence_note: Motion-direction craft (MIT skill)

name: Premium UI/product overshoot — sirf 1.5–3%
when: Premium/product/UI motion me element land kare
action: Overshoot ko sirf 1.5–3% rakho; damped settle ka namuna: 100 → 102 → 99.5 → 100 (frames 3/2/2 me)
why: Is duniya me zyada overshoot sasta padhta hai — premium ka matlab hai asar dikhe bina mehnat dikhe
evidence_note: Production-verified house craft (MIT skill repo, archived)
conflict_note: BADA TEEN-TARAFA TAKRAAV: dylantarre character animation ke liye exaggeration +20–50% kehta hai (D1-026); LobzyJay brand motion ke liye follow-through overshoot move-distance ka 10–20% aur pop 110% kehta hai (D1-061/D1-065); ye 1.5–3% SIRF premium UI/product ke liye hai. Step 3 addendum me context-wise table zaroori: UI/product 1.5–3% / brand 10–20% / character 20–50%

name: Easing kabhi symmetric nahi — asymmetric influence hi premium hai
when: Kisi bhi move ke keyframes par easing lagani ho
action: Keyframe influence ko jaan-boojh ke asymmetric rakho: premium ease-out ke liye key1 out ~12 / key2 in ~84; weighted hero in-out 38/78; pass-through 20 / 54-54 / 88; floor impact par 0.5/0.5 (bilkul cushioning nahi); apex/hang par 90/90. Aam taur par entrance par pehle key ka out-influence kam aur dusre ka in-influence zyada (mazboot ease-out ~80, halka ~33) rakho. Default Easy Ease (~33) ya symmetric 50/50 ko aakhri haal mat samjho
why: Symmetric/default easing hi amateur ki sabse pehchanne layak nishani hai; asymmetric curve hi wajan aur maksad deti hai
evidence_note: Do AE skills ke sangat craft numbers; asliyat me ye design ke faisle hain, naap nahi
conflict_note: LobzyJay ki chetaavni: easing ke numbers koi jaadu nahi — galat maksad par sahi number bhi bekaar hai; pehle faisla (entrance hai ya exit, halka hai ya bhaari), phir number

name: Exit hamesha entrance se tez — 0.6–0.8 guna
when: Koi element screen se jaye (exit animation)
action: Exit ki duration entrance ki 0.6–0.8 guna rakho aur exit par accelerate karke jao (ease-in) — dheere float karke kabhi mat ruko
why: Jaane wali cheez par darshak ka dhyaan pehle hi ja chuka hota hai; dheema exit susti aur anakalpan lagta hai
evidence_note: Do AE skills ke sangat craft numbers

name: Timing table 30 fps par — kaunsi harkat kitni lambi
when: Motion element ki duration tay karni ho
action: 30 fps par ye table rakho: opacity fade 5–8 frames (150–270 ms), chhota entrance 8–12 frames (250–400 ms), object/product entrance 12–18 frames (400–600 ms), exit 6–10 frames (200–330 ms), scene transition 15–24 frames (500–800 ms), hero camera move 24–45 frames (800–1500 ms)
why: Bina table ke har duration andaz banti hai aur poori piece ki lay bikhar jati hai
frequency: Har motion element ki duration par
evidence_note: Production house ki timing table (MIT skill repo, archived)
conflict_note: ishu86 transitions ko 0.5–1.5 s kehta hai (D1-093) — upari hadd par farak (0.8 vs 1.5 s); dhyaan do dono ke neeche ke band (0.5 s) milte hain. justajazz ke entrance band (D1-038) se bhi aadha overlap hai

name: Shadow ki teen paratein — kabhi pure black nahi
when: Kisi element ko realistic shadow deni ho
action: Shadow ko teen blurred copies se banao: contact (blur ~9, opacity ~21%), occlusion (blur ~22, opacity ~11%), ambient (blur ~64, opacity ~5%). Blur radius offset ka 2–3 guna rakho; vertical squash 30–40% rakho; shadow ka rang kabhi pure black nahi — halka cool dark violet/neutral rakho
why: Ek hi hard shadow nakli lagti hai; teen naram paratein aur rang-daar andhera hi asal roshni jaisa padhta hai
evidence_note: Production house ke look parameters (MIT skill repo, archived)

name: Dhyaan ka anushaasan — ek frame, zyada se zyada do maang
when: Frame ki composition/motion tay ho
action: Ek frame me do se zyada cheezein ek saath dhyaan na maangein; har frame me kam se kam ek crisp/sharp element rakho; aur jaan-boojh ke near-stillness (lagbhag sthirta) ke pal bhi rakho — sab kuchh har samay hilna zaroori nahi
why: Har hilti cheez chillaye to koi nahi sunai deta; sthirta ke pal hi harkat ko matlab dete hain
evidence_note: Do AE sources ke sangat dhyaan-niyam
conflict_note: dylantarre ki staging takneek (D1-028) isi anushaasan ko pane ke upaay deti hai — takraav nahi

name: Glow/bloom ka hisaab — stack aur frame ka hissa
when: Kisi element ko glow/bloom dena ho
action: Glow ko blurred copies ke stack se banao (jaise blur 4px/42%, 22px/17%, 92px/6% — radius dugna to opacity aadhi); bloom ko frame ke sirf 5–20% hisse tak rakho; glass/translucent cheezon par glow ke liye Screen mode rakho, Add nahi
why: Poora frame chamke to kuchh nahi chamakta; seemit bloom hi mehnga aur jaan-boojh ka lagta hai
evidence_note: Production house ke look parameters (MIT skill repo, archived)

name: Duration hi wajan hai — ms ki ghadi
when: Kisi bhi animation ki lambai (ms me) tay karni ho
action: Wajan ke hisaab se ghadi chuno: <150 ms = instant/mechanical, 150–250 ms = halka/UI, 250–500 ms = standard brand motion, 500 ms–1 s = bhaari/editorial, >1 s = cinematic (ya bas bahut dheema). Har cheez ko ek hi ~300 ms par mat chalao — sab kuchh ek jaisi ghadi par chalana cheezon ko wajan-rahit bana deta hai
why: Aankh lambai se hi wajan padhti hai — ek ghadi sab par matlab koi ghadi kisi par nahi
evidence_note: AE craft ghadi (MIT skill); frame-table (D1-023) se sangat
conflict_note: ishu86 ke bands (D1-092: UI 0.3–0.5 s) is ghadi ke 'standard brand' hisse me padte hain — UI ko yahan halka (150–250 ms) kaha gaya hai; chhota farak Step 3 addendum me tay ho

name: Anticipation — main action ka 20–30%
when: Koi badi harkat (move/launch/jump) animate ho
action: Anticipation ko main action ki duration ka 20–30% rakho (jaise 400 ms ke move se pehle 80–120 ms ki taiyaari); uski matra chhoti rakho — ~300 px ke move se pehle ulta disha me sirf ~15–25 px ka kheenchav
why: Bina taiyaari ki harkat teleport lagti hai; zyada taiyaari use sust bana deti hai
evidence_note: AE craft (MIT skill)
conflict_note: dylantarre ki frame-banawat (D1-024) me wind-up ~40-frame action ka ~25% banta hai — sangat; paimana alag hai (absolute frames vs pratishat)

name: Follow-through overshoot — move-distance ka 10–20%
when: Brand motion me element apni jagah par land kare
action: Landing par element ko target se aage move-distance ka 10–20% tak overshoot karao, phir use main duration ke 20–40% samay me settle karo; overshoot wala keyframe target ke 3–5 frames aage rakho; secondary elements ke aakhri keyframes primary ke 3–6 frames baad land hon
why: Thoda sa aage nikal kar wapas aana hi harkat ko zinda aur wajan-daar banata hai
evidence_note: AE craft (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Overshoot ke teen-taraffa takraav ka hissa (D1-052 me poora varnan): ye 10–20% brand motion ke liye hai; premium UI 1.5–3%, character exaggeration 20–50% — Step 3 addendum me context table bane

name: Inertial bounce ke tuned defaults
when: Landing ke baad element ko natural bounce/settle dena ho
action: Damped oscillation ke defaults se shuru karo: amp 0.04–0.12 (default ~0.08), freq 2.0–4.0 (default ~2.0–2.5), decay 4–8 (UI) / 2–4 (naram material) / default ~5; bounce ka asar pehle 1 s ke andar hi khatm ho jana chahiye (t < 1 s)
why: Andaz se lagaya bounce ya to hilta hi nahi ya jelly ban jata hai; ye defaults production me ghise hue hain
evidence_note: Teen AE sources ke sangat parameter sets ka merged band

name: Sequential reveal metronome jaisa na ho
when: Kai cheezein ek ke baad ek reveal hon (timings ki shrinkhala)
action: Reveals ke beech ke antar barabar mat rakho (200/400/600/800 ms jaisa metronome galat hai) — lay ko tod-tor kar rakho (jaise 0/180/340/550 ms)
why: Barabar antar machine jaisa lagta hai; tooti hui lay hi insaani taal aur dilchaspi deti hai
evidence_note: AE craft (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Stagger (D1-044) se takraav nahi — stagger ELEMENTS ke beech ka offset hai, ye bade reveals ke beech ke antar ki lay hai

name: Midpoint check — transition ka beech wala frame bhi design ho
when: Koi bhi transition bane
action: Transition ke 50% wale frame ko alag se dekho — wo kisi jaan-boojh ke design state jaisa lagna chahiye, do states ke beech ka dhundhla saump nahi
why: Darshak beech ke frame ko bhi dekhta hai; bekaar midpoint poori transition ko sasta kar deta hai
frequency: Har transition par ek baar check
evidence_note: AE craft (MIT skill)

name: Pop ka snap — 0 se 110%, phir 100%
when: Kisi element ko pop ke saath land karana ho
action: Scale ko 0 se shuru karke 0.25 s par 110% tak le jao, phir 0.4 s par 100% par settle karo
why: Thoda sa overshoot karke rukna hi pop ko padhne layak aur mazedaar banata hai
evidence_note: AE craft ka kaam kiya hua udaharan (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Iska 10% overshoot Maciejdziuba ke premium band (1.5–3%, D1-052) se takraata hai — ye brand/marketing pop ke liye hai, premium UI ke liye nahi; context table Step 3 addendum me

name: Exit ka raasta = entry ka ulta raasta
when: Koi element jis raaste se aaya tha usi se wapas jaye
action: Exit path ko entry path ka ulta rakho — jo neeche se aaya wo neeche hi jaye; alag raaste se gayab hona teleport jaisa lagta hai
why: Aankh cheez ko usi raaste par dhoondhti hai jahan se wo aayi thi; raasta badalna = cheez ka badal jana
frequency: Har exit par jahan entry bhi dikhi ho
evidence_note: AE craft (MIT skill)

name: Zoom aur pan ek saath kabhi nahi
when: Camera jaisi harkat (scale + position) design ho
action: Ek hi harkat me zoom aur pan dono mat chalao — pehle ek, phir dusra
why: Dono saath chalein to frame behka hua aur sasta lagta hai; aankh kisi ek ko bhi follow nahi kar pati
evidence_note: AE craft (MIT skill)

name: Camera move ki matra — push-in 2–6%, drift seemit
when: Koi camera jaisi harkat (push/drift/rotation) design ho
action: Matra seemit rakho: push-in 1–1.5 s me kul 2–6% zoom; lateral drift 1–2 s me 20–80 px; rotation 0.5–2° (jaan-boojh ke reveal par hi 3–5°); product shots ke liye lambi focal length jaisa ehsaas (70–120 mm ke barabar)
why: Camera ki harkat mehsoos honi chahiye, dikhni nahi — zyada matra hi use sasta bana deti hai
evidence_note: Production house ke camera numbers (MIT skill repo, archived)

name: Camera hamesha subject se dheema — 1.5–2.5 guna lambi ghadi
when: Subject aur camera dono move karein
action: Camera ki movement ki duration object ki duration ki 1.5–2.5 guna rakho; ek section me ek hi jaan-boojh ka camera idea rakho (push, ya track, ya orbit, ya parallax — sab nahi); bina maksad ka perpetual drift kabhi nahi
why: Tez camera harkat ko kha jata hai; dheema camera use wajan deta hai aur bhatkav mita deta hai
frequency: Har camera + subject wale scene par
evidence_note: Production house craft (MIT skill repo, archived)

name: Finish ki parat — halka grain, near-black background
when: Motion piece ka final polish/render ho
action: Project ko 16 bpc par rakho (32 bpc nahi — koi fayda nahi, sirf bojh); adjustment layer par 1.5–2% mono noise grain lagao (banding chhupta hai, premium texture aata hai); backgrounds ko near-black rakho, pure black (0,0,0) kabhi nahi
why: Banding aur khaali kaala rang hi do sabse aam 'sasta' nishaan hain; grain aur near-black dono ko ek saath sambhalte hain
evidence_note: Production house craft (MIT skill repo, archived)

name: Accent pop ki ghadi — chamak 0.13 s me peak
when: Chhota accent (sparkle/glint/star) pop karna ho
action: Pop ki ghadi rakho: scale 0 se shuru, lagbhag +0.13 s par peak (~135%) par, +0.50 s tak wapas 0; opacity flash +0.07 s tak 100 par aur +0.45 s tak khatm
why: Accent ka kaam ek pal ki chamak hai — dheema pop dhyaan kheench kar bojh ban jata hai
evidence_note: Preset craft ke kaam kiye hue numbers (MIT skill pack)

name: Visuals ko audio transients par bithao
when: Music/audio ke saath animation sync karni ho
action: Har visual event ko audio ke asal transient (hit/beat) par bithao; kadam-ka-antarr (step interval) recording se naapo — (aakhri hit − pehli hit) / (steps − 1) — aur pehle transient ko pehla visual event banao; BPM ka andaz mat lagao
why: Sync ka ehsaas naape hue transients se hi aata hai; andaz wala sync hamesha thoda off lagta hai
evidence_note: Preset craft (MIT skill pack)

name: Generated SFX ko pehle normalize karo — I=−16 LUFS
when: AI/generated SFX ko edit me milana ho
action: Generated SFX samples ko pehle loudnorm I=−16 LUFS : TP=−1.5 dB : LRA=11 par laakar phir pipeline me milao
why: Bina normalize kiye generated awaazein har baar alag zor par aati hain aur mix bikhar jata hai
frequency: Har generated SFX asset par, milane se pehle
evidence_note: Skill pack ka asset-prep number (MIT)
conflict_note: Ye ASSET-level normalization hai, final master ka loudness target nahi — purana master target −14 LUFS (YouTube) isse alag cheez hai; Step 3 addendum me asset vs master ka farak saaf likha jaye

name: Wiggle hamesha maksad ke saath
when: Kisi layer par wiggle/ambient harkat lagani ho
action: Wiggle ko maksad ke hisaab se chuno: ambient drift ke liye wiggle(0.5, 8), mechanical jitter ke liye wiggle(24, 2); bina-socha wiggle(5, 20) jaisa raw wiggle mat lagao — wo harkat nahi, shor hai
why: Har harkat ka matlab hona chahiye; matlab-rahit harkat frame ko sasta aur bechain karti hai
evidence_note: AE craft (MIT skill)

name: Shot ki lambai beat ke prakar se — film/teaser ghadi
when: Film/teaser/documentary ki pacing tay ho
action: Beat ke hisaab se shot rakho: establishing/breath 5–8 s, hook/opening reveal 4–6 s, comedy beat 4–5 s, rhythmic action montage 2–4 s prati shot, interview/talking head 5–7 s (5 s se kam par baat kati hui lagti hai), title card 3–5 s (zor se padho + 1 s)
why: Har beat ki apni saans hoti hai — sab par ek ghadi chalana hi pacing ko marta hai
frequency: Har shot ka chunav isi ghadi se
evidence_note: Film-editing craft table (MIT skill); Murch parampara se sambandhit
conflict_note: Short-form house pacing (D1-033: Hook ASL 1.6 s) se bahut dheema — ye film/teaser ki ghadi hai; format ke hisaab se chunav Step 3 addendum me. Title card 3–5 s ishu86 (D1-093) se bilkul milta hai — sangat

name: Sabse bade pal ko sabse lambi ghadi do
when: Emotional climax/payoff/end title ka shot tay ho
action: Cinematic/emotional center ko 6–8 s, climax/payoff reveal ko 6–10 s (ye rhythm ke aam niyamo ko override karta hai), aur end title ko 6–10 s rakho
why: Sabse ahem pal ko sabse zyada waqt hi kahani ka hisaab hai — wahan jaldi karna matlab payoff ko sasta karna
evidence_note: Film-editing craft table (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Tez-pacing wale purane rules (jaise max gap/ASL wale) se disha ka takraav hai — source khud kehta hai ye beats rhythm rules ko override karte hain; ORDER ki kahani-sabse-upar wali seedhi bhi yahi kehti hai

name: Lambai ka ratio — sabse lamba shot sabse chhote ka 2–4 guna
when: Kisi teaser/sequence ki shot lambaiyan tay hon
action: Sabse lambe shot ko sabse chhote ke 2–4 guna ke andar rakho; chaar lagatar shots ek hi lambai ke kabhi mat rakho; aur teen sabse ahem emotional beats ko hi teen sabse lambe shots banao
why: Ek-jaisi lambai lay ko sust karti hai; lambai ka utaar-chadhaav hi ehsaas ki seedhi hai
evidence_note: Film-editing craft (MIT skill)

name: Blink cut point — soch ke aakhir par kaato
when: Dialogue/performance me cut point chunna ho
action: Cut ko soch ke aakhir par rakho; actor ki palak jhapakne (blink) wala frame cut-point ka swabhavik ummeedvaar hai — palak band hote hi cut chhupta hai
why: Insaan soch badalte waqt palak jhapakta hai — wahi pal darshak ke liye bhi cut ki swabhavik jagah hai
frequency: Har performance cut par pehla ummeedvaar yahi
evidence_note: Murch ki blink theory ka operational roop (MIT skill); vigyaan harvest me ye siddhant pehle se hai — ye uska Premiere istemal hai, nakal nahi
conflict_note: Purane Murch/science rules se takraav nahi — unhi ka vyavharik roop hai

name: Misdirection — cut ko harkat ya awaaz ke dhakke peeche chhupao
when: Koi cut zyada dikh raha ho
action: Cut point par achanak harkat ya sound spike (darwaza band, taali jaisi tez awaaz) rakho — darshak ka dhyaan wahan jayega aur cut ghayab ho jayega
why: Aankh aur kaan hamesha sabse tez nayi cheez ke peeche bhagte hain — usi pal me seam ghul jati hai
evidence_note: Film-editing craft (MIT skill)
conflict_note: ADAM-0S ke invisible-cut upaayo (D1-003) se sambandhit — ye sirf cut-point wale dhakke ki baat karta hai

name: Idea cut jaan-boojh ke — jahaan matlab takkar se bane
when: Documentary/teaser/montage me do shots jodne hon
action: Wahan idea cuts lagao jahan do shots ki takkar se teesra matlab banta hai; narrative/continuity wali jagah par continuity cuts rakho — dono ko jaan-boojh ke alag rakho, galti se mishrit nahi
why: Idea cut hi montage ki jaan hai; galat jagah laga idea cut sirf gadbad lagta hai
evidence_note: Film-editing craft (MIT skill)

name: Decisive moment — out-point us par ya uske just baad
when: Har clip ka out-point tay ho
action: Pehle clip ka decisive frame pehchano (jahan pal apne matlab par pahunchta hai); out-point ko usi par ya uske just baad rakho — usse pehle kabhi nahi
why: Decisive pal se pehle kaata clip apni baat aadhi keh kar ruk jata hai
evidence_note: Film-editing craft (MIT skill)

name: Stabilize sirf outliers ko — blanket kabhi nahi
when: Handheld footage ko stabilize karna ho
action: Sirf un shots ko stabilize karo jo baakio ke muqable me zyada hilte hain (relative outliers); poori film par blanket stabilization kabhi mat chalao
why: Zyada safai jaan-boojh ki handheld urja ko maar deti hai — documentary ka sach hi us harkat me hai
evidence_note: Film-editing pipeline craft (MIT skill)

name: Black card ke neeche room tone — khamoshi kabhi nahi
when: Video me koi black card/blank aaye
action: Black card ke neeche hamesha room tone rakho; poori khamoshi (silence) kabhi mat rakho
why: Asli khamoshi darshak ko 'video ruk gaya/band ho gaya' jaisa ehsaas deti hai; room tone use zinda rakhta hai
evidence_note: Film-editing pipeline craft (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Paheli lage to: 'a talking cut is never silent' wala usi skill ka usool bhi yahi disha deta hai

name: End card fade ke baad, black par
when: End card/title lagana ho
action: End card ko fade ke BAAD, black ke upar rakho — aakhri frame ke upar title chipkana galat hai
why: Aakhri frame par chipka title dono ko kharab karta hai; black par saaf card hi khatma deta hai
evidence_note: Film-editing pipeline craft (MIT skill)

name: Jumla-cut ki padding — 0.25 s pehle, 0.35 s baad
when: Rough cut me jumlo (sentences) ke hisse kaate jayein
action: Har hisse ko pehle shabd se lagbhag 0.25 s pehle shuru karo aur aakhri shabd ke lagbhag 0.35 s baad khatm karo — hamesha asal source pause ke ANDAR rehkar; pause ke beech me kabhi mat kaato; agar chhota pause do hisso me bantna pade to 60% outgoing tail ko do. ASR timestamps ko ±0.2 s ki galti ke saath lo
why: Ye saans ki jagah hi bol ko insaani rakhti hai; kas kar kaata jumla ghuta hua lagta hai
evidence_note: Rough-cut tool ke kaam kiye hue numbers (MIT skill)
conflict_note: TAKRAAV purane padding model se: purana edge padding 30–200 ms hai (frame-edge suraksha ke liye); ye 250/350 ms jumla-star ki saans hai — dono ki jagah alag hai lekin numbers takraate dikhte hain; Step 3 addendum me dono ki paribhasha alag saaf ho. eacp1991 ke margins (D1-014, 30–200 ms) se bhi yahi sambandh hai

name: 30 ms ke andar speech = CLIPPED (shabd kata mana jayega)
when: Koi cut speech ke paas gire
action: Agar cut se 30 ms ke andar speech hai to use defect mano — shabd kata hua hai; cut ko hamesha asli pause ke beech me rakho
why: Shabd ke kinare ka kataav sunne me sabse pehle pakda jata hai — yehi sabse sasti galti hai
evidence_note: Defect-lint ka threshold (MIT skill)
conflict_note: eacp1991 ka 60 ms crossfade niyam (D1-012) isse sakht hai — dono sangat disha me hain: 30 ms = kataav ki hadd, 60 ms = saaf cut ki shart

name: Room tone ka jump 6 dB se zyada = defect
when: Do hisso ke beech cut lage
action: Cut ke dono taraf ke room tone me 6 dB se zyada ka jump defect hai (LEVEL_JUMP) — room tone ka mel rakho, warna cut kaan ko sunai dega bhale dikhai na de
why: Kaan background ke badlav ko tasveer ke badlav se pehle pakadta hai
evidence_note: Defect-lint ka threshold (MIT skill)

name: 0.5 s se chhota tukda = SLIVER — mat rakho
when: Cut ke baad koi bahut chhota tukda bane
action: 0.5 s se chhote tukde ko hamesha hatao ya padosi me milao — sirf tab rakho jab wo music/SFX ke neeche jaan-boojh ka rakha fragment ho
why: Aadhe second ka tukda darshak ko sirf jhatka deta hai, koi matlab nahi
evidence_note: Defect-lint ka threshold (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Shorts/teaser ke jaan-boojh ke tez tukdo (jaise mmmnhat ke <1.5 s teaser shots) se takraav sambhav hai — apvaad sirf jaan-boojh ke fragments ke liye hai, Step 3 addendum me saaf ho

name: Click hatana ho to aakhri 2 frames fade karo
when: Cut par click sunai de aur outgoing shabd soft decay par khatm ho raha ho
action: Shabd ko kaatne ki jagah outgoing audio ke aakhri 2 frames par fade lagao — click jayega, shabd bachega
why: Click ka ilaaj shabd kaatna nahi hai; 2-frame fade sabse halka aur surakshit ilaaj hai
evidence_note: Rough-cut craft (MIT skill)
conflict_note: ADAM-0S ka 2–4 frame crossfade niyam (D1-008) isi ka vistarit roop hai — sangat

name: Repeated take me sirf ek — aakhri complete take
when: Ek hi passage ke kai takes/repeats hon
action: Direction/setup wali chatter hamesha kaato; repeated passages me bilkul ek hi take rakho — aakhri complete take
why: Do aadhe takes jodne se behtar ek poora take hai; chatter kahani ko sirf dheema karti hai
evidence_note: Rough-cut craft (MIT skill)

name: Bina-wajah ka A/V cut mismatch = defect
when: Video (V1) aur audio (A1) ke cut points alag jagah par hon
action: Agar A/V cuts kuch frames idhar-udhar hain aur uski koi wajah nahi hai to use defect mano — cuts ek hi jagah par rakho
why: Bina wajah ka mismatch edit ko bikharra hua dikhata hai; jaan-boojh ka offset hi split edit kehlata hai
evidence_note: Defect-lint (MIT skill)
conflict_note: ADAM-0S ke split-edit niyam (D1-001) se takraav NAHI hai — wahan offset jaan-boojh ka aur 6–12 frames ka hota hai; ye sirf bina-wajah ke chhote mismatch ki baat hai

name: Chhote elements ki ghadi — UI 0.3–0.5 s, text reveal 0.8–1.2 s
when: Chhote motion elements (UI, text, logo/CTA) ki duration tay ho
action: Bands rakho: UI elements 0.3–0.5 s, text reveals 0.8–1.2 s (kuch guidelines 0.5–1.5 s tak jati hain), logo/CTA reveal overshoot ke saath 0.4–0.6 s
why: Har prakar ke element ki apni padhne ki ghadi hai — UI ko text jitna aur text ko UI jitna samay dena dono galat hai
frequency: Har chhote element ki duration par
evidence_note: Motion guide ke timing bands (MIT skill)
conflict_note: justajazz ka aam entrance band 0.4–1.2 s (D1-038) inse overlap karta hai; LobzyJay ki ms-ghadi (D1-059) UI ko 150–250 ms kehti hai — 0.3–0.5 s usse dheema hai; element-prakar wise faisla Step 3 addendum me

name: Bade pieces ki ghadi — logo 1–3 s, title card 3–5 s, loop 2–4 s
when: Poora logo animation, title card, transition ya ambient loop bane
action: Bands rakho: poora logo animation 1–3 s, title cards 3–5 s, transitions 0.5–1.5 s, ambient loops 2–4 s
why: Bade pieces ko chhoto ki ghadi dene se wo ghate hue lagte hain, aur ulta karne se sust
frequency: Har bade piece ki duration par
evidence_note: Motion guide ke timing bands (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Title card 3–5 s koptsev63 (D1-075) se bilkul milta hai — sangat. Transitions 0.5–1.5 s ki upari hadd Maciejdziuba ke 0.5–0.8 s (D1-055) se takraati hai — neeche ka band (0.5) dono me ek hai

name: Spring presets — mood ke hisaab se spring chuno
when: Spring-based motion ka ehsaas tay karna ho
action: Mood se spring chuno: gentle/soft = stiffness 80, damping 20 (koi overshoot nahi); default = 100/10 (halka overshoot); wobbly/playful = 150/8 (zyada overshoot); stiff/snappy = 200/20; slow/heavy = mass 3 ke saath 100/15; visual bounce chahiye to 200/5; tez UI feedback = mass 0.5 ke saath 300/20
why: Spring ke numbers hi ehsaas hain — ek hi spring har mood par chalana sab ko ek jaisa bana deta hai
frequency: Har spring animation par mood ke hisaab se ek preset
evidence_note: Motion guide ke physics presets (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Inertial bounce wale defaults (D1-062) se sambandhit hai — wahan damped oscillation AE expressions me hai, yahan spring physics ke presets hain; takraav nahi

name: Parallax ki gehrai — 0.2 / 0.5 / 1.0
when: Parallax/depth wala scene bane
action: Ek hi controller ko animate karo aur layers ko uske ansh (fraction) do: door ka background 0.2, midground 0.5, foreground 1.0
why: Har layer ko alag se animate karna bikharav hai; ek controller ke fractions se gehrai khud-ba-khud sahi banti hai
evidence_note: Motion guide craft (MIT skill)

name: Aakhri frame murda na baithe — slow push-in rakho
when: Koi reveal/logo animation apne end frame par ruke
action: End frame par halka slow push-in rakho taaki final frame zinda lage, murda still na lage
why: Bilkul ruka hua aakhri frame video ko khatm nahi, atak gaya mehsoos karata hai
frequency: Har reveal ke end frame par
evidence_note: Motion guide craft (MIT skill)
conflict_note: Maciejdziuba ke perpetual-drift mana karne (D1-069) se halka tanav hai — ye sirf END frame par halka push-in hai, poore scene ka drift nahi

name: Chapter ka 5-beat spine
when: Har chapter (travel/long-form) ki planning aur review par
action: Har chapter me paanchon beat hon: context, movement, lived-in texture, destination payoff, aftertaste/handoff. Jo beat gayab ho, use pehle footage se repair karo — effects ya BGM hit se kabhi nahi
why: Chapter sirf jagah ki list ban jata hai to viewer ko safar mehsoos nahi hota; movement aur texture hi kahani ko aage badhate hain
frequency: Har chapter = 5/5 beats; missing beat = structure kaam, effect ka kaam nahi
evidence_note: Ek travel-studio skill ka house structure contract; koi measured corpus nahi

name: Opening: 40s me vaada, 60s me saboot
when: Video ke pehle minute me, khaas taur par travel/long-form opening me
action: Pehle 40 second me asli destination/route footage par viewer promise rakho; pehle 60 second ke andar readable destination proof do (aerial, skyline, coast ya landmark)
why: Pehla minute hi decide karta hai ki viewer rukega ya jayega; vaada bina saboot ke clickbait lagta hai
evidence_note: House opening contract; koi platform data nahi

name: Pehle 3 minute: arrival aur texture, payoff se pehle
when: Opening ke baad pehle chapter tak ke hisse me
action: Minute 3 se pehle practical arrival dikhao (station, hotel, street) aur pehle chapter payoff se pehle lived-in texture rakho; pehla handoff movement/street/hotel/food/weather/signage bridge se ho, hard reset se nahi
why: Viewer ko pehle jagah par 'pahuncha' hua mehsoos hona chahiye, tabhi payoff ka matlab banta hai
frequency: Arrival <3:00; texture hamesha pehle payoff se pehle
evidence_note: House opening contract

name: Long-form ki ghadi: 20-minute wali shape
when: Long-form travel film (target ~20 min) ki structure planning me
action: Shape rakho: opening route promise 35–60s, 4–6 main chapters har ek 2.5–5 minute, transitions 15–45s, ending 45–75s callback/aftertaste ke saath. 1–2 minute ki short-video pacing long-form par default nahi
why: Lambi film ko saans aur route chahiye; short pacing se 20 minute ki film thaka deti hai
evidence_note: Ek reference-style (Bilibili long-form travel) se liya house target; measured nahi

name: Har chapter ko barabar time nahi
when: Chapter durations tay karte waqt
action: Jis chapter ke paas strong footage, rich human moments, saaf local texture ya zyada route-matlab hai, use zyada time do; kamzor chapter sirf bridge ki bhumika me chhota rahe
why: Barabar time dene se film calendar jaisi lagti hai, kahani jaisi nahi
frequency: koi fixed ratio nahi; strong chapter > bridge chapter hamesha
evidence_note: House structure niyam

name: Payoff-se-payoff jump = slideshow
when: Chapter boundaries aur bade jagah-badal par
action: Ek payoff shot ke seedha dusre payoff shot par mat jao — beech me movement/texture support rakho. Aftertaste hamesha chapter ke AAKHIR me rakho, shuru me nahi
why: Sirf 'best shots' jodne se tourist slideshow banta hai; beech ka safar hi film hai
frequency: Har chapter boundary par ≥1 movement/texture support shot
evidence_note: House scene-flow contract

name: Route task-chain hamesha samajh aaye
when: Departure/arrival jaise practical chapters (hotel→airport→flight) me
action: Chain ko padhne layak rakho: leave → handoff → travel → arrive → process → threshold → new state. Viewer ko har pal current jagah, current action aur agli manzil pata ho. Action continuity (haath, samaan, darwaze, signs, chalne ki disha) effect continuity se zyada mazboot join hai
why: Practical safar ki kahani kaam ke steps se banti hai; ek step gayab ho to viewer kho jata hai
frequency: Har phase ke paas ≥1 pehchan wala anchor shot
evidence_note: Ek 6:13 homeward film ki poori review se nikali grammar (non-copying profile)

name: Ending nayi state par, 3–6s thehrao ke saath
when: Video/chapter ke aakhiri shot par
action: Ending wahan rakho jahan traveller kisi nayi state me pahunch jaye (seat, window, arrival); uske baad suitable footage ho to 3–6 second stable aftertaste hold rakho. Chalte hue movement ke beech abrupt cut se khatam mat karo
why: Badli hui halat par rukna hi band hone ka ehsaas deta hai
evidence_note: Usi homeward review se; house niyam

name: Story plan cutting se pehle; beech-idea cut kabhi nahi
when: Koi bhi talking-head/social edit shuru karne se pehle
action: Pehle story plan likho: hook/agenda → body beats → recap/CTA ('jo bologe wo batao, batao, phir bataya hua dohrao'). Duration ghataane ke liye idea ko beech se kabhi mat kaato; word-boundary edits ki jagah lambe coherent blocks ko tarjeeh do
why: Plan bina kaatne se achhe hisse kat jate hain aur baat adhoori reh jati hai
frequency: Har video = 1 story plan pehle; mid-idea cut = 0
evidence_note: Editor ke production standard se

name: Narration sparse rakho, khamoshi ko kaam karne do
when: Long-form travel narration likhte waqt
action: Spoken paragraphs sparse rakho; 20-minute film me voiceover kul chand minute hi ho sakta hai. 20–60 second ke hisse aise chhodo jahan sirf source audio, BGM aur visuals film ko aage le jayein. Jo dikh raha hai use bolkar mat samjhao
why: Har cheez bol dene se film lecture ban jati hai; nazara khud bhi bolta hai
frequency: Quiet stretches 20–60s; narration kabhi wall-to-wall nahi
evidence_note: House narration style

name: Reference se seekho, copy nahi; route par imaandari
when: Kisi reference film ko style guide banate waqt
action: Reference se pacing, structure aur rhythm seekho — uske titles, narration lines, music ya footage copy kabhi nahi. Location pakka na ho to narration/plan me confidence bhasa rakho: confirmed / visually likely / route scaffold only / needs human review
why: Copy ki hui pehchan pakdi jati hai aur galat location film ki sachchai tod deta hai
frequency: Copy = 0; har uncertain location par confidence label
evidence_note: House non-copying + route-honesty contract

name: Footage selection selective rakho, local pehle
when: Pehli assembly se pehle footage chunte waqt
action: Clip sirf isliye timeline me nahi aata ki woh exist karta hai. Pehle local footage, stock baad me. Kisi clip ko final reject karne se pehle full-duration, in-motion review karo — filename/metadata sirf review ke hints hain, faisla nahi
why: Sab kuch daal dene se film bhari ho jati hai; aur bina dekhe reject karne se best moment haath se jata hai
frequency: Har final reject = full in-motion review ke baad hi
evidence_note: House footage-select contract (temporal scan ka ~99.5% coverage bar usi skill ke acceptance criteria me hai)

name: Kharaab-par-unique clip, saaf generic scenic se upar
when: Do clips me se ek chunna pade to
action: Technically imperfect lekin unique story/emotion wala clip saaf lekin generic scenic shot se upar rank karo
why: Viewer ko perfection nahi, pal yaad rehta hai
evidence_note: House selection niyam

name: Shot tiers aur function ka badlav
when: Creator cut / clip classification me
action: Har clip ko tier do: Hero / Main / Texture-bridge / Utility / Reject. Ek hi function wale do adjacent clips ke beech alag function wala clip daalo
why: Ek hi kaam ke shots lagatar aane se film ek-ras (monotone) ho jati hai
frequency: Adjacent same-function pair = 0 (beech me alag function)
evidence_note: House creator-cut contract

name: B-roll = saboot, sajawat nahi
when: Cutaway/B-roll lagate waqt
action: Har B-roll ke saath uska claim/beat/problem note karo — woh kis baat ka saboot hai ya kis cut ko dhak raha hai. B-roll pehle dhoondo aur WATCH karo, phir action/story ke hisaab se kaato; filler ke liye kabhi nahi
why: Bina-kaam ka B-roll viewer ko turant 'stock' lagta hai aur bharosa todta hai
evidence_note: Do alag editor sources ka ek hi niyam (production standard + vlog workflow note)

name: Rough cut me editor-notes aur punchlines bachaao
when: Rough cut me retakes/dead air saaf karte waqt
action: Speaker ki khud ki 'notes-to-editor' wali baatein aur punchlines ko galti se mat kaato — ye hamesha protect list me rakho
why: Ye woh hisse hain jo creator ne jaan-bujh kar rakhe hain; kaatna = kahani ka nuksaan
frequency: Protect list = har rough cut se pehle tay
evidence_note: Note source: editor workflow apne shabdon me

name: Screencast: shuru 15–30s 'kya aur kyun', aakhir me uplabdhi
when: Screen-recording/tutorial videos me
action: Pehle 15–30 second me batao kya bana rahe hain aur kyun. Aakhir me accomplishment/diff summary do — video beech safar me khatam mat karo
why: Viewer ko manzil pehle pata ho to beech ke steps sehne layak ho jate hain
evidence_note: Ek screencast editor ki house style

name: Captions sirf darshak ke liye
when: Final SRT/TXT narration lines likhte waqt
action: Har caption line audience ke liye ho: travel narration, route context, emotion ya visual observation. Workflow state wali baatein captions me KABHI nahi — 'QA pass', 'V14', 'Resolve', 'SRT', 'ye fix ho gaya' jaisi editor-bhasha block hai
why: Ek bhi andar-ki-baat wala caption poori film ko machine-bani hui ghoshit kar deta hai
evidence_note: House caption contract

name: Title zones me subtitles band
when: Opening/chapter/ending title windows me
action: Title chal raha ho to us window me rendered subtitle overlay suppress ya trim karo, jab tak user khaas taur par captions-over-title na maange. Scenic/title windows BGM-led rakho
why: Title aur caption ek saath ladte hain — dono padhne mushkil ho jate hain
evidence_note: House subtitle-overlay contract

name: Bina-voiceover film me captions hi kahani
when: Jab voiceover na ho aur TXT/SRT hi narrative layer ho
action: Captions itne dense rakho ki route, emotion aur visual imaandari carry kar sakein — planning target kam se kam 4 cues/minute rakho (slow reference profile justify kare to hi kam)
why: Awaaz na ho to kam captions wala hissa khaali aur khoya hua lagta hai
evidence_note: House caption-density target

name: Caption highlight: line me sirf 1–3 shabd
when: Word-highlight/karaoke style captions banate waqt
action: Har caption line me sirf 1–3 important shabd highlight karo. Hierarchy: action verbs > numbers > emotional words. Filler/modifier shabd ('this', 'my', 'completely') kabhi highlight nahi
why: Sab kuch highlight = kuch bhi highlight nahi; aankh ko ek hi jagah rukna chahiye
evidence_note: CapCut director brain ki caption intelligence

name: Captions: pehle proofread, aakhir me finishing pass
when: Caption workflow ke dono sire par
action: Captions ko import karne se PEHLE saaf aur proofread karo (single-line default). Caption-only finishing pass sirf approved cut par chalao — word-level timing check karo aur sirf high-confidence domain terms fix karo
why: Gande captions import karke theek karna doguna kaam hai; aur cut badalne ke baad caption pass bekaar ho jata hai
frequency: Proofread = import se pehle; finishing pass = sirf approved cut par
evidence_note: Do sources: vlog workflow note + Resolve production standard

name: Burned-in captions dikhne wala layer ho
when: Caption delivery check par
action: Sirf SRT file deliverable nahi hai — burned-in captions timeline me ek visible layer ke roop me hone chahiye aur final render me dikhne ka saboot ho
why: File hai lekin render me caption nahi — ye sabse chhupa hua delivery fail hai
frequency: Har delivery = rendered caption ka visual saboot
evidence_note: Production standard ki QA shart

name: Vertical: aankhein upar-wale third me, captions surakshit jagah
when: Vertical (9:16) framing aur caption placement me
action: Speaker ki aankhein frame ke upper third ke aas-paas rakho. Captions ko chehra/munh aur platform UI ke danger zones se bahar rakho; key lines proofread karo
why: UI ke neeche daba caption = na padha gaya caption
frequency: Caption kabhi face/mouth/UI-safe-zone ke bahar nahi
evidence_note: Do sources: Resolve social editor + CapCut mobile workflow

name: Bolne wala dikhe; B-roll emotion ko na dhake
when: Talking-head par B-roll lagate waqt
action: Spoken sections ke dauran speaker visible rakho. Crucial face/emotion beats par B-roll mat lagao — cutaway phrase land hone ke baad, saans par ya naye idea par rakho
why: Jazbaat chehre par hote hain; galat jagah cutaway usi pal ko chura leta hai
evidence_note: Production standard se

name: Screencast samajh: intent bolo, action nahi
when: Screen-recording narration aur annotations me
action: Har interaction se pehle context do; fast-forward hisse me khaas taur par narration rakho. Jo prompt text screen par poora na dikhe, use caption karo. Annotations phase ka label dein. Narration 'main ye click kar raha hoon' ki jagah intent bataye
why: Bina intent ke screen sirf harkat hai; viewer ko 'kyun' chahiye
evidence_note: Screencast editor ki house style

name: Narration ka har daava saboot se bandha ho
when: Narration/caption lines likhte waqt
action: Har claim actual route evidence ya user-confirmed context se bandha ho. Jo cheez screen par khud dikh rahi hai use bolkar repeat mat karo
why: Bina saboot ke daave aur dikhi cheez ki commentary — dono bharosa ghataate hain
evidence_note: House narration niyam

name: Title/lower-third: timing aur font ki discipline
when: Animated titles aur lower-thirds banate waqt
action: Lower-third slide-in ~12 frames rakho (~0.5s @24fps); typewriter follower delay 2 frames per character. Font medium-to-bold sans rakho (Open Sans Extrabold jaisa default). Timing perfect hone ke baad hi use macro/template me save karo. Animated title ke liye Text+ istemaal karo, basic Text nahi
why: Dheere-dheere ghusne wala lower-third purana lagta hai; halka font mobile par ghul jata hai
evidence_note: Resolve titles workflow se

name: Marker discipline: EDL se, rang-tiers ke saath
when: Resolve me review markers lagate waqt
action: Markers EDL ke through lagao (Resolve FCP7 XML ke clip colours ignore karta hai). Colour tiers fixed rakho: A = Red, flash frames = Fuchsia, B = Yellow, C = Blue, notes/re-record = Green
why: Marker ka rang hi team ki bhasha hai; rang badla to matlab badla
evidence_note: Note source: dusre editor ke workflow apne shabdon me

name: Pehle mapo (measure), phir raay do
when: Kisi bhi editorial faisle se pehle
action: Pacing/audio/structure par pehle scripts se numbers nikalo, editorial opinion uske baad do
why: Bina map ke raाय andaz hai; numbers behes khatam karte hain
frequency: Har bada faisla = pehle ek measured report
evidence_note: Note source

name: HOW aur WHAT alag rakho: preset pehle padho
when: Koi bhi edit lane chalane se pehle
action: Pehle WHAT padho — preset: look, numbers, done ki definition. Phir HOW chalao — lane ke steps. Dono ko mix mat karo
why: Bina 'done kya hai' jaane steps chalana = ghumte rehna
frequency: Har kaam = pehle preset read, phir execution
evidence_note: Note source

name: Do-stage soch: pehle creative, phir tool
when: AI/editor se edit plan banwate waqt
action: Stage 1 me tool/catalog ka zikr kiye bina pure creative analysis karo (pacing, emotion, energy, weak spots). Stage 2 me hi suggestions ko asal tool/asset names se ground karo
why: Catalog pehle dikha do to soch catalog ke andar hi band ho jati hai; aur bina grounding ke plan chalaya nahi ja sakta
frequency: Har plan = 2 stages, isi kram me
evidence_note: CapCut director ka core design niyam

name: Har edit ka 'kyun' aur weak spots saaf likho
when: Edit plan/review dete waqt
action: Har action ke saath uski wajah likho. Dead air, pacing drops jaise weak spots chhupao mat — explicitly flag karo. Subjective choices par 2–3 alternatives do taaki editor control me rahe
why: 'Kyun' bina ka plan order hai; kyun ke saath woh direction hai
frequency: Actions bina why = 0; weak spots sab flag
evidence_note: CapCut director ke output niyam

name: Handoff ke liye layered timeline
when: Timeline kisi insaan ko saumpte waqt
action: Timeline layered rakho: disabled/backup tracks ka naam 'DISABLED' rakho, taaki agla editor bina puche samajh jaye ki kya live hai aur kya rakha hua hai
why: Gandi timeline dusre ke liye band kamra hai
evidence_note: Production standard se

name: Pehli-pass ki taqseem: insaan = taste, agent = mazdoori
when: AI agent ke saath edit ka kaam baant-te waqt
action: Insaan taste aur film-sense ke faisle rakhe; agent transcribe/log/detect jaise labour kare. Agent raw footage kabhi modify nahi karta — woh sirf ADD karta hai
why: Taste machine ko dena aur mazdoori insaan karna — ulta batenwara kaam kharab karta hai
frequency: Division = har project ki shuruaat me tay
evidence_note: Note source

name: Creative azadi: template nahi, video ki energy
when: Har naye video ki analysis par
action: Har video ko independently analyze karo. Rigid genre rules ('funny hai to X karo') default mat banao. Video ki unique energy hai to usi par lean karo, safe defaults par nahi
why: Template-har-video ek jaisi film banata hai; energy har video ki alag hoti hai
evidence_note: CapCut director ka creative-freedom rule

name: Travel shot-lengths: reference se calibrate
when: Long-form travel pacing set karte waqt
action: Ek poori tarah review ki hui homeward travel film ke measured numbers ko calibration anchor rakho: average shot ~10.4s, median ~10.1s, p10 ~3.1s, p90 ~17.9s. Apni film ke avg/median shot lengths in reference-calibrated ranges ke andar rakho
why: Long-form travel ki saans short-video se bilkul alag hai; bina anchor ke pacing ya to sust ya to bechain ho jati hai
frequency: Anchor: avg ≈10.4s, median ≈10.1s, p90 ≈17.9s (ek film ka map)
evidence_note: Ek asli film ke 36 shots/35 boundaries ka poora human-reviewed map — measured, par sirf 1 film

name: Pacing ki marammat footage se, effects se nahi
when: Rhythm recut / pacing repair me
action: Do galtiyan block karo: recut ke baad bache lambe non-scenic raw holds, aur micro-clips ki accidental flicker runs. Dono ki marammat footage badal/chun kar karo — effect daal kar kabhi nahi
why: Effect pacing ki bimari ko dhakta hai, theek nahi karta; viewer ko dhokha mehsoos hota hai
evidence_note: House pacing-watchability contract

name: Har bade chapter me kam se kam ek saans-wala shot
when: Chapter rhythm review par
action: Har substantial chapter me kam se kam ek breathing/payoff/aftertaste shot rakho
why: Bina saans ke chapter ghutan hai; ek thehra shot poore chapter ko wazan deta hai
evidence_note: House pacing contract

name: Visual rhythm ka pattern: establish → detail → reaction → widen
when: Long-form ke andar shot sequence banate waqt
action: Pattern dohrao: jagah ko establish karo (aerial/skyline/map/title) → street-level detail me ghuso → human reaction/food/transit/weather/waiting dikhao → jaane se pehle phir widen karo → geography, awaaz ya motion se transition karo
why: Ye upar-neeche ki lehar hi documentary-vlog rhythm hai; sirf beauty shots se film so jati hai
frequency: Har place-block = kam se kam ek poora pattern cycle
evidence_note: House visual-rhythm style

name: Visual change gap 3s se zyada (short-form) = pattern interrupt
when: Short-form/social edit me jahan 3 second se zyada koi visual change nahi
action: Pattern interrupt lagao — bareek se mote kram me: zoom (105–110%) → cut → caption overlay → motion (pan/shake) → effect overlay. Sabse halka kaam kare wahi chuno
why: 3 second bina badlav ke short-form me dhyaan marr jata hai
evidence_note: CapCut director ke attention niyam
conflict_note: TAKRAAV: purane ORDER default me long-form max visual gap 5s hai (Shorts 3s). Ye 3s wala niyam short-form/social ke liye hai — long-form par 5s wala hi rahe; profile se lagu karo, dono ko ek mat samjho.

name: Platform ke hisaab se pacing table
when: Platform tay hote hi edit shuru karne se pehle
action: Pacing platform se lo: TikTok/Reels/Shorts — change har 1–3s, hook 1s me; YouTube short-form — change 2–3s, hook 3s; YouTube long-form — change 3–5s; LinkedIn — change 4–6s, saaf aur minimal
why: Ek hi pacing har platform par ya to sust hai ya bechain
frequency: Table upar wali; hook: TikTok 1s / YT-SF 3s
evidence_note: CapCut director ke platform-optimization niyam

name: Hook me dead air = retention ki maut
when: Video ki shuruaat (khaas taur par hook section ~pehle 4s) me
action: Shuru ki silence/dead air kaato — hook action ya baat se shuru ho, khaamoshi se nahi
why: Pehle 2 second ki dead air sabse zyada viewers girati hai
evidence_note: CapCut director ke hook niyam; purane Shorts hook ≤2.5s niyam se milta-julta

name: Pause ke niyam (talking head): 0.5s / 1.0s / dramatic chhoot
when: Talking-head edit me pauses dekhte waqt
action: Pause >0.5s ho to jump cut ka sujhav do; pause >1.0s ho to weak spot flag karo. Lekin 0.3–0.5s ke brief pauses dramatic maksad ke liye reh sakte hain
why: Har pause kaat dene se boli robot jaisi ho jati hai; lambe pause rakhe to viewer bore hota hai
evidence_note: CapCut director ke silence-detection niyam
conflict_note: TAKRAAV: purana unified pause model ≥400ms ko cut zone, 150–400ms ko usable aur <150ms ko unsafe kehta hai. Ye source 500ms threshold rakhta hai aur 300–500ms dramatic pause ko surakshit maanta hai. Merge par faisla: threshold 400ms vs 500ms — profile (talking-head social = 0.5s wala; Kang pipeline = purana model) se tay karna bacha hai.

name: Smart-cut: >1s silence aur duplicate takes pehle pass me bahar
when: Auto/smart-cut pehla pass chalate waqt
action: Subtitle gaps >1s wali silences aur duplicate takes auto-remove karo. Chalane se PEHLE project ka duplicate/backup zaroor banao (auto-backup nahi hota)
why: Pehla pass haath se karna sabse dheema kaam hai; machine ko wahi do jo bina taste ke ho sakta hai
frequency: Threshold: silence gap >1s; duplicates = sab bahar
evidence_note: CapCut smart-cut + note source ke retake-removal workflow ka sangam
conflict_note: TAKRAAV: purana pause model ≥400ms ko hi cut zone kehta hai — >1s wala threshold usse zyada conservative hai. Ye sirf AUTO pehle pass ke liye hai (haath ka fine pass purane model par hi rahe), isliye takraav pass-wise sulajh sakta hai.

name: Cut sirf silence ya word-boundary par; mid-sentence kabhi nahi
when: Tighten/cut pass me har cut lagate waqt
action: Cut hamesha silence ke andar ya word boundary par rakho — sentence ke beech me kabhi nahi. Shorts aur longform ke liye alag tighten profiles rakho
why: Beech-vaakya cut boli ko kaatta hai aur viewer ko jhatka lagta hai
evidence_note: Note source (dr-tighten) + production standard ke coherent-block niyam

name: Do-phase discipline: CUT pass → re-cut → TRANSCRIPT pass
when: Poore edit ka kram tay karte waqt
action: Pehle CUT pass (picture lock ki taraf), phir editor ka re-cut, uske BAAD transcript pass. Purani subtitles ke upar transcript pass chalana bekaar hai — transcript hamesha final cut ke baad bane
why: Galat kram = do baar kaam; transcript pehle banaya to har cut use tod dega
evidence_note: Note source

name: Phase-1 ki shikar-list
when: Pehle (hunt) pass me footage dekhte waqt
action: Sirf ye cheezen dhoondo aur mark karo: duplicate takes, misspeaks, garbled audio, flash frames, redundancy, aur script ke missing sections
why: Pehla pass sab kuch ek saath theek karne nikle to kuch theek nahi hota
frequency: 6 item ki list; is se bahar ka kaam phase-2 ka
evidence_note: Note source

name: Screen-recording cut workflow: transcript pehle, rough 2x, 1.5x par galti-pass
when: Screen-recording/talking video ka rough cut banate waqt
action: Transcript-first kaato: AI transcription + silent-portion removal ~80% kaam kar deta hai. Rough cut ka target final length ka ~2x rakho (8 min final → ~16 min rough). Refine pass me snapping OFF, audio scrubbing ON, 5-frame nudges. Aakhiri mistake pass 1.5x playback par ripple-delete ke saath chalao (aur 1–3 minute nikalta hai). Verify: koi audible cut edit na sune, saare ums/pauses gaye hon
why: Dekh-dekh kar kaatna sabse dheema hai; transcript se kaatna tez aur pakka hai
evidence_note: Resolve screen-recording workflow se

name: Silence detection ki shart: room noise pehle theek karo
when: Auto silence removal chalane se pehle
action: Room noise −30 dB se upar ho to silence detection toot jata hai — pehle noise reduction karo ya haath se kaato
why: Shor ko tool khaamoshi samajh nahi pata; galat detection = galat cuts
evidence_note: Workflow ki vyavharik shart

name: Screencast speed map: sust hissa delete nahi, tez karo
when: Screencast ke boring hisse handle karte waqt
action: Boring hisse ko delete karne ki jagah speed up karo taaki poora workflow dikhta rahe. Normal speed = prompts, output review, test results, key decisions. 4x–8x = generation, lambe reads, scrolling. Poora cut = false starts, re-prompts, apni typos. Speed% = (original duration / target audio duration) x 100
why: Delete karne se viewer ko 'beech me kya hua' ka shaq rehta hai; tez karne se poora safar dikhta hai
frequency: 4x–8x sust hisso par; key moments hamesha 1x
evidence_note: Screencast editor ki house style

name: Talking speed 1.1x (samajh bani rahe to)
when: Speaker-led short-form me
action: Speaker ki speed 1.1x rakho — sirf tab jab intelligibility poori bani rahe
why: Halki tez boli energy deti hai bina nakli lage
evidence_note: Production standard se

name: A-roll reset: 6–9s se zyada bina reset ke nahi (talking-head social)
when: Talking-head social edit (Deya-style retention) me
action: 6–9 second se zyada uninterrupted A-roll mat chalne do — beech me visual reset do (B-roll, punch-in, angle ya title)
why: Ek hi frame par thahri boli dhyaan ko sust kar deti hai
evidence_note: Ek retention creator (Deya) ki style ko production standard ne apnaya
conflict_note: TAKRAAV (halka): purana max visual gap default 5s hai. Ye 6–9s wala window sirf 'A-roll reset' ki had hai (speaker frame par lagatar rehne ki), aam visual-change gap se alag mapna — dono ek saath chal sakte hain: visual change 5s ke andar, A-roll reset 9s ke andar.

name: BPM ke hisaab se cut frequency
when: Music-led edit me cut rhythm tay karte waqt
action: Cut frequency BPM se lo: 60 BPM → har 4 beats (~4s, ~8 cuts/30s, cinematic); 100 BPM → har 2 beats (~17 cuts/30s); 120 BPM → har 1–2 beats (20–30 cuts/30s); 140 BPM → har beat (~35 cuts/30s). Ambient/bina-BPM music par beat-cut bilkul nahi — cuts visual narrative se motivate hon, 5–15s ke holds aam hain
why: Music ki gati aur cut ki gati alag chale to video do hisso me tootta lagta hai
frequency: Upar wali table; formula: beat frames = 1800/BPM @30fps
evidence_note: CapCut KF-07 ka BPM-to-cut map (house table, measured nahi)

name: Cuts beat par; 2–3 frame aage-peeche ka khel
when: Beat-synced cuts lagate waqt
action: Default: cut theek beat par (kick/snare). Aage ki kheench (anticipation) chahiye to cut beat se 2–3 frames PEHLE; wazan chahiye to 2–3 frames BAAD. Off-beat cuts sirf syncopated/groovy feel ke liye jaan-bujh kar
why: Beat par cut 'lock' mehsoos hota hai; jaan-bujh kar off-beat usi lock ko tod kar jaan deta hai — galti se off-beat sirf galti lagta hai
evidence_note: KF-07 beat-sync guide
